raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior Web Designer with a strong creative vision, excellent visual design skills, and a portfolio that demonstrates expertise in art direction, typography, layout, and motion.

This role is ideal for someone who can create visually engaging and interactive web experiences that go beyond standard corporate designs and templates. The selected candidate should be comfortable working independently, moving quickly, collaborating with developers, and taking ownership of design projects from concept to execution.

What You'll Do:

  • Conceptualize and design high-impact web pages, campaign experiences, and digital assets with a clear creative direction.
  • Develop distinctive visual concepts through strong art direction, typography, layout, and composition.
  • Create engaging motion and interactive elements, either by producing them directly or providing clear direction to developers.
  • Develop wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity web designs using Figma.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are translated into polished, responsive, and accessible websites.
  • Maintain and improve the brand's web components and visual style across different projects.
  • Work on a variety of projects, from immersive and interactive web experiences to simpler website redesigns and page updates.
  • Communicate design ideas clearly, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality work within project timelines.

Requirements:

  • A personal portfolio website showcasing advanced web design skills. This is mandatory and will be the primary basis for evaluation.
  • Strong creative vision and a distinctive design style that feels modern, expressive, and visually engaging rather than overly corporate.
  • Proven experience designing immersive, interactive, or visually rich web experiences.
  • Strong skills in art direction, typography, layout, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience with motion design or a solid understanding of motion and interaction in web design.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity design.
  • Good understanding of how web designs are developed into responsive and accessible live websites.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver quality work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with developers and brand teams.
  • Availability to collaborate during Pacific Time (PT) business hours. Candidates based in the Pacific Time zone are strongly preferred.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working with technology, SaaS, AI, or brand-focused companies.
  • Previous experience in a creative agency or design studio.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Experience with 3D design, WebGL, or other interactive web technologies.
  • Familiarity with Framer, Webflow, After Effects, or other prototyping and motion design tools.
  • Experience using AI-assisted design tools.
  • Freelance opportunity supporting ongoing web design projects.
  • Weekly working hours and engagement duration will be discussed during the selection process.
  • Work involves a mix of highly creative web experiences, campaign pages, and simpler website redesigns.
  • Candidates should be comfortable working with a small, fast-moving in-house brand team.
  • Pacific Time availability is preferred, with candidates based in the Pacific region strongly prioritized.

Application Requirements:

  1. Submit your proposal through Upwork.
  2. Include a link to your personal portfolio website.
  3. Answer the required screening questions and provide relevant details about your web design experience.

Important: A personal portfolio website is mandatory. The portfolio will be the primary basis for evaluating candidates' creative style, visual design skills, art direction, typography, and motion capabilities. Proposals without a personal portfolio website will not be considered.

An enterprise client is seeking a talented Senior Web Designer to support a leading AI company in creating distinctive, high-quality web experiences.

The selected freelancer will work with a small, fast-moving in-house brand team to develop creative web designs, campaign pages, and digital experiences that reflect a bold and modern visual identity.

raw.excerpt: About MenloMenlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it.
raw.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

We are hiring a Researcher to advance the world models at the core of Asimov's ability to perceive, predict, and act. You will work at the intersection of self-supervised representation learning, predictive architectures, and embodied control, in close collaboration with our platform, firmware, and hardware teams.

What You'll Do

  • Design, train, and rigorously evaluate world models that let Asimov predict the consequences of actions across visual, proprioceptive, and force/torque modalities.

  • Advance our self-supervised learning stack for visual and sensor representations, building on and extending the JEPA family (V-JEPA, I-JEPA, and related predictive-embedding approaches).

  • Prototype and benchmark generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs) against JEPA-style objectives for embodied prediction and planning.

  • Own the data pipeline for your experiments end to end: curation, tooling, and scaling, without depending on a separate data-engineering team to move.

  • Integrate what you build with our platform, firmware, and software teams so research reaches the robot, not just the paper.

  • Contribute to sim-to-real transfer, inverse dynamics, and multi-modal sensor fusion, and publish or open-source work where it strengthens the field and the team.

What We Look For

  • Proven modeling track record: you have trained models and can show solid, honest evaluations, not just training curves.

  • JEPA fluency: you understand the joint-embedding predictive approach and can reason about where it fits versus alternatives.

  • Breadth across approaches: familiarity with prior and adjacent work, including VLA (vision-language-action) models, and a view on their trade-offs.

  • Depth in a modality: strong depth in at least one sensory domain (vision, audio, natural language, or similar).

  • Strong data abilities: you get things done without depending on a whole data-engineering team.

  • Solid engineering: you can implement, integrate, and ship what you build alongside platform, firmware, and software teams.

  • Conversant, ideally deep, in several of: SSL for visual and sensor representations; world models (JEPA, V-JEPA, I-JEPA, LeJEPA, MJEPA); generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs); robotics ML (VLA, inverse dynamics, sim-to-real, optical flow); sensor fusion (vision, proprioception, force/torque, multi-modal encoders); PyTorch, JAX, and distributed training.

Nice to Have

  • Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CoRL, or RSS (or arXiv work with comparable citations).

  • PhD or equivalent research experience in ML, robotics, or computer vision. Not required with a strong portfolio.

  • Demonstrated hardware or robotics interest or hands-on experience.

  • Strong communication: technical blogs, talks, or clear written research.

Why Join Menlo

World models are the bet that lets a humanoid generalize instead of memorize. This is a rare seat where your research runs on real hardware in short cycles, your data and modeling choices are yours to own, and your work ships in the open. If you want the distance between an idea and a walking robot to be measured in weeks, this is the room.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

raw.description:
Partner Discovery & Requirements Analysis

  • Lead and document working sessions with clinical, finance, operations, product, and technical stakeholders to understand existing workflows, business rules, data requirements, and operational processes.
  • Translate manual and system-supported workflows into structured business and functional requirements.
  • Produce gap-analysis documentation mapping current-state processes and partner requirements to existing platform capabilities.
  • Classify requirements based on appropriate disposition, such as existing functionality, configuration, new development, acceptable operational workaround, shared platform enhancement, or out of scope.
  • Maintain a consistent backlog structure across implementations so requirements remain comparable, traceable, and reusable.

System Reconciliation & Technical Analysis

  • Analyze application logic, SQL, stored procedures, configuration parameters, integrations, and data flows to understand existing system behavior.
  • Determine whether business requirements can be satisfied through configuration, existing functionality, process changes, or new development.
  • Validate assumptions about platform behavior against available technical evidence and distinguish confirmed system behavior from inferred behavior.
  • Identify discrepancies between documented behavior, stakeholder expectations, system configuration, and implemented logic.
  • Trace business rules to underlying parameters, data elements, calculations, integrations, and system components.
  • Identify where behaviors are configurable versus hardcoded and assess the impact on future implementations.

Requirements Authoring

  • Write clear business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and proposed workarounds.
  • Maintain appropriate separation between business-facing requirements and technical implementation details.
  • Ensure acceptance criteria reflect the agreed solution approach, including configuration changes, operational workarounds, or new functionality.
  • Apply a consistent standard for distinguishing standalone requirements from assumptions, configuration decisions, implementation details, or operational procedures.
  • Maintain traceability from business need through solution decision and development implementation.

Cross-Functional Facilitation & Governance

  • Facilitate requirements, solutioning, and review sessions across business, clinical, product, engineering, data, and operational teams.
  • Drive open questions toward resolution and update requirements and documentation to reflect confirmed decisions.
  • Identify ambiguity, conflicting requirements, downstream impacts, and cross-feature dependencies before development begins.
  • Prevent scope drift and ensure implementation-specific requirements do not unintentionally become platform-wide requirements.
  • Support prioritization and decision-making by clearly communicating business impact, implementation complexity, dependencies, and risk.

Ticket Creation & Scoping

  • Translate approved requirements into development-ready tickets containing problem statements, user stories, functional scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and open questions.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to clarify technical scope and implementation approach.
  • Track dependencies across features, integrations, implementations, and shared platform capabilities.
  • Identify common capabilities that can support multiple clients, workflows, or future implementations rather than creating one-off solutions.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, or equivalent role in a software-, data-, or technology-driven environment.
  • Experience working within healthcare technology, healthcare operations, payer/provider systems, pharmacy, claims, revenue cycle, eligibility, or related healthcare domains.
  • Ability to understand and reason about SQL, data structures, system logic, APIs, configuration, and technical workflows well enough to validate platform behavior and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development tickets that engineering teams can implement with minimal rework.
  • Strong analytical rigor with the ability to distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions, challenge unclear reasoning, and validate conclusions.
  • Experience facilitating requirements and solution-review sessions involving business, clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt business and technical information for different audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with healthcare claims, eligibility, reimbursement, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, or healthcare financial processes.
  • Experience working with configurable or rules-driven healthcare platforms.
  • Experience supporting client, provider, health system, or partner implementations.
  • Understanding of data pipelines, ETL processes, APIs, healthcare integrations, and data exchange concepts.
  • Experience managing a shared product backlog across multiple customers, implementations, or business units.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards, regulatory requirements, or privacy considerations such as HIPAA.

Key Competencies

  • Requirements elicitation and translation
  • Healthcare workflow analysis
  • Technical and data analysis
  • System behavior reconciliation
  • Product and backlog management
  • Stakeholder facilitation and decision-driving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Analytical rigor and structured problem-solving
  • Dependency and impact analysis
  • Documentation discipline and traceability

raw.description:
Our client is seeking a remote Lead AWS Platform Architect to provide senior technical leadership for a mission-critical cloud platform in a remote work environment.

This is a hands-on architecture and platform-engineering role focused on AWS, Amazon EKS, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, security, and federal cloud compliance. The platform is highly automated, with infrastructure and application changes managed through code, peer review, and deployment pipelines rather than manual console configuration.

The Lead AWS Platform Architect will take ownership of platform architecture and implementation across multiple AWS environments, helping guide the evolution toward a secure multi-account federal cloud architecture.

The right candidate is equally comfortable designing cloud architecture and implementing it. You should be able to move from architecture decisions and Terraform modules to EKS operations, GitOps workflows, CI/CD security controls, and production troubleshooting.

Success in this role means delivering secure, reliable, highly automated cloud infrastructure while raising engineering standards across architecture, security, change control, automation, and operational evidence.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as a senior technical lead for AWS platform architecture, engineering, security, and automation.

  • Own and evolve Terraform across multi-environment and multi-account AWS infrastructure.

  • Develop reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, dependencies, lifecycle, and infrastructure drift.

  • Safely reconcile existing AWS resources with Infrastructure as Code.

  • Design, operate, and improve production Amazon EKS environments.

  • Manage EKS networking, autoscaling, add-ons, workload identity, Helm, ingress, load balancing, upgrades, and cluster lifecycle.

  • Design and maintain secure AWS networking and identity patterns.

  • Support IAM, workload identity, network isolation, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

  • Develop and extend GitOps deployment models using Argo CD, Flux, or comparable technologies.

  • Design and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure and application delivery.

  • Implement automated security controls including SAST, Infrastructure as Code scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, policy-as-code, and deployment gates.

  • Support secure container supply-chain practices including image validation, signing, and deployment controls.

  • Help design and implement a federal multi-account AWS landing-zone architecture.

  • Develop approaches for cross-account identity, networking, environment isolation, and controlled promotion between development, testing, and production environments.

  • Work with AWS services including VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, Lambda, and related cloud technologies.

  • Support cloud-native, containerized, microservices, and serverless architectures.

  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and continuous security visibility across the platform.

  • Support the technical implementation of controls aligned with NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, RMF, and Authority to Operate requirements.

  • Produce and maintain technical evidence supporting security assessments, compliance reviews, and ATO activities.

  • Troubleshoot complex AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, networking, GitOps, CI/CD, and security issues.

  • Mentor engineers and provide technical direction on cloud architecture, automation, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, and DevSecOps practices.

  • Improve engineering standards around peer review, change management, deployment validation, documentation, and evidence-based operations.

  • Collaborate with developers, security teams, architects, program stakeholders, and other technical personnel.

  • Perform other related technical responsibilities as assigned.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or a related discipline, including senior ownership of production environments.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience engineering and supporting AWS cloud environments.

  • Deep hands-on expertise with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, dependency management, and infrastructure drift remediation.

  • Significant experience operating Amazon EKS or Kubernetes at production scale.

  • Experience with Kubernetes networking, workload identity, Helm, autoscaling, ingress, load balancing, and cluster lifecycle management.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, and related technologies.

  • Experience designing or supporting multi-environment and multi-account AWS architectures.

  • Hands-on experience implementing GitOps using Argo CD, Flux, or comparable technologies.

  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, with GitLab CI/CD strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on DevSecOps experience implementing automated security scanning, secrets detection, Infrastructure as Code scanning, container scanning, policy-as-code, or pipeline security gates.

  • Experience with Docker and secure containerized application environments.

  • Experience supporting cloud-native, microservices, or serverless architectures.

  • Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks such as FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and RMF.

  • Familiarity with the technical evidence and controls required to support an Authority to Operate.

  • Strong troubleshooting, architecture, documentation, and communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and provide technical leadership.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating AWS Organizations, Control Tower, federal landing zones, or comparable multi-account architectures.

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or FedRAMP-authorized cloud environments.

  • Experience with container supply-chain security, SBOMs, image signing, admission control, or AWS Signer.

  • Experience with CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, or comparable observability platforms.

  • Experience supporting FISMA Moderate or other regulated production environments.

  • Experience with high-availability, mission-critical cloud systems.

  • Familiarity with scientific, environmental, weather, geospatial, or other data-intensive systems.

  • Familiarity with scientific data formats such as GRIB or NetCDF.

Work Authorization / Security Clearance Requirements

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.

title: Teach English From Home !
description: Teach English Online!  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing • Long-term employment only!

raw.title: Teach English From Home !
raw.excerpt: Teach English Online!  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing • Long-term employment only!
raw.description:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

raw.title: Junior AI Engineer
raw.excerpt: About the CompanyAjaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results.
raw.description:
About the Company

Ajaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results. We operate across four core pillars: AI Strategy and Advisory, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Training and Enablement, and Custom Product Development.

In addition to client services, Ajaia builds proprietary AI products, copilots, and vertical solutions that solve high-value industry problems. This dual model allows us to translate hands-on implementation experience into scalable products while continuously refining our approach through real-world deployment.

Our operating model combines deep technical execution with practical change management, enabling enterprises to deploy secure, compliant, and high-impact solutions that drive measurable operational value. From executive roadmapping to production-ready systems and workforce upskilling, Ajaia embeds intelligent tools directly into the workflows that matter most.

Mission: Help organizations win the AI moment.

Position Overview

As a Junior AI Engineer at Ajaia, you will build and ship AI-enabled software across client engagements and internal products, working alongside senior engineers who will review your work and help you grow.

You will take clearly scoped tasks, ask good questions, and deliver working code across web interfaces, backend services, LLM integrations, and AI-driven workflows. Over time, you will take on larger pieces of work with less guidance.

This is an individual contributor role for an early-career engineer who learns fast, cares about quality, and wants real production experience in applied AI.

Every role at Ajaia is AI-forward. We expect engineers to use AI tools in daily workflows across research, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. AI usage is a core execution capability, not optional tooling.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Build and fix frontend and backend features for AI-enabled applications, under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Help integrate large language model APIs, prompts, and simple AI workflows into products.
  • Write clean, tested code and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
  • Work with APIs, databases, and cloud deployments on well-defined tasks.
  • Use AI tools daily for coding support, debugging, research, test generation, and documentation.
  • Ask clarifying questions early and raise blockers quickly.
  • Keep documentation, tickets, and status updates current.
  • Learn the team's engineering patterns and apply them consistently.

Requirements

  • 0–2 years of professional experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects (internships, freelance, open source, or personal projects count).
  • Working knowledge of a modern frontend framework (such as React or Next.js) and a backend language (such as Python or Node.js).
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, SQL databases, and authentication.
  • Some hands-on experience calling a large language model API (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini) in a project.
  • Comfortable with Git and GitHub for daily collaboration.
  • Clear written and spoken English with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Active daily use of AI tools for coding, debugging, and learning.
  • Ability to check AI-generated code for correctness instead of accepting it as is.
  • Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and improve quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A project that uses retrieval (RAG), embeddings, or a simple AI agent.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL.

Schedule and Location

  • This is a fully remote role within approved hiring locations, subject to Ajaia hiring and compliance requirements.
  • Working schedule follows Eastern Time hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, including holidays.

Technical Requirements

  • Reliable wired internet connection with at least 100 Mbps speed.
  • Computer or laptop with Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5 processor or higher.
  • Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 128 GB available storage.
  • Dual-monitor setup preferred.
  • Windows 10 or macOS (latest version).
  • 1080p webcam and working microphone.
  • Backup solutions for power and internet interruptions.

Benefits

  • Compensation: USD 10,000 per year base salary + Performance Bonus
  • Remote work with earned flexibility.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Paid time off.

Why Join Ajaia

You will start your career building real AI products that reach production, with senior engineers who will review your work and help you grow fast. You will see both client delivery and internal product work, and build the range that strong AI engineers need.

The environment rewards ownership, speed, and clarity rather than bureaucracy.

Experience the Ajaia difference. Let's build what's next.

About the Role
Were seeking a detail-oriented Medical Billing Specialist to support the revenue cycle operations of a U.S.-based healthcare client. This role is primarily focused on reducing claim denials and recovering aging or stale claims. You'll be working directly in the clients billing system, managing claim queues, and communicating with payers to ensure timely and accurate reimbursement.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience in medical billing or claims follow-up who thrives in a fast-paced, process-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Log into the clients billing system to review and manage denied or aging claims
  • Work claim queues to identify root causes of denials and submit appropriate documentation or corrections
  • Make outbound phone calls to insurance payers to check claim statuses, appeal denials, and resolve payment issues
  • Escalate recurring denial trends or system/process bottlenecks to the clients RCM lead
  • Maintain accurate and detailed notes of all payer interactions and claim activities
  • Assist with additional RCM workflows as needed to support clean and efficient revenue operations

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in medical billing, revenue cycle management, or claims follow-up
  • Familiarity with payer portals and billing systems (e.g., Kareo, Athena, AdvancedMD, etc.)
  • High attention to detail and ability to work independently on repetitive or process-heavy tasks
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Comfortable speaking with payers over the phone and navigating insurance systems

Nice to Have

  • Experience with denial management and recovery of aged claims
  • Previous work with U.S.-based healthcare providers
  • Background in a remote RCM role

Work Setup: Remote, Mexico-aligned working hours
Contract End Date / Length: 30 November 2026 (expected to be extended)
Rate: £623–£674
Languages: English; Spanish preferred

Our client is looking for a Mainframe Datacom Engineer to provide hands-on BAU support and technical ownership of an existing CA Datacom environment on IBM z/OS. The role runs alongside a wider modernisation programme and focuses on maintaining and supporting the current Datacom estate, rather than production monitoring or a Datacom-to-DB2 migration.

What you will do:

  • Administer and maintain Broadcom Datacom databases on z/OS.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve Datacom database issues independently.
  • Carry out backup, restore and recovery, and database administration and structuring.
  • Diagnose and resolve database and query performance issues.
  • Perform and support Datacom fixes, patching, patch validation and maintenance.
  • Provide Datacom technical consultancy and support to applications and users.
  • Carry out root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
  • Take ownership of BAU Datacom activities transferred from the existing team.
  • Work with application, operations and infrastructure teams to maintain service stability.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong hands-on Broadcom Datacom or CA Datacom DBA experience.
  • A proven ability to diagnose and fix Datacom issues, not only monitor and escalate them.
  • Strong experience in backup and recovery, database administration, restoration and performance or query tuning.
  • Hands-on Datacom patching, maintenance and system programming experience.
  • Strong IBM z/OS and JCL knowledge.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale production Datacom environments.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal training or supervision.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analysis and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work Mexico-aligned hours.

Preferred:

  • Spanish language capability, particularly for working with Spanish-speaking users and team members.
  • CICS, COBOL and wider mainframe application knowledge.
  • Banking or financial services experience.
  • Db2 knowledge (advantageous, not required).
  • Experience in regulated enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on Broadcom or CA Datacom DBA experience.
  • Strong IBM z/OS and JCL knowledge.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale production Datacom environments.
  • English fluency, with Spanish preferred.

raw.excerpt: Votre rôleEn tant que Senior Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultant.
raw.description:
Votre rôle

En tant que Senior Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultant.e.s. Vous piloterez opérationnellement les missions, participerez activement au développement commercial, au marketing de l’offre et au développement de l’expertise au sein du cabinet.

Vous intervenez comme directeur de projet auprès de directions immobilières, directions des environnements de travail et directions des systèmes d’information dans la définition de leur stratégie Smart Building et dans la transformation numérique de leurs bâtiments, depuis l’expression des besoins jusqu’au déploiement des solutions et à leur adoption par les utilisateurs.

Vos principales responsabilités

1.Développement commercial et management

  • Encadrer, accompagner et faire progresser des consultants.
  • Réalisation des rendez-vous d’avant-vente et aux phases de qualification.
  • Pilotage de la rédaction des propositions commerciales et des réponses aux appels d’offres.
  • Structurer les démarches, charges, livrables et dispositifs d’intervention.
  • Présenter les propositions aux clients et défendre les choix méthodologiques.
  • Développer des offres, méthodes, référentiels et convictions autour du Smart Building.
  • Participer à la veille technologique, réglementaire et concurrentielle.

2.Pilotage de mission de conseil et cadrage stratégique

  • Analyser les enjeux usagers, immobiliers, énergétiques, environnementaux, numériques et organisationnels des clients.
  • Construire une vision cible du bâtiment intelligent adaptée à leurs priorités et à leur patrimoine.
  • Réaliser des diagnostics de maturité Smart Building et Digital Workplace.
  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les cas d’usage à valeur :
    • performance énergétique ;
    • optimisation de l’occupation et des espaces ;
    • confort et qualité des environnements intérieurs ;
    • maintenance prédictive ;
    • expérience collaborateur ;
    • services aux occupants ;
    • sûreté et sécurité ;
    • pilotage multisite du patrimoine.
  • Élaborer des feuilles de route, scénarios de transformation et modèles de gouvernance.
  • Contribuer à la construction des trajectoires d'ambition digitales.

3.Pilotage de conception fonctionnelle et architecture Smart Building

  • Recueillir les besoins des directions métiers, immobilières, techniques et informatiques.
  • Formaliser les cas d’usage, parcours utilisateurs et exigences fonctionnelles.
  • Participer à la définition des architectures fonctionnelles et applicatives.
  • Définir les principes d’articulation entre :
    • équipements et systèmes du bâtiment ;
    • GTB/GTC ;
    • IoT et capteurs ;
    • réseaux et connectivité ;
    • Building Operating System ou plateforme de services ;
    • BIM et BIM GEM ;
    • systèmes d’information immobiliers ;
    • outils Workplace ;
    • plateformes de données ;
    • applications destinées aux occupants.

4.Pilotage de prestation d’assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage et pilotage de projets

  • Accompagner les clients dans la rédaction de programmes fonctionnels et de cahiers des charges.
  • Participer à la consultation et à la sélection de fournisseurs, intégrateurs et éditeurs.
  • Analyser les réponses techniques et fonctionnelles.
  • Assurer la coordination entre les différents acteurs du projet :
  • Piloter les risques, dépendances, arbitrages et plans d’action.
  • Préparer et animer les instances de gouvernance.
  • Suivre la réalisation des pilotes, démonstrateurs et déploiements.
  • Préparer les phases de recette fonctionnelle et de mise en service.
  • Vérifier l’alignement des solutions déployées avec les usages et la vision initiale.

5. Pilotage de mission de conduite du changement

  • Comprendre les attentes des occupants, exploitants et gestionnaires.
  • Concevoir des parcours de services simples et cohérents.
  • Animer des ateliers de design de services ou de co-construction.
  • Participer à la définition des modalités d’adoption des nouveaux services numériques.
  • Accompagner les équipes clientes dans l’évolution de leurs pratiques.
  • Mesurer l’usage, la satisfaction et la valeur créée après le déploiement.

Votre profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure Bac+5, école d’ingénieurs, école de commerce, université ou formation spécialisée en immobilier, bâtiment, numérique ou systèmes d’information.
  • Expérience professionnelle de 10 ans minimum, acquise dans le conseil, l’immobilier, l’ingénierie, l’intégration de solutions ou la transformation digitale.
  • Expérience significative sur des projets Smart Building, Smart Workplace, immobilier numérique, IoT, performance énergétique ou exploitation technique.
  • Expérience de pilotage de missions, de lots ou de projets complexes impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.
  • Une expérience en management en cabinet de conseil constitue un atout important.

Vos qualités

  • Forte capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
  • Aptitude à comprendre et à articuler des enjeux métiers, immobiliers et technologiques.
  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et relationnelles.
  • Capacité à animer des ateliers et à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction.
  • Pédagogie et capacité à rendre accessibles des sujets techniques complexes.
  • Autonomie dans la conduite des missions.
  • Esprit de conseil et orientation client.
  • Goût du travail collectif et des environnements pluridisciplinaires.
  • Capacité à structurer et sécuriser des projets complexes.
  • Curiosité pour les innovations, les usages et les évolutions du marché.
  • Capacité à encadrer et faire progresser des consultants

Entité

L'ambition d'Orange Business est de devenir l'intégrateur réseaux et numérique de référence en Europe, en nous appuyant sur nos forces autour des solutions de connectivité nouvelle génération, du cloud et de la cybersécurité.

Nos 30 000 femmes et hommes présents dans 65 pays, dont chaque voix compte, sont tous animés par la même détermination et le même esprit d'équipe, pour construire les solutions digitales d'aujourd'hui et de demain et créer un impact positif pour nos clients, pour leurs salariés et pour la planète.

Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes grâce à des projets innovants dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l'IA, la cybersécurité, l'IoT, ou encore le digital workspace et le big data.

Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous !

Travailler chez Orange Consulting, c'est rejoindre un cabinet à taille humaine qui offre à ses collaborateurs des perspectives d'évolution claires et accessibles à travers des parcours de formations spécialement conçus par et pour nos consultants.

La direction Orange Consulting accompagne les entreprises et les institutions en France et à l'international sur leurs problématiques de transformation digitale et leurs enjeux métiers.

raw.excerpt: About UsAfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape.
raw.description:
About Us

AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world’s leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.

AfterShip unifies shipping & labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post-purchase touchpoint.

AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400 carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.

Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.

Your Mission:

Our marketing team ships at a high cadence across paid, email, events, organic social, and web. In 2026 we built the strategic creative direction. In 2027 we need production horsepower—designers who turn that direction into volume, fast, using AI as leverage. The ideal candidate is a builder first and foremost, not an abstract strategist. This role reports to AfterShip’s Manager of Creative.

What You’ll Do:

  • Performance marketing ad creative (static + simple motion) for paid channels.
  • UI snippets that showcase our product benefits, used across channels.
  • Demand gen campaign creative including campaign identity + asset development.
  • Web asset development + templated wireframes leveraging our core design system.
  • Other assets as needed: organic social assets, email marketing assets, IRL event graphics.
  • Contributing to the build out of AI-native production workflows — pushing Claude Design, Midjourney, Runway, Figma AI, and whatever’s next to the limit.

Who We're Looking For:

  • Taste: Your portfolio shows you know what great B2B tech marketing design looks like.
  • AI as a reflex: You build your own agents and default to AI-native production methods every day — not as a demo you rolled out once. You are deeply curious and constantly seek out new ways to get leverage out of AI tooling.
  • Hustle: You ship fast. You care about getting to prod. You see the value in creative testing and iteration vs. aiming for polished perfection.
  • Design chops: Strong graphic design + fluency in simple motion design. Figma is your home.
  • Extreme ownership: When a project is assigned to you, you own it from beginning to end. You clear blockers and problem solve as needed to deliver on the assignment.
  • Opinionated: You always bring a POV to your work, and can articulate the rationale behind the creative choices you make.

At AfterShip, we know great talent doesn’t always fit every requirement. If you’re passionate about our mission and believe you can make an impact, we encourage you to apply.

Why You Should Join Us:

We are Monterail - ~ 130 experts working together to create meaningful software.
As a software agency, we collaborate with multiple clients, so as a Junior Project Manager, you will most likely run a few projects simultaneously.
We specialise in 4 main industries Fintech, MedTech, HRtech & E-commerce.

We are opening a Junior Project Manager opportunity with a specific twist: at least half of your projects will be AI-augmented.

What does that mean? In some of our projects we use AI tools like Claude, Claude Code connected to our repos to handle the work that used to take hours: drafting tickets, summarising calls, surfacing risks in git history.

We are looking for someone who is excited to utilise AI in their projects but also work in traditional set-up of projects.

Requirements

Project work - what will you do?

  • collaborate on building web and mobile applications from prototyping through delivery
  • coordinate a project team of Backend, Front-End or Mobile Developers, supported by QA Specialists and Designers

AI- augmented work - what will you do?

  • use Claude (and similar tools) to draft Jira tickets, refinement summaries, decision logs and client updates

Description

Helfy is a European leader in digital health, facilitating over 300,000 monthly treatments across the continent through our flagship platform, DoktorABC. We connect licensed physicians, partner pharmacies, and patients to make healthcare faster, discreet, and reliable.

As we expand our footprint in the French market, we are looking for dedicated Independent Endocrinologists to join our medical network. This remote role offers complete autonomy to set your own workload, fitting smoothly alongside an existing practice or hospital appointment while generating a consistent supplemental revenue stream.

Responsibilities

As our Endocrinology Category Lead, you will combine remote clinical consultations with high-impact clinical leadership. You will serve as our primary specialist authority in France, shaping our medical standards, safety frameworks, and treatment protocols in specialized endocrine and metabolic health.

  • 100% Remote Opportunity: Lead consultations and protocol development from your home or personal workspace, wherever you are based, provided you hold valid authorization to practice in France.
  • Protocol & Clinical Leadership: Design, refine, and audit clinical guidelines, triage algorithms, contraindication screenings, and dosing escalation protocols for our French medical services.
  • Targeted Clinical Consultations: Conduct specialized teleconsultations and reviews focused exclusively on three core therapeutic pillars:
    • Weight Loss & Obesity Management: Advanced GLP-1 and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist therapies, lifestyle integration, and long-term metabolic monitoring.
    • Type 2 Diabetes: Glycemic control protocols, early-stage interventions, and continuous therapeutic oversight.
    • Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT): Endocrine assessment for hypogonadism, laboratory screening protocols, safety thresholds, and hormone optimization.
  • Maximum Schedule Flexibility: Organize your review hours and protocol advisory workload around your hospital duties or private clinical practice.
  • Direct Influence on Care at Scale: Establish the benchmark for quality, safety, and evidence-based care delivered to thousands of patients across France.

Requirements

  • Licensing & Credentials: Fully licensed Medical Doctor (MD) registered with the Conseil National de l’Ordre des Médecins (CNOM) with a recognized medical specialization in Endocrinology, Diabetology, and Nutrition (DES d’Endocrinologie-Diabétologie-Nutrition or recognized EU equivalent).
  • Active Registration: Valid and active RPPS number with unrestricted authorization to practice medicine in France.
  • Deep Clinical Expertise: Proven authority and current clinical experience in managing:
    • In-depth dosing, titration, monitoring, and safety profiles of GLP-1 receptor agonists and anti-obesity medications.
    • Evidence-based diagnostic workflows and monitoring for Hypogonadism & Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT) (hematocrit/PSA tracking, fertility considerations, contraindications).
    • Comprehensive care pathways for Type 2 Diabetes.
  • Clinical Governance Mindset: Prior experience in writing clinical guidelines, medical review protocols, or leading safety audits is a strong asset.
  • Insurance: Active individual professional indemnity insurance (Responsabilité Civile Professionnelle – RCP) covering specialist teleconsultation and medical advisory activities in France.
  • Setup & Security: High-speed internet access, private setup ensuring strict adherence to medical confidentiality, and comfort using modern telehealth interfaces.

6-Month Contract | Potential Full-Time Opportunity | Remote (US)

Engagement: Six-month contract, approximately 40 hours per week, with potential extension or conversion to permanent employment

Location: Remote, United States, with substantial Eastern Time business-hour overlap

Start: As soon as possible

We're looking for a highly experienced, hands-on DevSecOps / AWS Platform Engineer to help strengthen and modernize our cloud infrastructure, application security, and development operations.

This engagement encompasses two major initiatives: improving our cloud and application security infrastructure and migrating business-critical legacy systems into AWS.

You'll work closely with our engineering and technology leadership teams, with significant autonomy to recommend solutions, make technical decisions, and implement improvements.

This is not a purely advisory or architectural role. We want an engineer who enjoys designing solutions, writing code, automating infrastructure, and delivering working systems.

While initially structured as a six-month contract, we're building a long-term internal technology capability, and the right candidate may have an opportunity to transition into a permanent position.

Requirements

Cloud & Application Security

  • Evaluate and strengthen application and AWS security, including identity, authorization, data protection, and infrastructure controls.
  • Implement automated security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response capabilities.
  • Embed security practices into our development workflows without unnecessarily slowing delivery.

AWS Infrastructure & Migration

  • Lead the technical migration of legacy production workloads into WorldVia-managed AWS environments.
  • Design secure, reliable, cost-effective AWS infrastructure supporting modern applications and traditional business systems.
  • Implement infrastructure as code, backup and recovery, monitoring, and operational automation.
  • Coordinate migration testing, validation, cutover, and stabilization with internal stakeholders.

DevOps & Platform Engineering

  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and environment management.
  • Integrate security scanning and automated safeguards into development workflows.
  • Establish practical infrastructure standards and reusable deployment patterns.
  • Support cloud infrastructure needs for applications incorporating generative AI and agentic workflows.
  • Document architecture, operating procedures, and technical decisions so our internal team can maintain and evolve the environment.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or related disciplines.
  • Strong AWS expertise, including networking, compute, databases, IAM, security, monitoring, and infrastructure architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience migrating production workloads from legacy or third-party environments into AWS, preferably including Windows-based applications.
  • Practical experience implementing application and cloud security controls.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or AWS CDK.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD systems, automated security scanning, and deployment automation.
  • Strong understanding of backup, disaster recovery, production monitoring, and incident response.
  • Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and collaborate with a small, fast-moving engineering team.

Especially Valuable, Preferred:

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, or other AI infrastructure.
  • Secure development practices involving AI coding tools.
  • Financial application or legacy enterprise system migrations.
  • PCI DSS or SOC 2 readiness experience.
  • Experience balancing security, reliability, infrastructure costs, and rapid product delivery.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

We're a product-driven company making a substantial investment in technology. Our engineering team is small, entrepreneurial, and actively embracing AI-assisted development.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Own meaningful technical initiatives from design through production.
  • Work directly with decision-makers with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Influence the architecture and operational foundations of a growing technology platform.
  • Build automated systems and guardrails that make engineers more productive.
  • Potentially grow into a permanent role as our technology organization expands.

We value practical problem-solvers who favor thoughtful, maintainable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

What Success Looks Like

At the end of the initial engagement, we expect to have materially improved our security posture, modernized important AWS infrastructure, advanced or completed our priority migrations, and established more consistent and efficient deployment and operating practices.

Just as importantly, the systems and processes you build should be well-documented, maintainable, and ready for our internal team to operate.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief description of one or two relevant projects you've personally led, particularly involving AWS migration, cloud security, or DevOps automation.

We're especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate hands-on ownership of complex production environments and sound engineering judgment.

About WorldVia

WorldVia Travel Group is a growing travel technology and services company serving thousands of independent travel advisors, travel entrepreneurs, and corporate travel clients.

We're investing heavily in our next generation of technology, including an integrated advisor operating platform, consumer travel applications, and AIVIA, our AI-powered workspace.

Our technology strategy centers on AWS, modern software development, automation, and AI. We're building a platform designed to transform how travel professionals operate their businesses.

Fotokite is the global category leader in actively tethered autonomous Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) platforms. Born as an ETH Zurich deep-tech spin-off with 22 granted patents, Fotokite combines autonomous robotics, un-jammable tethered station-keeping, and enterprise SaaS to deliver continuous 24/7 situational awareness.

With over 1,100 fielded systems dominating North American public safety, Fotokite is scaling its European commercial infrastructure.

Role Overview & Strategic Charter

We are seeking a high-caliber, battle-tested Director, US Defense & Federal Sales to own and scale Fotokite’s US Defense vertical.

This is a true Player-Coach role. You will take 100% ownership of our Defense Go-To-Market (GTM) engine—leading direct engagements with DoD contracting officers, building strategic alliances with major Defense Primes and navigating complex federal procurement pathways (IDIQs, OTAs, DLA, and Programs of Record).

The Strategic Gap You Will Bridge

Fotokite already possesses strong end-user field demonstration capabilities—our team can effectively put hardware in the hands of operators, tactical teams, and unit commanders in the field. The Fotokite team is seeking an expert who has demonstrated expertise in converting end-user demand into awarded contracts and scalable program line items. You will manage direct reports (including tactical field sales and solutions engineers) and provide the federal contracting expertise, procurement navigation, and C-suite Prime strategy required to win major defense business.

Core Responsibilities

1. Federal Contract Execution & Deal Closing (Player Focus)

  • Pipeline to Contract Conversion: Take direct ownership of closing high-value deals across all branches of the US Department of Defense (Army, Air Force, Navy, Marines, USCG, SOCOM, and National Guard).
  • Federal Procurement Mastery: Navigate FAR/DFARS regulations, Other Transaction Authorities (OTAs), Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR/STTR) transitions, and multi-year DoD budget cycles (POM).
  • Contract Vehicle Optimization: Weaponize pre-existing contract vehicles and prime channels—including DLA Prime Vendors, GSA Schedules, and established Primes' IDIQs—to shorten procurement cycles.

2. Strategic Defense Prime Alliances & Teaming

  • Prime Partnering: Architect formal teaming agreements, subcontracting arrangements, and technology integration partnerships with top-tier US Defense Primes.
  • Program of Record Integration: Position Fotokite’s tethered ISR technology as a required subsystem/payload inside larger Defense Programs of Record (e.g., base security, vehicle-mounted ISR, tactical MANET relays).

3. Team Leadership & Coaching (Coach Focus)

  • Manage & Mentor: Directly manage, mentor, and expand a focused team of Defense Account Executives and Federal Solutions Engineers.
  • Bridge Field Demos to Legal Ink: Guide field sales reps who excel at end-user tactical demos, providing them with the structural support, proposal oversight, and contracting strategy needed to turn field enthusiasm into signed Purchase Orders.
  • Operational Alignment: Work hand-in-hand with CRO and leadership to align US defense customer requirements with product development and manufacturing schedules.

4. Vertical Ownership & Executive Reporting

  • Vertical Strategy: Define and execute the multi-year US Defense GTM roadmap, maintaining full accountability for the vertical’s revenue, bookings, and pipeline velocity.
  • Capture Management: Lead high-stakes proposal efforts, RFP/RFI responses, and executive-level briefings for DoD program offices, Defense Innovation Units (DIU), and congressional/government affairs partners.

Candidate Qualifications & Requirements

  • 8–12+ Years of Proven US Federal / Defense Sales Experience: Demonstrated track record of personally closing $1M+ defense contracts and growing federal accounts within the US DoD and Intelligence Community.
  • Deep Federal Contracting Architecture: Master-level understanding of DoD procurement processes, FAR/DFARS compliance, IDIQs, DLA channels, FFP/CPFF contract types, and Defense budget mechanics.
  • Defense Prime Network: Active, established relationships with Business Development, Corporate Strategy, and CTO organizations across major Defense Primes.
  • Player-Coach Mindset: Willingness to directly write proposals, negotiate contract terms, and travel to customer sites, while simultaneously coaching and managing direct reports.
  • Military Veteran (Highly Preferred): US Military Veteran with operational experience or deep familiarity with tactical unmanned systems/ISR platforms is a major plus.
  • Security Clearance: Active US Security Clearance (Secret or Top Secret/SCI) or clearability is strongly preferred.
  • Mobility: Willingness to travel 30–40% for key DoD briefings, Prime partner syncs, major defense trade shows (AUSA, SOF Week, Sea Air Space), and corporate syncs.

We require that applicants already have permission to work in the US. We will not sponsor work-related visas now or in the future. Please include both a resume and cover letter. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

---

Department: GBTN

Location: Remote (Work from Home)

About GBTN

GBTN is a community of gamers who help shape the future of video games. We partner with developers to test unreleased and in-development titles from the comfort of our members' homes.

Our community is essential for testing multiplayer games, verifying online infrastructure, and providing critical feedback on the user experience. If you are passionate about gaming and want a behind-the-scenes look at how games are made, this is a perfect opportunity for you.

The Role: What You'll Do

As a GBTN Community Tester, you will be invited to participate in paid, "on-call" test sessions. This is a highly flexible role with no set hours—you participate when you are available for an invited session.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Participating in scheduled game tests using your own personal hardware (PC, console, mobile device, VR headset, etc.) and internet connection from the comfort of your home
  • Stress-testing multiplayer servers and online features.
  • Evaluating games for user experience (UX), gameplay feel, and balance.
  • Identifying and clearly reporting bugs, glitches, and other technical issues.
  • Providing detailed, constructive feedback through surveys and written reports.

Please Note: This is Not a Job

This is not a full-time or part-time position. It is a flexible, paid, on-call role.

  • You will be paid for the specific test sessions you are invited to and choose to participate in.
  • This is an ideal role for students, gaming enthusiasts, retirees, or anyone looking to earn extra income while contributing to the gaming industry.

Confidentiality is Critical

Due to the sensitive, pre-release nature of the projects you will test, all GBTN members are required to sign a strict Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).

  • You must not discuss any aspect of the tests, games, or materials with anyone outside of the GBTN program.
  • Breaching the NDA will result in immediate removal from the program and potential legal action.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking reliable, discreet, and passionate gamers to join our community.

Requirements:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Access to a stable, high-speed internet connection.
  • Own at least one gaming device (e.g., a PC, game console, mobile device, or VR headset).
  • Must be willing and able to sign and strictly adhere to our Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).

Nice-to-Haves (not required):

  • Previous experience in game testing or Quality Assurance (QA).
  • Familiarity with a wide variety of game genres.

Why Join GBTN?

  • Get Paid to Play: Earn money for participating in test sessions.
  • Ultimate Flexibility: Accept invitations that fit your schedule.
  • Behind-the-Scenes Access: Be one of the first people in the world to play unreleased games.

The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

The Granicus Local Sales Team is a dynamic, results-driven group charged with driving new revenue in a young and energized Cloud Vertical. Ours is a Team that values individual initiative as well as teamwork. What we do makes a difference. Our products and services improve the efficiency of government and the quality of people’s lives. The Enterprise Account Executive generates subscription sales for our SaaS platform and related services in an assigned territory.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Drive sales generation and foster market expansion within the designated territory.
  • Collaborate closely with the Marketing Team to ensure a robust lead pipeline and effective lead nurturing.
  • Craft and communicate compelling value propositions to prospective clients, highlighting the unique benefits of our solutions.

  • Lead pursuit teams for larger-scale opportunities, orchestrating efforts for comprehensive client engagement.
  • Guide and educate prospects through the purchasing journey, providing insights and assistance as needed.

  • Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews to Sales Management, Senior Management, and peers, providing comprehensive insights into sales performance and market trends.
  • Be prepared to travel up to 50% of the time to engage with clients and prospects effectively.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

  • 5+ years of Public Sector sales experience in IT, information services, or business services sold on a subscription model.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness selling through partners, resellers and/or integrators
  • Effective Prospecting and Opportunity Closure: Demonstrates a track record of successfully identifying and nurturing sales leads through both direct outreach and in-person engagements, culminating in the successful closure of opportunities.
  • Proficient in CRM Utilization: Proficiently utilizes customer relationship management software to efficiently track leads, manage opportunities, and streamline sales processes, ensuring effective follow-up and nurturing of prospects.
  • Adaptability in Fast-Paced Environments: Thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments, adept at managing multiple tasks and priorities under tight deadlines to maximize sales productivity and responsiveness to client needs.
  • Client-Centric Problem-Solving: Possesses a genuine passion for helping clients overcome challenges, employing exceptional problem-solving skills to tailor solutions that address their specific pain points and drive value.
  • Solution-Oriented Sales Approach: Executes sales processes within a solution-oriented framework, focusing on building strong relationships with clients and delivering persuasive oral and written communication to effectively communicate value propositions and drive sales outcomes.
  • Utilization of Technology for Sales Enhancement: Comfortable and experienced in leveraging technology tools and platforms to enhance sales effectiveness, utilizing digital resources to streamline processes, gather insights, and drive engagement with prospects.
  • Navigating Complex Sales Environments: Skilled in navigating committee-driven sales environments characterized by multiple stakeholders and decision-makers, adept at building consensus and overcoming objections to drive successful sales outcomes.
  • Influencing Abilities and Persuasive Communication: Capable of effectively persuading and influencing potential clients to consider our solutions, using compelling arguments and persuasive communication techniques to close deals.
  • Interpersonal Effectiveness and Collaborative Relationship-Building: Skilled in building strong, trust-based relationships with clients and internal teams alike, fostering collaboration and cooperation to drive successful sales outcomes.
  • Forward-Thinking and Strategic Mindset: Possesses a forward-thinking approach and strategic mindset, able to anticipate market trends and client needs to proactively tailor sales strategies for long-term success.
  • Strong Customer Orientation and Result Orientation: Demonstrates a deep commitment to understanding and meeting customer needs, coupled with a relentless focus on achieving sales targets and delivering measurable results
  • Business Acumen: Exhibits a strong understanding of business principles and market dynamics, leveraging this knowledge to identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and make informed decisions that contribute to sales growth and profitability.

Pay Range

USD $110,000.00 - USD $125,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Project Manager with a strong background in agile software development, client relationship management, and delivering complex software projects on time and within budget. The ideal candidate is a proactive leader who can independently manage multiple client engagements, anticipate risks, and guide teams toward successful outcomes.

This role requires 5+ years of software project management experience, including leading custom software development projects and working directly with clients and engineering teams. We are also looking for someone who embraces AI-powered tools and modern project management practices to improve efficiency, communication, and delivery outcomes.

SmartLogic is an experienced custom software development consultancy serving clients since 2005. We build custom web and mobile applications for organizations across a variety of industries. We are deeply committed to our team, our clients, and the communities where we work. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, accountability, and thoughtful adoption of emerging technologies.

This is a fully remote, ongoing contract position with a variable commitment of approximately 10–25 hours per week, depending on project needs.

Responsibilities

Our project teams are supported by a Project Manager, Staff Engineer, product designer, and one or more developers. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead project management for multiple client software development projects, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring successful delivery.
  • Partner with clients, stakeholders, and engineering teams to define project scope, requirements, priorities, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Lead agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Staff Engineers and developers to maintain actionable backlogs, develop user stories, establish acceptance criteria, and ensure development priorities align with client objectives.
  • Proactively manage project budgets, timelines, resource allocations, and scope changes while identifying risks and communicating mitigation strategies.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, requirements, roadmaps, status reports, and budget forecasts.
  • Support quality assurance efforts, coordinate testing and acceptance processes, and ensure deliverables meet client expectations.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with clients through clear communication, proactive problem-solving, and consistent delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing client engagements by understanding business objectives, anticipating future needs, and recommending valuable solutions.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools to improve project management workflows, including requirements documentation, meeting summaries, backlog refinement, reporting, and project analysis.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to identify opportunities for AI-assisted delivery while maintaining appropriate quality, accuracy, security, and human oversight.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of SmartLogic's project management practices, delivery processes, and operational efficiency.

Requirements

We are seeking a resourceful, organized, and proactive team player with strong interpersonal skills and a demonstrated ability to lead software projects independently. The successful candidate will be comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Additionally, the successful candidate will have:

  • 5+ years of professional software project management experience, preferably within a custom software development consultancy or agency.
  • Demonstrated success managing six-figure software development projects with varying team sizes, technical complexity, and client requirements.
  • Strong understanding of agile software development methodologies and experience managing projects from discovery and planning through development, testing, and launch.
  • Experience managing multiple client engagements simultaneously while maintaining accountability for budgets, schedules, scope, and delivery quality.
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Harvest, and similar platforms.
  • Experience developing project roadmaps, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, managing backlogs, tracking budgets, and coordinating quality assurance activities.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts, facilitate difficult conversations, manage expectations, and build trusted relationships.
  • Experience identifying project risks, managing scope changes, resolving delivery challenges, and holding project teams accountable for commitments.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, documentation, communication, or project management workflows, with an understanding of their limitations and the importance of validating AI-generated outputs.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently in a remote, collaborative environment.

Benefits

This is a fully remote contract position open to candidates based in the United States.

Compensation range for this position is $70-$85 per hour. Compensation is based on the applicant's experience and qualifications.

This position has flexible weekly hours based on project needs and your availability, which is currently estimated at 10-25 per week. You must be available during SmartLogic's core working hours of 10:00 AM–3:30 PM ET on weekdays, as some client and internal meetings occur during this window and your attendance may be required.

As a remote-first organization, SmartLogic works intentionally to build a supportive, collaborative culture. Contractors are encouraged to participate in relevant team meetings, knowledge-sharing opportunities, and professional development activities.

We value continuous learning, thoughtful experimentation, and the responsible use of emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen how we work and deliver value to our clients.
