raw.description:
Fotokite develops autonomous, high-endurance tethered unmanned aerial systems to help firefighters and public safety teams save lives.

Fotokite systems allow first responders to quickly and easily gain situational awareness after arriving at emergency scenes: our autonomous one-touch launch/land system makes operation simple and safe; the dual color and thermal camera payload provides situational awareness from the system’s aerial perspective; and actively tethered flight means the system can be flown without a certified pilot, and can be left flying for as long as the situation requires.

Fotokite is seeking a hands-on, high-impact Vice President of Customer Success to architect, build, and lead our global post-sales function from the ground up. Operating in a Player-Coach capacity, you will write the official Customer Success Playbook, implement the technical infrastructure and tracking tools, and directly manage key strategic accounts while scaling a high-performing team across North/South America and Europe.

You will bridge hardware logistics, software telemetry, and customer retention to transform post-sale operations into a predictable, high-margin revenue engine across public safety agencies, defense entities, OEMs, and enterprise security clients.

Key Responsibilities

1. Playbook Architecture & Standard Operating Procedures

  • Create the CS Playbook: Build the end-to-end Fotokite Customer Success Playbook from scratch, establishing standardized SOPs for Order Handoff, Technical Commissioning, Day 30 CSAT Audits, Day 90 QBRs, and Renewal Triggers.
  • Scale Repeatable Processes: Codify segment-specific onboarding and expansion workflows tailored to Firefighting, Law Enforcement, Defense, and Enterprise Security verticals across global regions.

2. Infrastructure, Tooling & Analytics Setup

  • Build the CS Tech Stack: Select, configure, and roll out customer health tracking platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or advanced CRM modules) and integrate them with hardware telemetry logs.
  • Establish Health Scoring & Dashboards: Develop real-time customer health dashboards tracking system flight hours, deployment frequency, software utilization, maintenance status, and churn risk indicators.

3. "Player-Coach" Team Leadership & Account Execution

  • Lead by Example (Player): Directly manage flagship enterprise, defense, and strategic municipal accounts; personally conduct high-stakes in-person QBRs, flight demos, and executive check-ins.
  • Scale the Global Team (Coach): Recruit, mentor, and manage regional Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Sales Engineers across the Americas and Europe, instilling a high-accountability, customer-centric culture.

4. Revenue Ownership: Retention, Expansion & Software Attach

  • Drive Account Expansion: Partner with Regional Sales Managers and Resellers to execute systematic fleet expansion campaigns, driving multi-unit orders and accessory upsells.
  • Monetize Software & Support: Own post-sale revenue for annual software subscriptions, cloud data streaming, software maintenance, and extended warranty/service attachments.

Key Qualifications

  • Player-Coach Mindset: Proven willingness to roll up your sleeves, write documentation, configure software tools, and manage customer accounts directly while building executive strategy.
  • Zero-to-One Infrastructure Builder: Direct experience selecting, setting up, and deploying CS tracking platforms, CRM health scoring, and customer telemetry dashboards from scratch.
  • Author of CS Playbooks: Demonstrated track record creating formal, scalable Customer Success Playbooks and SOPs in a hybrid Hardware-plus-SaaS, IoT, Robotics, Defense, or GovTech environment.
  • 5+ Years CS Leadership: Proven leadership experience building and scaling CS teams.
  • Revenue & P&L Accountability: Track record of direct ownership over gross retention, net expansion revenue, software attach rates, and service contract renewals

We require that applicants already have permission to work in the US. We will not sponsor work-related visas now or in the future. Please include both a resume and cover letter. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Our client is seeking a remote Senior AWS DevSecOps / Platform Engineer to help build, secure, and operate a mission-critical cloud platform supporting high-availability scientific and operational workloads.

This is a remote position for a senior, hands-on engineer who is comfortable owning production AWS infrastructure from Infrastructure as Code through deployment, validation, monitoring, and ongoing operations.

The environment is built around AWS, Amazon EKS, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, and GitOps, with a strong emphasis on automation, security, reliability, and federal compliance. Infrastructure changes are managed through code and automated pipelines rather than manual configuration.

The ideal candidate has deep hands-on experience with Terraform and AWS, has operated Kubernetes/EKS in production, and understands how to build secure delivery pipelines that can withstand both operational scrutiny and formal security reviews.

This is an opportunity to join a small, experienced engineering team where senior engineers have meaningful ownership and influence over platform architecture, security, automation, and engineering standards.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, maintain, and improve production AWS infrastructure across multiple environments.

  • Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules and Infrastructure as Code used to provision and manage cloud infrastructure.

  • Manage Terraform remote state and safely reconcile differences between deployed infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Operate and maintain production Amazon EKS environments, including cluster networking, autoscaling, add-ons, upgrades, workload identity, ingress, and load balancing.

  • Design and support Kubernetes workloads using Helm and modern container orchestration practices.

  • Build and maintain GitOps-based deployment workflows using Argo CD, Flux, or comparable technologies.

  • Develop and harden GitLab CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure and application delivery.

  • Integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, Infrastructure as Code scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, policy enforcement, and artifact validation.

  • Implement policy-as-code technologies such as OPA, Conftest, or comparable tools.

  • Support container supply-chain security, including image scanning, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), image signing, and deployment validation.

  • Design and maintain secure AWS identity and access patterns using IAM and workload identity technologies such as IRSA or EKS Pod Identity.

  • Design and support AWS networking, including VPCs, routing, load balancing, security boundaries, and cross-account connectivity.

  • Work with AWS services including EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, and related cloud technologies.

  • Support the development and evolution of multi-account AWS environments and federal landing-zone architectures.

  • Implement least-privilege access, network isolation, continuous monitoring, security controls, and other cloud-hardening practices.

  • Support federal cybersecurity requirements including NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, RMF, and Authority to Operate activities.

  • Develop and maintain technical evidence and documentation supporting security controls and compliance reviews.

  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability using technologies such as Amazon CloudWatch, Grafana, or comparable platforms.

  • Troubleshoot complex AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, networking, pipeline, security, and production infrastructure issues.

  • Mentor other engineers and help establish strong engineering practices around code review, change management, automation, testing, and technical documentation.

  • Collaborate with application developers, security teams, architects, and other technical stakeholders to deliver secure and reliable production services.

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, or a related discipline, including senior-level ownership of production environments.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, infrastructure lifecycle management, and remediation of configuration drift.

  • Strong hands-on AWS engineering experience supporting production workloads.

  • Experience with AWS networking, IAM, EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, and related cloud services.

  • Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes and Amazon EKS in production, not simply deploying applications to an existing cluster.

  • Experience with Kubernetes networking, autoscaling, workload identity, Helm, ingress, load balancing, and cluster lifecycle management.

  • Hands-on experience implementing GitOps using Argo CD, Flux, or a comparable platform.

  • Experience engineering CI/CD pipelines, with GitLab CI/CD strongly preferred.

  • Experience implementing DevSecOps controls such as SAST, container scanning, Infrastructure as Code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code.

  • Strong experience with Git-based development and infrastructure workflows, including merge requests, peer review, and controlled production changes.

  • Experience supporting secure, highly available cloud infrastructure.

  • Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks such as FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and RMF, including familiarity with requirements supporting an Authority to Operate.

  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

  • Ability to mentor engineers and provide senior technical leadership.

  • U.S. Person with the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating multi-account AWS environments, AWS Organizations, Control Tower, or federal cloud landing zones.

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or FedRAMP environments.

  • Experience implementing container supply-chain security, including SBOMs, image signing, admission controls, or AWS Signer.

  • Experience with CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, or comparable observability technologies.

  • Experience with Docker and secure container build practices.

  • Experience with serverless AWS technologies such as Lambda.

  • Experience with real-time or event-driven data-processing architectures.

  • AWS certification such as Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Developer.

  • Experience supporting scientific, environmental, geospatial, weather, or other data-intensive mission systems.

  • Familiarity with scientific data formats such as NetCDF or GRIB.

Work Environment

  • This position is remote.

  • No routine on-site requirement is expected.

Security / Eligibility Requirements

  • U.S. Person.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

raw.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.
raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

description: The Lawyering Project is excited to launch our search for an experienced strategic planning partner to facilitate the development of our 2028-2033 strategic plan.

raw.title: Strategic Planning Consultant
raw.excerpt: The Lawyering Project is excited to launch our search for an experienced strategic planning partner to facilitate the development of our 2028-2033 strategic plan.
raw.description:
The Lawyering Project is excited to launch our search for an experienced strategic planning partner to facilitate the development of our 2028-2033 strategic plan. This engagement will take place during February – July 2027 and the consultant will report to the Lawyering Project’s Executive Team.

Organizational Background

Founded in 2017, the Lawyering Project is a legal advocacy organization that blends traditional impact litigation with movement lawyering to promote reproductive health, rights, and justice throughout the United States. We have an all-remote staff that includes 24 full-time employees spread across the United States.

Laws that undermine reproductive health, rights, and justice deprive people of moral agency, rob us of control over our bodies, and compound other forms of oppression like racism, sexism, and poverty. Our mission is to eliminate these laws and the harmful impacts they have on people’s lives. We are especially focused on laws that limit the availability or affordability of abortion care; contribute to disparities in reproductive health outcomes; embody gender-based stereotypes; or discriminate against people based on their reproductive decisions.

We envision a society with laws that enable each of us to make decisions about intensely personal matters like sex, pregnancy, family, and healthcare based on our own beliefs and values, and ensure that we all have access to safe pregnancy care, safe abortion care, and safe communities for our families.

More information about the Lawyering Project is available on our website.

Project Background

Since its inception nearly a decade ago, the Lawyering Project has undergone significant growth in its staff size, programming, and overall organizational capacity, all while operating in a volatile political and legal landscape. We understand that, to realize our long-term vision for reproductive health, rights, and justice, we must continually assess our organizational strategy and impact. Energized by the organization’s growth, the exciting work being done by our clients and partners, and the growing need for legal services by those seeking, providing, and supporting abortion care, we are embarking on a strategic planning process to coincide with our tenth anniversary. Our goal for this process is to bring our creative, partner-driven approach to lawyering to bear on the challenges facing the repro movement nearly five years after the fall of Roe.

Project Scope of Work

  1. Design a process for the development of a five-year strategic plan that includes the following:
    • Robustly engaging with the Lawyering Project’s Board of Directors and staff;
    • Gathering input from key external stakeholders including clients, partners, and funders;
    • Evaluating the impact of the Lawyering Project’s current programs;
    • Assessing the strengths and weaknesses of the Lawyering Project's current operations; and
    • Providing the Lawyering Project’s Executive Team with periodic opportunities to review progress and offer feedback.
  2. Guide the Lawyering Project through the strategic planning process, taking the lead on meeting facilitation and data collection.
  3. Use the information and insights gathered to create a five-year strategic plan.
  4. Assist the Executive Team in creating metrics to assess progress under the strategic plan.

Requirements

Desired Consultant Expertise and Qualifications

  • Proven expertise in strategic planning for nonprofit organizations. Experience working with legal advocacy organizations is a plus.
  • Proven knowledge of the U.S. reproductive health, rights, and justice movement.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate group discussions and build alignment among stakeholders with differing perspectives.
  • Strong project management skills, especially the ability to complete deliverables on time and according to specifications.
  • Demonstrated commitment to JEDI (Justice, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion) and social justice.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills and readiness to work with a group of committed, talented, and enthusiastic individuals.

Budget

We are seeking bids of up to $40,000 for the entire project.

Submission Requirements

To apply, please submit the following materials by December 18, 2026:

  • A concise proposal detailing your approach to the project
  • An updated CV or resume
  • At least two client references from strategic planning projects
  • Any additional supporting materials that you would like us to consider

Our goal is to engage a consultant by January 31, 2027, and begin work on the project in early February.

National Campaigns Director

Overview

The Campaigns Director will lead Justice Democrats’ efforts to ensure our endorsed candidates win their races, and support our efforts to recruit the next generation of progressive leaders in Congress.

This includes leading the Campaign’s Department, overseeing staff within the department, managing collaboration with other departments. You will work closely with our staff, and the teams of our endorsed candidates to ensure our candidates hit their goals.

The ideal Applicant has high emotional intelligence and communication skills, is able to build trusting relationships with a wide array of individuals, the instinct to lean into productive conflict, and a well-rounded background across campaign departments. This is a dynamic role, and critically important for JD headed into the 2028 election cycle and beyond.

The Campaigns Director reports to Hodari Williams, the Executive Director.

This position will begin in January 2027, the application deadline is November 23rd 2026.

Responsibilities

Winning Campaigns (60%)

  • Managing and supporting the Campaign team to provide detailed, high-quality support to our endorsed campaigns.
  • Work with all Justice Democrats Directors to ensure their departments are engaged and supported to work with our campaigns, bringing their expertise and perspective.
  • Keeping the entire Justice Democrats staff updated on key information and needs from each campaign.
  • Support the team to recruit and hire skilled teams of staff and consultants for each of our campaigns
  • As needed, maintain close, meaningful relationships with key campaign staff, consultants, and firms to ensure the success of our campaigns.
  • Proactively look for ways each of our campaigns can scale and improve their progress towards goals.
  • Work with JD’s own staff to ensure we are providing the best services possible in helping our campaigns hit their goals.
  • Travel to campaigns as needed to provide direct support.

Candidate Recruitment and Endorsement (20%)

  • Support the Candidate Recruitment Manager in the recruitment and endorsement process.
  • Bring your perspective and expertise to the recruitment and endorsement process.
  • During the peak of recruitment, dedicate a portion of your time to conducting district research and identifying potential nominees.

Departmental Management and Cross-Departmental Collaboration (20%)

  • Manage the Campaigns Department to ensure that our goals are being met, and the team is getting the support that is needed.
  • Planning and facilitating campaign department meetings and retreats
  • Participating in the director’s team of the organization, giving input and bringing reflections to inform our long-term goals.
  • Ensuring the full team are kept informed of the work in the campaigns department, and facilitating cross-departmental collaboration as needed.
  • Supporting fundraising as needed from a campaigns department perspective.
  • Other organizational leadership work as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 2-4 cycles of campaign experience and/or other commensurate organizing and management experience
  • A demonstrated commitment to racial and economic justice, and a clear understanding of national political dynamics in the US.
  • Can connect with others and quickly build trust with staff, potential nominees, our endorsed candidates, and their staff.
  • Strong management skills, including project management, setting work plans, supporting staff in hitting their goals, and giving feedback.
  • Able to recognize where campaigns are struggling and figure out how to support them
  • Able to work between internal and external stakeholders to coordinate that support to the campaigns.
  • Deep understanding of the challenges confronting candidates and campaign leadership teams
  • Familiarity with campaign management, field, political, communications, data, finance, and digital aspects of campaigns
  • Awareness of national & local political dynamics and skills to adapt strategies to fit those dynamics
  • Ability to prioritize, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and manage others to do the same. Have the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and resolve complex issues and competing needs under pressure.
  • Ability to communicate consistently and effectively through written and verbal updates to political and organizational partners, staff, and volunteers
  • Experience managing political relationships
  • Ability to turn complex/abstract goals into monthly, weekly, and daily priorities, and to hold yourself accountable to achieving them
  • Possess broad and/or working knowledge of campaign fundraising and paid media strategy
  • Helpful to have deep knowledge of technical campaign skills - VAN, FEC compliance
  • Ability to operate well in a high-pressure environment

Location

We are a fully remote organization. Anywhere in the US is fine.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

Salary & Benefits

  • $90,500 annual salary
  • This is a fully remote position, with some travel
  • Unlimited vacation with a 2 week minimum, all federal holidays off, and the organization is closed the final week of the year
  • Unlimited sick days
  • Fully paid Health, Vision, Dental (including dependents)
  • 401K and 4% employer match
  • Raise every two years

raw.description:
Help us build the Polish market from the ground up

RealAdvisor is launching in Poland — and we're looking for ambitious Sales Partners to help us build this market from day one.

This is a unique opportunity to join us at an early stage of our Polish expansion, with a huge amount of room to grow and significant commercial opportunities ahead.

RealAdvisor is one of Europe's leading digital platforms in the real estate ecosystem. Founded in Switzerland, we currently support 5,000+ real estate agencies and reach more than 10 million users every year across Europe.

We are now expanding into Poland and are looking for freelance Sales Partners who know how to turn commercial opportunities into customers.

You don't need previous experience in real estate — we'll train you on the product and the market.

What we do need is a proven track record in sales and, above all, the ability to close deals.

The opportunity

Poland is a newly launched market for RealAdvisor, which means there is a lot to build — and a lot of opportunity for the people joining us early.

You won't be stepping into a mature market with an established sales structure. You'll have the opportunity to help shape our commercial presence in Poland, build relationships with customers, generate business and grow alongside the market.

Our goal is to build a high-performing sales team capable of reaching at least 15 sales per month per Sales Partner.

For top performers, our commission structure offers the potential to earn €20,000+ per month, depending on results. We already have colleagues consistently earning €30,000+ per month.

The principle is simple:

The more you sell, the more you earn.

Your role

You'll be responsible for the full sales cycle, from the first contact all the way through to signing the contract.

We're not looking for people who only specialise in prospecting or only run demos. We're looking for full-cycle sales professionals who can independently manage a sales process from beginning to end.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Outbound prospecting and generating your own opportunities
  • Managing inbound leads
  • Managing qualified appointments provided by our SDR team
  • Qualifying prospects
  • Conducting sales demos via video call
  • Understanding customer needs
  • Presenting the solution and value proposition
  • Handling objections
  • Negotiating
  • Structured follow-ups
  • Preparing and managing contracts
  • Closing deals
  • Managing your entire pipeline in the CRM

In short: from first contact to signed contract.

A high-intensity sales role

We want to be transparent about the pace and expectations of the role.

You should expect approximately 5 demos per day, generally via video calls lasting around 20–40 minutes.

On top of demos, you'll be responsible for prospecting, follow-ups, negotiations, pipeline management and all the activities required to turn opportunities into closed deals.

A significant portion of your appointments will be generated by our SDR team, but we also expect our Sales Partners to be capable of creating their own opportunities and taking ownership of the entire sales process.

Requirements

What we offer

  • €20,000+ monthly earning potential for high performers
  • Colleagues already consistently earning €30,000+ per month
  • A highly performance-driven commission structure
  • Qualified appointments provided by our SDR team
  • The opportunity to generate your own pipeline
  • Full training on our product and the real estate industry
  • The opportunity to join a newly launched Polish market
  • Significant room for growth as the market develops
  • The opportunity to help shape our Polish sales operation from an early stage
  • Long-term freelance partnership
  • Continuous support from an international team
  • Opportunities to progress into senior and leadership roles

Who we're looking for

Previous experience in real estate is not required.

What matters is proven sales experience.

We're looking for people who:

  • Have previous experience in sales
  • Have experience with outbound sales
  • Are comfortable conducting sales demos
  • Know how to handle objections and negotiate
  • Have experience closing contracts
  • Know how to manage structured follow-ups
  • Are comfortable working with targets and KPIs
  • Have a strong results-oriented mindset
  • Are autonomous, organised and disciplined
  • Have an entrepreneurial mindset
  • Have experience using CRM systems
  • Are native or fluent Polish speakers
  • Are comfortable communicating professionally in English

We're not simply looking for a salesperson.

We're looking for a closer.

Someone who knows how to manage a pipeline, handle a high volume of demos, create value, overcome objections and take a deal all the way to signature.

If you've already proven that you can sell and you're looking for an environment where your performance has a direct impact on your earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

Why join now?

Because Poland is just getting started.

We're launching this market now, which means you'll be joining at a stage where there is a lot to build and a lot of opportunity to capture.

For ambitious sales professionals, this is a chance to get in early, establish yourself in a new market and grow together with the business.

If you want to be one of the people helping build RealAdvisor's presence in Poland from the ground up, this is the moment to join.

Type of collaboration

Freelance / self-employed

A Polish business registration / ability to invoice is required, or you must be willing to set one up.

Expected commitment: at least 35 hours per week.

Compensation is primarily performance-based, through commissions generated from sales. Your earning potential is directly linked to the results you achieve.

Ready to build the Polish market with us?

The ideal candidate is someone who can take complex or information-heavy content and turn it into polished, professional, easy-to-understand visual communication. Strong corporate and B2B design experience is particularly important for this role.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

The Testing Strategy Manager (TSM) leads the development and execution of a comprehensive testing strategy for the Peraton CMS Fee‑for‑Service (FFS) healthcare program. This role focuses on advancing Agile testing practices, expanding test automation, and improving overall quality outcomes across three large, complex, mainframe‑based systems. The TSM collaborates closely with account leadership, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders to drive quality excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement a holistic testing strategy aligned with Agile/DevOps methodologies and prioritizing automation across all testing phases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test schedules across hardware and software platforms.
  • Define and communicate requirements for test environments, test data, and test cycles, collaborating with Infrastructure/Data Center teams.
  • Ensure adequate testing coverage prior to production releases and support production checkout planning through risk identification and mitigation.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of 10–15 technical and business analyst resources, including performance monitoring and annual evaluations.
  • Provide technical leadership to Testing Engineers and promote a culture of collaboration, growth, and quality-minded thinking.

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Develop and champion strategies for increasing automation across the program, including test data automation approaches.
  • Implement and refine processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, productivity, and reduce redundancy.
  • Assist in establishing and measuring quality metrics to support process adoption and continuous improvement.

Risk, Defect, and Quality Management

  • Identify and communicate risks related to testing strategies, ensuring clear visibility into business impacts.
  • Analyze defects to support triage, drive resolution, and determine technical and business impacts.
  • Support and participate in design reviews, requirement walk‑throughs, quality assessments, and post‑release reviews.
  • Administer the problem management process, monitoring and reporting on problem resolution activities.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work with account and program leadership to align testing strategy with system roadmaps, transformation efforts, and software development priorities.
  • Collaborate with Release PMs, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Technical Leads on implementation planning and issue resolution.
  • Participate in requirements/user story reviews to ensure clarity, feasibility, and testability.

Strategic Insight & Recommendations

  • Provide recommendations on tools, technologies, and testing practices to improve efficiency and quality outcomes.
  • Help shape Quality Assurance policies, goals, and objectives in partnership with QA leadership.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • 10+ years of combined experience in software testing, automation, technical analysis, and business analysis.
  • 5+ years managing teams of 10+ resources.
  • Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
  • CMS contract experience preferred.

Knowledge & Skills – Must have

  • Experience developing use cases, process flows, and related documentation.
  • Expertise in automated testing practices and tools, including TestRail, Open Text UFT, MS Scheduler, and WFTP Script Editor/Debugger.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and working with Confluence and Jira.
  • Strong relationship‑building abilities across QA, business, and technical teams.
  • Excellent analytical, diagnostic, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Knowledge of mainframe testing and Automated testing.
  • Demonstrated success implementing test automation within Agile/DevOps environments.
  • Ability to translate between business and technical concepts and work independently or within distributed teams.
  • Proven ability to exercise sound judgment and influence teams toward common goals.

Knowledge & Skills – Nice to have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of testing within mid-tier and cloud environments desired.
  • Mid‑tier and cloud testing experience desired.
  • Knowledge of AI Testing tools and Methodologies desired.
  • Prior CMS or Federal Government contract experience desired.
  • Prior health insurance experience desired.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Intermediate Accountant

Compensation range: $2,000 AUD - $2,800 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: The client is an Australian-focused professional accounting and business support organisation that works with businesses across different industries. Their team provides bookkeeping, payroll, financial reporting and broader accounting support, with a strong focus on accuracy, accountability, efficiency and professional client service. The business offers exposure to a range of Australian clients and opportunities to develop skills across end-to-end accounting and financial management.

Role Overview: We are looking for a capable and detail-oriented Intermediate Accountant to support Australian businesses with a broad range of accounting and payroll functions. This is a hands-on role covering end-to-end bookkeeping, general ledger accounting, balance sheet reconciliations, payroll processing, month-end reporting and financial analysis.

You will work across potentially multiple Australian clients and will be expected to take ownership of your work, investigate discrepancies, manage competing priorities and deliver accurate work within agreed deadlines. Previous Australian accounting experience is preferred but not essential, with training and ongoing support provided in Australian accounting systems, payroll procedures and reporting requirements.

Ultimately, we are looking for someone with a strong accounting foundation, the right attitude and the potential to develop into a dependable, well-rounded accounting professional.

Note: Performance will be assessed against agreed KPIs, including accuracy, timeliness, productivity, accountability, quality of work and client communication.

Formal performance and remuneration reviews will take place every four months. Any remuneration adjustment will be performance-based and subject to business requirements, rather than automatic.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end bookkeeping and accounting for assigned Australian clients
  • Maintain accurate general ledger records and process accounts payable and receivable
  • Perform bank, credit card, merchant and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Prepare and maintain accruals, prepayments, fixed asset, loan, payroll and other accounting schedules
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies, unusual balances and incorrectly recorded transactions
  • Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports, including P&L, Balance Sheet and budget vs actual reports
  • Assist with cash flow monitoring, management reporting and financial analysis
  • Process monthly journals and support accurate and timely month-end close
  • Process weekly, fortnightly or monthly Australian payroll, including leave, deductions, reimbursements and final pay
  • Reconcile payroll liabilities, PAYG, superannuation and related accounts
  • Assist with STP reporting, payroll-related BAS/IAS reconciliations and other compliance activities as required
  • Communicate directly with Australian clients regarding accounting, bookkeeping and payroll queries
  • Follow up missing information, provide work updates and proactively raise issues
  • Assist with accounting system implementations, process improvements, reporting templates and automation
  • Support other finance and accounting activities as required
  • The position involves end-to-end bookkeeping, accounting, payroll, balance sheet reconciliations, weekly and monthly financial reporting, and client liaison.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant accounting experience
  • Strong experience in end-to-end bookkeeping and general ledger accounting
  • Practical experience preparing and reviewing balance sheet reconciliations
  • Experience preparing monthly financial statements and management reports
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and double-entry bookkeeping
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Experience with cloud-based accounting software
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
  • Ability to consistently meet reporting and processing deadlines
  • Willingness to handle a broad range of accounting and payroll responsibilities
  • Strong accounting fundamentals, initiative, accountability, attention to detail, communication and a willingness to learn are essential.
  • Must be comfortable handling multiple responsibilities, working independently and meeting agreed deadlines.

Highly Desirable:

  • Australian accounting or bookkeeping experience

Who The Client Is: An irrigation design and supply business delivering tailored irrigation solutions across a range of residential, commercial, and recreational environments. Our expertise covers everything from private residential landscapes to large-scale commercial developments, sports turf, golf courses, and council-managed reserves and streetscapes.

Role Overview: An experienced irrigation designer to join our design team full-time and remotely, working with our Adelaide-based team.

The role covers producing irrigation design drawings and documentation in AutoCAD/IrrigationFX/Irrisketch, consistent with our design style, and administering projects and CRM records in our business software. It suits someone who works independently to deadlines, communicates clearly in writing and on Microsoft Teams calls, and takes ownership of both design output and the admin that supports it.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Produce and edit irrigation design drawings in AutoCAD/IrrigationFX to our standards
  • Develop system layouts and hydraulic designs, and select appropriate products for each design
  • Size tanks and pumps (e.g. Grundfos) to suit system requirements
  • Prepare supporting documentation, including bills of materials and product schedules (where required)
  • Administer our CRM, projects and timesheet records in our business software — maintaining opportunities, projects and tasks, and keeping data accurate
  • Interpret written briefs, markups and design instructions from the Client/Adelaide team
  • Communicate progress clearly and meet deadlines with minimal supervision

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience as an irrigation designer, with a solid understanding of design principles, hydraulics and system layout
  • Sound product knowledge of major irrigation brands (e.g. Hunter, Rain Bird, Toro, Netafim), including selecting appropriate products and equivalents
  • AutoCAD proficiency — confident producing and editing drawings independently
  • Microsoft Product proficiency
  • Strong written and spoken English — clear communication in writing and on Microsoft Teams calls, and the ability to interpret written briefs and markups
  • Competence administering projects and records in a CRM and project management system
  • Well-organised and self-managing, able to work to deadlines remotely with minimal supervision
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-office setup including hardware required for the role (only software licenses will be provided by the employer)

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Advanced experience in IrrigationFX (Especially data base setup)
  • Prior experience with Odoo (CRM and project modules)

Ideal Profile

  • A self-directed, experienced irrigation designer who combines strong technical design skills with genuine administrative discipline — someone who takes pride in accurate drawings and well-maintained project records.
  • Work confidently on their own, communicate clearly in writing and on calls across a time difference, and can be trusted to keep work moving without close supervision.
  • Comfortable learning new tools like Odoo, and motivated to be a dependable, long-term part of our high-output design team.

This is a remote role that will be set up via an Employer of Record (EOR) service.

It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. raw.description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Clinical Trial Manager at Worldwide


As a Senior Clinical Trial Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in leading clinical site management activities that help bring innovative therapies to patients who need them most. Your leadership will directly support the successful execution of clinical trials, ensuring quality, efficiency, and excellence from study start-up through closeout.


Working closely with sponsors, CRAs, and cross-functional project teams, you'll serve as a key strategic partner responsible for driving clinical monitoring activities and delivering high-quality outcomes. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact while guiding teams through complex clinical research programs in a collaborative, patient-focused environment.

At Worldwide, you'll join a values-driven culture where leaders work alongside their teams and where every clinical trial is approached with the care, urgency, and commitment patients deserve.


Where You'll Work

This is a remote role open to candidates based in United States. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.

Travel up to 25% is required to support study and site management activities.

What You'll Do


  • Lead and provide direction to Clinical Research Associates and site management team members throughout the full study lifecycle.
  • Serve as the primary Site Management representative for clinical monitoring and site activities across assigned projects.
  • Act as a key sponsor-facing contact, building strong partnerships and ensuring effective communication throughout study execution.
  • Oversee monitoring deliverables to support study objectives, quality expectations, and budget requirements.
  • Identify and manage out-of-scope activities while proactively communicating potential impacts and solutions.
  • Drive collaboration across cross-functional teams to ensure consistent execution of clinical site management activities.
  • Support high-quality study conduct by providing leadership, guidance, and operational oversight to project teams.

What You'll Bring


  • Bachelor’s Degree or Nursing Degree, plus 2+ years of experience as a Clinical Trial Manager, Clinical Operations Leader, Clinical Trial Lead, or equivalent role.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%; valid passport required.
  • Required experience supporting Internal Medicineclinical trials (IMID, Cardio Metabolic, Rare Disease).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and support remote teams.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us on LinkedIn.


At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace by providing transparent compensation.

The salary range for this position is annually (For hourly paid positions, the stated salary range reflects hourly rates):


United States of America - $112,000.00 - $222,000.00

The salary range provided is intended to give candidates an understanding of potential earnings. Compensation will fall within the provided range, and it not a guarantee of exact salary. The final salary will be determined based on relevant experience, performance, education, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage.


Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, military status, or other class protected by applicable law.

raw.title: Business Development Representative
raw.excerpt: YOUR MISSIONNulogy is seeking an energetic, coachable, and curious individual to join our growing marketing team as a Business Development Representative.
raw.description:
YOUR MISSION

Nulogy is seeking an energetic, coachable, and curious individual to join our growing marketing team as a Business Development Representative. This role provides an exciting entry point into the world of sales and marketing within a leading software company. You'll gain hands-on experience in identifying potential leads, initiating early-stage outreach, and contributing to the success of demand generation campaigns. This position is ideal for someone early in their career who is eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support outbound outreach efforts through email, phone, and social media to identify and engage potential prospects.
  • Assist in researching target accounts, industry trends, and key decision-makers.
    Help qualify inbound leads from web inquiries, events, and campaigns.
  • Work with the BDR to prepare outreach materials and follow-up messages.
  • Support logistics and follow-ups for virtual and in-person events.
  • Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions and lead status in Salesforce.
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales to refine messaging and lead generation strategies.

EXPERIENCE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • 0–1 years of experience in a sales, marketing, or customer-facing role (internship or part-time experience welcome).
  • Familiarity with or interest in CRM and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated, with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
  • Interest in the SaaS, tech, supply chain, or logistics industries.
  • Comfortable making phone calls and engaging with new people.
  • Team-oriented and open to feedback.
  • Ability to multitask and manage time efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Nulogy is a manufacturing technology company driven by a vision to make life better for the people who plan, produce, and deliver the products we use every day.
Nulogy’s Manufacturing Operating System helps manufacturers and packagers automate every stage of the production process—from inventory to quality—which reduces operating costs, increases efficiency, and boosts customer satisfaction. Hundreds of manufacturing sites around the world are powered by Nulogy, and our software also runs in the networks of world-leading brands such as Colgate-Palmolive, L’Oréal, and Procter & Gamble.

Nulogy has grown rapidly over the last decade, and we are proud to be recognized with a number of awards including: Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers, Food Logistics Top 100 Software Provider, and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Culture. Nulogy has also received multiple awards for company culture, the most recent being one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for 2024, Great Place to Work 2025 & Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2025.

By joining Nulogy, you’ll become part of a fantastic culture of capable and motivated individuals. You’ll also join a team that is solving challenging problems every day with the potential to make a global impact.

OUR VALUES
1. We put people first
We lead with genuine care, build strong relationships, and create space for people to grow.
2. We rewrite the playbook
We don’t wait for perfect conditions. We move, deliver, and refine, solving problems creatively as we go.
3. We learn up
We stay curious, learn from the people and experiences around us, and keep looking ahead.
4. We take the hot potato!
When something goes wrong, we don’t pass the problem along. We take ownership and work together to solve it.
5. We ring the bell together
We celebrate success as a team and recognize the people who helped make it happen.

WHY NULOGY
We’re solving problems that no one has been able to solve before. This is an opportunity to join a team that is transforming the way that supply chains are structured.

Competitive benefits package: Group benefit plans including health, dental, and vision that start on day one—benefit premiums are fully paid by the employer; Parental leave: 100% top-up for 15 weeks for any parent of biological or adopted children; Flexible paid vacation policy; RRSP Matching Program, 401K program.


FULLY REMOTE
Everyone is set up with the tools and resources required to stay connected and help employees do their best work.

Nulogy embraces diversity, and we recognize the need for teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We encourage everyone to apply.

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented HR Assistant to support our HR Manager in day-to-day HR operations, including payroll administration, HR systems management, internal communications, and compliance reporting.   • Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow through on tasks
  • Friendly, resourceful communicator who knows when to escalate issues
  • Comfortable handling repetitive tasks, shifting priorities, and managing a to-do list style workflow

HR Operations & Administration

  • Enter and verify timekeeping data from Square into Paylocity
  • Support weekly and monthly payroll processing
  • Troubleshoot employee timecard issues and reset Paylocity login credentials
  • Generate reports and maintain historical data for HR and compliance audits
  • Organize and maintain HR documents in Google Drive

Employee Support

  • Monitor Slack and email for HR inquiries and triage or escalate as appropriate
  • Provide light weekend support for urgent inquiries (approx. 2-3 per weekend)

Communications & Job Postings

  • Draft and build job descriptions
  • Post job openings on Indeed and other recruitment platforms
  • Monitor and update job listings regularly
  • Coordinate candidate phone screen scheduling with Susanne based on screener responses
  • Publish internal HR newsletters and communications

Performance & Planning Support

  • Track employee performance management timelines
  • Assist with logistics for senior leadership events and HR initiatives
  • Support upcoming strategic planning cycles

Work Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week
  • Tuesday & Wednesday: No work
  • Monday & Thursday: 6 hours each, 1:00 PM 7:00 PM PST (some flexibility)
  • Friday: 8 hours, 9:00 AM 5:00 PM PST (no flexibility; fixed schedule)

raw.description:
About:

Are you always ahead of the latest social media trends and passionate about brand storytelling? At Vanguard College Prep, we are seeking a detail-oriented Social Media Content Coordinator to manage and elevate our digital presence across all social channels. In this role, you will plan, create, and schedule daily engaging content across all our social channels. You will craft eye-catching visual and video assets, manage community interactions, and analyze post performance to drive measurable growth and engagement while fostering meaningful connections with our online community.

Compensation:

  • Starting Compensation: $16.00 – $19.00 depending on education, experience, and skill.
    • Work from home, occasional commute
    • Flexible Schedule
    • Career growth opportunities

What You’ll Do:

  1. Content Creation & Curation

  • Short-Form Video Production: Script, film, and edit vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts using mobile editors like CapCut or desktop tools like Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Graphic & Visual Asset Design: Create static graphics, carousel posts, infographics, and story assets using Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator.
  • Copywriting: Draft engaging captions, call-to-actions (CTAs), video scripts, and post copy tailored to each platform's distinct tone and audience.
  • Brand Voice Maintenance: Ensure all visual design choices, messaging, and tone strictly follow established brand guidelines.

  1. Planning & Scheduling

  • Editorial Calendar Management: Build and maintain weekly/monthly content calendars aligned with product launches, marketing campaigns, and seasonal events.
  • Content Scheduling: Upload and schedule posts across platforms (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Youtube) using scheduling platforms
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with internal teams as needed to gather assets and information for upcoming posts.

  1. Community Management

  • Active Daily Engagement: Monitor active feeds and inbox messages daily to respond to comments, direct messages (DMs), and mentions.
  • UGC Curation: Identify user-generated content (UGC), engage with creators, and coordinate permissions to repurpose high-performing posts that apply to our brand.
  • Customer Support Routing: Flag customer complaints, technical issues, or public relations risks appearing on social channels and route them to support or leadership teams.

  1. Analytics & Reporting

  • Analytics & Reporting: Track key performance indicators (KPIs)—reach, impressions, engagement rates, follower growth, click-throughs, and conversions—and compile regular performance reports with actionable insights to optimize strategy.
  • Trend Identification: Research viral audio clips, trending video formats, and emerging platform features to pitch timely content opportunities.
  • Competitor & Industry Monitoring: Benchmark channel performance against industry trends and key industry competitors to refine publishing schedules and post styles.

Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • Work Experience: A minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience managing social media accounts, producing digital content, and/or coordinating organic social campaigns for a brand, business, or agency.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to write clear, engaging post copy, short hooks, and clear calls-to-action (CTAs) that match a brand’s specific voice and tone.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to read social media platform insights (engagement rate, reach, impressions, click-throughs) and turn metrics into actionable content adjustments.
  • Work Setup: Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional, distraction-free workspace suitable for video content production
  • Tech Proficiency: Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, social media platforms for posting content, and video editing platforms such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop etc.

The ideal candidate will also possess:

  • The ability to work both independently and in a team environment
  • Excellent content creation and editing skills
  • Ability to create growth in the number of followers across all platforms
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities to be able to meet content posting goals and create content when viral trends emerge
  • Manage multiple deadlines and content pipelines simultaneously
  • Experience with meeting social media related goals set by organizations
  • Ability to optimize post captions, alt text, and video metadata for social search engines using strategic keywords.

Why Work With Us?

  • Meaningful Impact: You will be able to provide the opportunity for more students to be able to use our services through social media reach
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for leadership and long-term career growth
  • Elite Peer Network: Join a tight-knit team that shares resources, celebrates wins, and supports each other through ongoing professional development and mentorship. Quickly-growing start-up environment that emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and mentorship.
  • Fully Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the autonomy of working from home with regular team collaboration and support.
  • Comprehensive Paid Onboarding: We invest heavily in your success with structured training covering our academic frameworks, objection handling, and marketing strategies.

About Us:

Vanguard College Prep is dedicated to equipping students with the strategic tools, expert test preparation, and personalized college counseling needed to confidently navigate an increasingly complex admissions system. As the education industry rapidly evolves, we are expanding our reach to ensure as many families as possible can access our top-tier programs and empower their students to reach their full potential. Our mission is to serve our community by creating future leaders that will revolutionize their respective fields.

Salary: $16 – $19 / hour

raw.description:
Our client is seeking a remote Senior Enterprise Applications Analyst – Microsoft 365 & SharePoint to serve as a senior technical resource supporting enterprise business applications, data platforms, and Microsoft 365 technologies in a remote work environment.

This is a hands-on role focused on administering, configuring, integrating, and improving SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, CRM, SaaS, automation, and emerging AI technologies.

An immediate priority will be supporting the configuration of HubSpot and the migration of existing business data from SharePoint Lists into the platform. This will include analyzing existing data structures, developing field mappings and transformation rules, cleansing and validating data, and ensuring information is accurately reconciled following migration.

The ideal candidate combines deep SharePoint and Microsoft 365 expertise with strong data, integration, automation, and business-systems experience. You should be comfortable working across both technical and business teams, translating requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.

Success in this role means improving the quality, accessibility, governance, and usability of enterprise information while helping business teams make better use of Microsoft 365, SaaS, automation, CRM, and AI-enabled technologies.

What You Will Do

Responsibilities

Title: PBS Reporting Analyst

Location: Fountain Valley

Department: Physician Billing

Status: Full-time

Shift: DAYS (Predominantly Remote)

Pay Range: $30.65/hr – $44.45/hr

MemorialCare is a nonprofit integrated health system that includes four leading hospitals, award-winning medical groups – consisting of over 200 sites of care, and more than 2,000 physicians throughout Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

Purpose Statement / Position Summary

The PBS Reporting Analyst plays a vital role in analyzing and interpreting patient billing, claims, reimbursement, and revenue cycle performance data to provide insights that support informed decision-making and enhance strategic initiatives. This position develops and maintains financial reports, dashboards, scorecards, data visualizations, and actionable insights to effectively present findings to leadership and key stakeholders. The role monitors key performance indicators, identifies revenue trends, variances, denials, underpayments, workflow errors, and potential revenue leakage, and recommends data-driven process improvements to support timely reimbursement, revenue integrity, compliance, and operational performance. The position ensures data accuracy and integrity across reporting processes, utilizes business intelligence tools to streamline data analysis and reporting, and remains current on industry best practices and emerging trends in data analysis and visualization. The position collaborates closely with billing, coding, finance, IT, clinical operations, and application teams to support reporting accuracy, system optimization, and alignment with payer requirements and regulatory standards.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities of the Job

  • Provide professional and courteous service to all customers, communicate effectively in written and verbal form, and interact in a positive and constructive manner.
  • Maintain complete patient and employer confidentiality at all times in accordance with company and HIPAA requirements. Perform job functions in accordance with current departmental and company standards, policies, procedures, and directives.
  • Demonstrate teamwork by assisting coworkers with tasks and training as directed, and attend and participate in mandatory meetings.
  • Accommodate changes in departmental workload, prioritize responsibilities, multitask effectively, and use initiative to resolve problems with appropriate action and follow-through.
  • Keep the Director informed when problems may interfere with timely completion of work.
  • Maintain a clean, well-organized, properly stocked, and secure work area.
  • Be at work and be on time.
  • If approved for remote or hybrid work, adhere to all remote work agreement requirements, including maintaining productivity, responsiveness, confidentiality, secure handling of organizational and patient information, availability during scheduled work hours, and compliance with departmental expectations and applicable policies.
  • Follow company policies, procedures and directives
  • Interact in a positive and constructive manner
  • Prioritize and multitask

    • *Placement in the pay range is based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant years of experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, there may be additional compensation available for this role, including but not limited to, shift differentials, extra shift incentives, and bonus opportunities. Health and wellness is our passion at MemorialCare—that includes taking good care of employees and their dependents. We offer high quality health insurance plan options, so you can select the best choice for your family. And there’s more...Check out our MemorialCare Benefits for more information about our Benefits and Rewards.

    Qualifications

    Experience

  • Minimum ten (10) years of experience in patient account billing and collections, including at least five (5) years of analytical and reporting experience in healthcare revenue cycle billing, claims processing, reimbursement, medical billing, healthcare financial analytics, or related business services.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare revenue cycle operations, including patient billing, collections, claims submission, payment posting, denials, accounts receivable, reimbursement, charge capture, insurance clearinghouses, HCFA-1500 forms, 835/837 EDI files, CPT/ICD-10 coding, payer requirements, regulatory requirements, contract terms, and healthcare audit guidelines.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, SQL, database management tools, billing systems, EHR systems, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience with Python or other data manipulation tools preferred.
  • Experience designing queries, manipulating large volumes of data, validating data accuracy, and transforming complex revenue cycle information into clear reports, dashboards, visualizations, and leadership presentations.
  • Knowledge of EHR and billing applications such as Epic, NextGen, QNXT, or comparable healthcare information systems preferred, including experience extracting and analyzing data from Epic Clarity, Resolute, Cogito, or equivalent reporting environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze trends, identify root causes, recommend corrective actions, and support workflow optimization or process improvement initiatives; Lean or Six Sigma experience is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and trend identification skills, with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in data analysis, reporting, validation, and presentation of findings.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including good listening skills and the ability to translate complex technical, financial, and cross-platform data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to manage multiple projects effectively and work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.

    • Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, Health Informatics, Finance, Data Analytics, or Business Intelligence, Statistics, or a related field preferred.
  • Relevant certifications in data analytics or business intelligence, preferred.

    • Pay Range

    USD $30.65 - USD $44.45 /Hr.

Position Overview

The Legal Intake Specialist plays a pivotal role as the first step in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. This position ensures that every request is accurate, complete, and optimized for downstream success. The precision and quality of the intake process directly influence the speed and accuracy of medical record retrieval for law firm clients.

1. Provider Research & Identification

  • Identify all relevant healthcare providers involved in a clients treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.
