3. Request Assignment

  • Assign requests to the appropriate records team members based on workload balance and utilization metrics.

4. Handling Special Cases

  • Identify and escalate special provider requirements (e.g., unique forms or protocols) to the assigned Client Success Manager (CSM).
  • Resolve missing, unclear, or conflicting information by liaising with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

  • Experience: Prior hands-on experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of law firms.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy; even small mistakes can cause delays of several months.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat and other PDF editing/combining tools.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

The Candidate Recruitment Manager will primarily help lead JD’s efforts to recruit the next generation of progressive leaders in Congress. Secondarily, this role will also support our campaigns. The Candidate Recruitment Manager will work cycle round to ensure JD is recruiting transformational leaders with strong paths to victory for current and upcoming election cycles. This includes leading on district targeting, outreach and our JD nomination and endorsement process.. The ideal candidate has high emotional intelligence and communication skills, is able to build trusting relationships with a wide array of individuals, the instinct to lean into productive conflict, and a well-rounded background across campaign departments.

The Candidate Recruitment Manager reports to Alexandra Rojas, the Senior Advisor.

This position will begin in January 2027, the application deadline is November 23rd 2026.

Responsibilities

Recruitment and Endorsement (80%)

  • Manage our candidate nomination and vetting process, modifying and updating it each cycle to be as powerful as possible
  • Manage district research, targeting and polling to ensure we are focusing our recruitment it the most strategic districts.
  • Own our district outreach planning and manage all staff to participate in the candidate recruitment process as appropriate
  • Conduct district outreach, having in-depth conversations with community leaders to power map communities and identify potential nominees.
  • Directly manage incoming nominations.
  • Ensure all candidate recruitment efforts are systematized and well tracked internally.
  • Manage relevant external partners, consultants and volunteers to get the most out of their work towards candidate recruitment
  • Work in collaboration with the Campaigns Director to plan and debrief the Candidate Recruitment process.
  • Hold national and local political relationships and leverage them to find transformational candidates for JD

Winning Campaigns (20%)

  • Support on challenger races in high impact ways like managing and monitoring budgets, key plans and coaching staff.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of political campaign, electoral organizing, or progressive movement experience, including at least 1 electoral cycle in a campaign, political, or field role.
  • Demonstrated track record of community-level relationship building and coalition work. Able to listen deeply, map out local political landscapes, and identify community leaders.
  • Comfort working with voter data, district-level demographic data, and synthesizing basic research or poll summaries for decision-makers.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to build and maintain strong relationships, communicate effectively, and move through tension/disagreements productively.
  • Comfort leaning into direct, sensitive conversations. Able to ask probing questions during candidate vetting, navigate delicate political dynamics, and deliver candid evaluations to leadership.
  • Highly organized project manager who excels at maintaining pipeline tracking, coordinating schedules, and ensuring no potential nominee falls through the cracks.
  • Ability to turn complex/abstract goals into monthly, weekly, and daily priorities, and to hold yourself accountable to achieving them

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on challenger or progressive primary campaigns.

HR Assistant (100% Remote)
Support our HR Manager in payroll, HR systems, communications, and reporting

Please apply through this application link:

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented HR Assistant to support our HR Manager in day-to-day HR operations, including payroll administration, HR systems management, internal communications, and compliance reporting. The ideal candidate will have strong familiarity with HR platforms and a sharp eye for accuracy when handling payroll data, timecard issues, and compliance reports.

You will also serve as the primary point of contact for routine HR inquiries when the HR Manager is unavailable, helping keep the HR team organized, responsive, and efficient.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong working knowledge of online timekeeping platforms
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow through on tasks
  • Friendly, resourceful communicator who knows when to escalate issues
  • Comfortable handling repetitive tasks, shifting priorities, and managing a to-do list style workflow
  • Able to work independently during off-hours or with minimal supervision
  • Bonus: Experience supporting in-person leadership events or insurance-related HR administration

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations & Administration

  • Enter and verify timekeeping data from Square into Paylocity
  • Support weekly and monthly payroll processing
  • Troubleshoot employee timecard issues and reset Paylocity login credentials
  • Generate reports and maintain historical data for HR and compliance audits
  • Organize and maintain HR documents in Google Drive

Employee Support

  • Monitor Slack and email for HR inquiries and triage or escalate as appropriate
  • Provide light weekend support for urgent inquiries (approx. 2-3 per weekend)
  • Escalate complex employee relations issues to the HR Manager

Communications & Job Postings

  • Draft and build job descriptions
  • Post job openings on Indeed and other recruitment platforms
  • Monitor and update job listings regularly
  • Coordinate candidate phone screen scheduling with Susanne based on screener responses
  • Publish internal HR newsletters and communications

Performance & Planning Support

  • Track employee performance management timelines
  • Assist with logistics for senior leadership events and HR initiatives
  • Support upcoming strategic planning cycles

Work Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week
  • Tuesday & Wednesday: No work
  • Monday & Thursday: 6 hours each, 1:00 PM 7:00 PM PST (some flexibility)
  • Friday: 8 hours, 9:00 AM 5:00 PM PST (no flexibility; fixed schedule)
  • Saturday & Sunday: 4 hours each, 9:00 AM 1:00 PM PST (some flexibility)

raw.title: Teach English From Home with YiYi
raw.excerpt: Teach English Online!  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing • Long-term employment only!
raw.description:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

raw.description:
Overview

MemorialCare is a nonprofit integrated health system that includes four leading hospitals, award-winning medical groups – consisting of over 200 sites of care, and more than 2,000 physicians throughout Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

Responsibilities

Title: Patient Account Biller Senior

Location: Fountain Valley

Department: Patient Accounting

Status: Full-time/Predominantly Remote

Shift: Days (8hr shifts)

Pay Range: $25.98/hr - $37.67/hr

At MemorialCare Health System, we believe in providing extraordinary healthcare to our communities and an exceptional working environment for our employees. Memorial Care stands for excellence in healthcare. Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

Purpose Statement / Position Summary

Medicare Biller, Senior is responsible for all Medicare billing of accounts to Fiscal Intermediary (FISS) to ensure that PFS is capturing all revenues as timely, efficiently, and accurately as possible. The Medicare Biller, Senior utilizes many complex and varying regulations, guidelines, and systems to perform Medicare billing functions. Proactively works with Fiscal Intermediary, patients and in-house resources to identify and resolve issues that delay account billing. Works under the supervision of management performing all tasks related to hospital reimbursement.

This position offers you the opportunity to work from home (WFH)

Essential Functions and Responsibilities of the Job

1. Ability to utilize patient billing software in performance of job functions.

2. Ability to accurately and timely request documentation needed from other departments to complete the billing process.

3. Ability to apply working knowledge of coding for accurate, timely billing reimbursement.

4. Demonstrates appropriate follow-up necessary resulting in expedient payment of billed charges.

5. Ability to recognize, share and apply knowledge of state and federal regulations in Medicare billing activities.

6. Able to be at work and on time, follow organization rules and procedures and directions from a Coordinator/Lead or other member of the Management staff.

7. At all times, provides professional and exceptional customer service and sets an example when interacting with all customers.

8. Able to adhere to all confidentiality policies and procedures and carries out all tasks in a pleasant and respectful manner.

9. Ability to make suggestions for and initiate enhancements throughout the department and continually seeks opportunities to improve current policies, procedures and practices.

10. Able to recognize and perform essential duties and offers assistance to others or performs other required tasks when own assignments are completed. Performs other duties as assigned by management.

11. Ability to use critical thinking while reviewing Medicare billing and collection notes in the financial computer system to ensure that the appropriate action is taken within the billing and collection process and to ensure correct hospital reimbursement.

*Placement in the pay range is based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant years of experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, there may be additional compensation available for this role, including but not limited to, shift differentials, extra shift incentives, and bonus opportunities. Health and wellness is our passion at MemorialCare—that includes taking good care of employees and their dependents. We offer high quality health insurance plan options, so you can select the best choice for your family. And there’s more...Check out our MemorialCare Benefits for more information about our Benefits and Rewards.

Qualifications

Experience

Minimum 2 years Acute Care In-Patient and Out-Patient Medicare Hospital Billing experience. (required)

Understanding of Medicare insurance Billing processes (required)

Excellent interpersonal skills

Positive work ethics

Bi-lingual preferred

Knowledge of medical terminology and coding, preferred.

Written and verbal communication skills to meet productivity standards.

Microsoft Office and Outlook experience

Education

High School diploma, GED equivalent, preferred.

Hospital billing courses, preferred.

Pay Range

USD $25.98 - USD $37.67 /Hr.

raw.excerpt: Our Client is a long-established and highly-regarded Central and Eastern European technology provider specialising in designing, building, and operating advanced, mission-critical software solutions for large international organisations.
raw.description:
Our Client is a long-established and highly-regarded Central and Eastern European technology provider specialising in designing, building, and operating advanced, mission-critical software solutions for large international organisations. With over 25 years of history and a team of 600+ top-tier software engineers across Europe, they are a certified partner for high-stakes industries including Aerospace & Defence, Automotive, Telecommunications, and Financial Services. They hold rigorous quality and security certifications such as NATO AQAP and TISAX.

This specific role involves working with a leading European client to develop and maintain their sophisticated cloud platform. You will be responsible for defining the DevOps architecture and strategy for solutions built primarily on Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes. You will be a key player in ensuring that highly available, scalable, and secure cloud-native architectures are implemented, managing the full lifecycle from Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development through to CI/CD and observability. This is a chance to apply your senior expertise to complex, enterprise-grade cloud environments.

Responsibilities

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end automation, deployment, and operational excellence of cloud-native systems. Your key duties will include:

  • Cloud Architecture & Strategy: Design and implement highly available, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure architectures utilising Microsoft Azure services, including AKS, VNETs, Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall, Key Vault, and Azure Application Gateway.
  • Infrastructure Automation (IaC): Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using tools like Terraform or ARM Templates to provision and manage cloud resources in a repeatable and consistent manner.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Ownership: Design, implement, and optimise robust CI/CD pipelines (e.g., using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI) for both application deployment and infrastructure changes.
  • Kubernetes Management: Administer, secure, and optimise Kubernetes clusters (preferably AKS), focusing on networking, scaling, security hardening, and performance tuning.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Azure Monitor/Log Analytics to maintain platform health and identify issues proactively.
  • Security and Compliance: Enforce security best practices, implement policies (e.g., Azure Policies), and ensure all deployments comply with industry standards and internal IT security requirements.
  • Collaboration & Mentoring: Work closely with development, security, and product teams to define requirements, troubleshoot complex production issues, and mentor junior team members on DevOps methodologies and tools.

Requirements

  • Senior Experience: At least 5+ years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Engineering role, with a focus on enterprise-scale solutions.
  • Azure Mastery: Proven, in-depth expertise in designing, deploying, and managing complex infrastructure on the Microsoft Azure platform.
  • Kubernetes Expertise: Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes (K8s), including cluster operations, networking, security, and using tools like Helm or Kustomize.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Strong hands-on experience with Terraform or equivalent IaC tools (e.g., ARM Templates, Bicep).
  • CI/CD Proficiency: Demonstrable experience in building and managing modern CI/CD automation pipelines using technologies such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
  • Scripting and Automation: Solid scripting skills in languages such as Bash, Python, or PowerShell for task automation and system configuration.
  • Networking Fundamentals: Excellent understanding of cloud networking concepts, including VNETs, network security groups (NSG), load balancing, and private connectivity.
  • Communication: Fluent professional English (written and spoken) and excellent collaboration skills in a remote, cross-functional team setting.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with advanced Azure services for data or AI/ML workloads (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning).
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools like Ansible.
  • Experience with FinOps or cloud cost optimisation strategies.

Our Client Offers

Our Client is committed to supporting your professional journey with a competitive package designed for growth, flexibility, and well-being.

  • 100% Remote Work Option within Europe, providing ultimate work-life flexibility.
  • Flexible Working Hours and a hybrid work model, supported by modern office hubs across Europe.
  • Personalised Development Program and access to dedicated mentorship and coaching from domain experts to accelerate your career growth.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package, including additional health insurance and food vouchers.
  • The chance to take full ownership and make a tangible impact on mission-critical, cloud-native solutions.
  • A supportive, collaborative team culture with regular social events and team-building activities.

Do you need more information? Contact us directly

raw.excerpt: DescriptionAbout Sygnia Sygnia is a premier cyber technology and services company providing high-impact incident response, cyber resilience consulting, and threat hunting for leading organizations across the globe.
raw.description:
Description

About Sygnia

Sygnia is a premier cyber technology and services company providing high-impact incident response, cyber resilience consulting, and threat hunting for leading organizations across the globe. Trusted by Fortune 100 companies and government entities alike, Sygnia draws its strength from a team of elite professionals with backgrounds in military-grade cyber operations and the global cybersecurity industry.

Sygnia is rapidly expanding its presence in the United States, growing our incident response capabilities and client base across key industries. Joining now means playing a formative role in shaping our U.S. operations while benefiting from the backing and expertise of an established global leader.

The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Incident Response Expert to join our elite global team. In this role, you will lead and participate in complex forensic investigations and incident response engagements involving sophisticated cyberattacks, ransomware events, and nation-state activity. Your expertise will play a critical role in helping Sygnia’s clients understand, contain, and recover from cyber incidents while preserving business continuity and mitigating risk.

What You’ll Do

  • Work with a team to conduct end-to-end forensic investigations, including log analysis, host and network forensics, malware triage, and memory analysis.
  • Support response efforts for major cybersecurity incidents, collaborating closely with internal and external security and IT teams.
  • Perform threat hunting activities in client environments to detect and eliminate advanced persistent threats.
  • Identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) using frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Analyze a wide variety of data sources (endpoint, network, SIEM, etc.) to build a clear picture of the attacker’s actions and impact.
  • Leverage and contribute to Sygnia’s internal investigation tools, playbooks, and threat intelligence platforms.
  • Communicate investigation results effectively to both technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Develop and present high-quality technical reports, timelines, and strategic recommendations to clients.
  • Support the continuous improvement of internal methodologies, tooling, and knowledge sharing within the team.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in incident response, digital forensics, threat hunting, or cyber investigations—whether from the private sector, military, or government.
  • Deep technical understanding of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS), file systems, registry and memory structures, and log analysis.
  • Proficiency in network fundamentals and common protocols (DNS, HTTP/S, SMB, etc.) and network traffic analysis (e.g., PCAP review).
  • Experience with tools such as EnCase, X-Ways, FTK, Velociraptor, Splunk, or Wireshark, and EDR platforms like CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Microsoft Defender.
  • Competency in scripting or automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to support investigations.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and related forensic techniques is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly convey complex technical topics to diverse audiences.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure in time-sensitive environments.
  • Willingness to travel.

Bonus Points For

  • Industry-recognized certifications (e.g., GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, GCIA, GREM, CISSP).
  • Experience responding to ransomware, business email compromise (BEC), and advanced threat actor incidents.
  • Experience presenting findings to legal counsel, regulators, or board-level stakeholders.
  • Multilingual skills and experience in multinational or cross-cultural environments.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; or equivalent education or training in cybersecurity

Why Sygnia

  • Be part of Sygnia’s continued growth in the U.S., with opportunities to influence how we scale our team, capabilities, and operations in a rapidly expanding market.
  • Work with some of the best minds in cybersecurity on the world’s most high-impact cases.
  • Operate in a fast-paced, elite-tier environment where your technical expertise is trusted and valued.
  • Take part in meaningful, challenging work that directly shapes the outcomes for Fortune 500 organizations.
  • Grow your career while staying hands-on in incident response and mentoring a highly capable team.

raw.title: Product Director, Public Sector
raw.excerpt: The Role Unit4 supports hundreds of public sector organizations across the UK, Netherlands, the Nordics, and similarly managed geographies - municipalities, local authorities, agencies, non-department public bodies, and emergency services.
raw.description:
The Role

Unit4 supports hundreds of public sector organizations across the UK, Netherlands, the Nordics, and similarly managed geographies - municipalities, local authorities, agencies, non-department public bodies, and emergency services. These organizations operate under a persistent double constraint: budgets that do not grow and teams that are stretched thin, often without the dedicated technology capacity that private-sector counterparts take for granted. The gap between what they are expected to deliver for communities and what their current systems enable them to do keeps widening. As Product Director for Public Sector, you own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap that helps close that gap.

This is not a policy advisory role. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build vertical depth that makes Unit4 genuinely competitive for local government and specialist agencies. You will work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure the platform delivers end-to-end across finance, HR, procurement, and operations, but the vertical product strategy and roadmap are yours.

The right person has built enterprise software for public sector organizations - municipalities, local authorities, agencies, or emergency services. You understand what public finance management looks like from the inside, what compliance and audit obligations demand in practice, and you have shipped features that public sector finance and operations teams actually use.

AI presents a genuine opportunity for public sector organizations: automating administrative burden, accelerating compliance processes, and providing better insight for decision-making. But these are not commercial organizations free to move fast and iterate. They are stewards of public funds, citizen data, and community trust, operating under transparency and security obligations that set a higher bar. This role exists to ensure Unit4's public sector roadmap is complete, balanced, and innovative without being reckless: a portfolio that earns the confidence of government buyers and gives public servants more time to focus on what they are there to do - building stronger communities.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Public Sector product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.

  • Lead a prioritized product backlog with dedicated engineering capacity - defining outcomes, success metrics, release plans, and quality criteria.

  • Own feature outcomes, not just delivery — define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.

  • Serve as the internal authority on the Public Sector vertical, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.

  • Translate deep sector knowledge into specific, investment-backed product requirements: problem statements, opportunity sizing, and build-vs-partner decisions.

  • Define industry-specific solution blueprints, reference configurations, and pre-built templates that reduce implementation time for public sector customers.

  • Work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure public sector requirements are reflected in platform investment across finance, HR, procurement, and operations.

  • Partner with the Industry Growth Director on launch readiness, pricing, packaging, and field enablement.

  • Engage directly with strategic customers and the Public Sector Industry Board to validate roadmap direction, co-innovate, and capture outcome evidence.

  • Ensure regulatory, security, accessibility, and localisation requirements across our supported geographies are systematically reflected in the roadmap.

  • Monitor the competitive landscape - know what Civica, Visma, Centric, CGI, and others are shipping and what it means for Unit4's positioning.

  • Work with partners to extend the value proposition for public sector customers.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven product management experience building enterprise software - ERP or enterprise SaaS - for public sector organizations, particularly municipalities, local authorities, or specialist agencies. You have shipped products used by public sector finance and operations teams, not just consulted for them.

  • Deep knowledge of public finance management, public sector accounting, and government budgeting practices.

  • Solid understanding of public procurement frameworks and how they translate into practical ERP requirements - from approval workflows and audit trails to supplier management and contract compliance.

  • Understanding of the security, data residency, and audit expectations of government buyers and what that means for cloud ERP product decisions.

  • A clear point of view on how AI can responsibly empower public sector organizations - balancing real opportunity for efficiency and insight with the accountability, transparency, and security obligations these organizations carry.

  • Commercial orientation: you understand how product decisions drive ARR, win rate, and customer retention.

  • Strong communication skills at Head of Finance, Head of ICT, and senior public service leadership level.

  • Experience in product management for enterprise SaaS platforms. 

  • Deep understanding of professional services business models, including project-based delivery, utilization, billing, scheduling and compliance. 

  • Strong ability to influence without authority and work cross-functionally in a matrixed environment. 

  • Proven ability to translate complex industry needs into scalable product solutions. 

  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills. 

 

Desirable Experience 

  • Experience with ERP or PSA platforms  

  • Familiarity with mid-market services firms and their operational challenges. 

  • Familiarity with in AI-driven or data-rich product environments. 

Who we are?

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.

We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated. We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

What we offer

  • a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
  • balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
  • growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
  • talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
  • a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
  • a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Our commitment to equity

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

  • Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
  • Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

This role may require security clearance required for customer projects and access to sensitive (customer) data. That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries though – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your info safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!

Meet Unit4. With over 40 years of heritage, we’re an agile, fast growing, Cloud company that is on a mission to redefine Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for mid-market people-centric organisations.

With our innovative, self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high-value work.

At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose: Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters. — A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.

We’re shaping how work should feel, and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need - it's what makes us unique.

raw.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Portworx by Everpure is the leading global solution for unlocking the potential of Kubernetes by unlocking the power of data at enterprise scale. Portworx is a cloud native platform that enterprises depend on to reduce the cost and complexity of rapidly deploying containerized applications across multiple clouds and on-prem environments. By providing a single standard that works across the environment, we reduce the operating cost of kubernetes, unlock more use cases, respond and pivot to changes due to economic, regulatory and/or business impacts and make it easier to modernize applications, delight developers, and deliver innovation.

Via Portworx, you can manage any database or stateful service on any infrastructure using any container scheduler. You get a single data management layer for all of your stateful services, no matter where they run. And we thrive in multi-cloud environments.

SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE…

We are looking for a highly motivated, persistent, polished and entrepreneurial Account Executive to focus on finding/nurturing/closing deals related to Portworx and our Everpure Cloud offerings.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

  • Grow a territory and manage deals from land to expand, doing account planning/selling across our Enterprise, Commercial, Corporate and US SLED segments
  • Work through partners and with co-sellers in order to drive new business opportunities
  • Understand prospect and customer use-cases in order to drive new business
  • Plan and manage the relationships at both the strategic and operational level
  • Evaluate new opportunities and present recommendations to the management team
  • Conduct competitive and market intelligence sessions for customers
  • Work closely with the rest of the Portworx and Everpure Cloud sales/pre-sales/SDR and engineering teams
  • Give enablement sessions both 1:1 and 1:many in order to spread the word on Portworx and Everpure Cloud
  • Leverage all available documentation, best practices, knowledge-base articles and other vehicles to assist customers

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO BRING TO THIS ROLE:

  • 10+ years experience in selling enterprise software and subscription software, building 3-4x pipeline and exceeding annual quota.
  • A basic technical understanding of the enterprise software, container, cloud native, and storage domains
  • Ability to present Portworx and Everpure Cloud’s unique value propositions, products, vision, strategy, and road map
  • Excellent interpersonal skills including written and oral communication, able to build relationships easily and deepen them over time
  • Avid hunter with proven prospecting skills, consistently opening doors to new customers and navigating seamlessly between the boardroom and the data center while passionately positioning the advantages of a Portworx and/or Everpure Cloud solutions
  • Authenticity and a genuine desire to engage customers and understand their business challenges
  • Thought leadership, creativity and a challenger mindset; the ability to apply your customer insights and expertise in technology solutions to position Everpure’s portfolio to solve persistent problems
  • Ability to assess, plan, and actively manage a territory to achieve maximum revenue and efficiency
  • Expertise leading a complex sales process with multiple stakeholders, while fostering teamwork and shared ownership internally with Everpure co-sellers and with Partners
  • Consistent track record of exceeding quota and driving referenceable business
  • Passionate about post-sales customer success

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

The annual base salary range is:
$130,000—$208,000 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

raw.description:
Description

About Sygnia

Sygnia is a global cyber readiness and response team that helps organizations beat attackers and stay secure. We combine creative thinking, deep technical expertise, and battle-tested experience to strengthen cyber resilience and guide organizations through high-pressure situations. Our specialists come from elite military technology units and leading roles across the cybersecurity industry. We support clients at every stage of their security journey and bring the mindset, tools, and experience needed to help them stay ahead of evolving threats.

The Role

Sygnia is looking for a Client Partner, Manager in the United States to win new enterprise clients across North America as part of our Sales team. This is a sales-focused, client-facing individual contributor role responsible for converting qualified opportunities into signed business, building new client relationships, and generating revenue.

You will receive qualified opportunities generated primarily through Sygnia's business development, marketing, and partner channels, and lead them from qualification through close. You will own a defined revenue target and be accountable for converting qualified opportunities into signed business and consistently delivering against your target.

This role is focused primarily on acquiring new clients, with selective responsibility for expansion after the initial sale. During the first six months of each new client relationship, you will lead commercial expansion, identify follow-on opportunities, and support an orderly transition to the long-term account owner.

What You’ll Do

  • Convert qualified opportunities into signed new-logo business, with responsibility for achieving a defined revenue target.
  • Own the sales process from qualification through discovery, scoping, proposal development, negotiation, and close.
  • Manage a portfolio of qualified opportunities with the discipline needed to improve win rate and increase the number of closed-won opportunities.
  • Build relationships with technical, security, business, and executive stakeholders, establishing credibility and creating a strong foundation for a long-term client relationship.
  • Work closely with Sygnia's technical and engagement teams to understand client challenges, shape relevant solutions, and bring the right expertise into each opportunity.
  • Develop and maintain clear opportunity plans, including stakeholder maps, decision criteria, competitive considerations, next steps, and realistic forecasts.
  • Lead client meetings, workshops, and presentations that advance opportunities and demonstrate the relevance of Sygnia's cybersecurity capabilities.
  • Coordinate the commercial transition from sales into delivery, ensuring that client expectations, commitments, and relationship context are communicated clearly to the engagement team.
  • Own commercial expansion during the first six months of each new client relationship, identifying follow-on needs and developing additional opportunities before transitioning the account.
  • Collaborate across Sygnia's matrix organization and with business development, marketing, and partner teams to maintain momentum and progress opportunities toward close.
  • Contribute market, buyer, and competitive insights that strengthen Sygnia's sales approach, messaging, and go-to-market priorities.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven track record of converting qualified opportunities into new-logo revenue, ideally within cybersecurity consulting, professional services, or a related technology environment.
  • Seven to ten years of professional experience, including significant experience in client-facing sales, business development, consulting, or cybersecurity services.
  • Strong sales mindset with a demonstrated ability to advance qualified opportunities, navigate complex buying environments, negotiate effectively, and close business.
  • Strong client service orientation, with the ability to build credibility and trust quickly with technical, business, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand complex cybersecurity challenges and translate them into relevant business outcomes and service opportunities.
  • Disciplined opportunity management skills, including the ability to manage multiple pursuits, maintain momentum, and provide realistic forecasts.
  • Proactive, independent, and hands-on working style with the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving and high-pressure environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong presentation and negotiation capabilities.
  • Experience working in a matrixed organization and collaborating across multiple teams and geographies.
  • Positive, adaptable mindset with the ability to learn quickly and navigate changing client and market needs.
  • Ability to travel within the United States approximately 20 percent of the time, primarily for client meetings, relationship development, and industry events.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience selling cybersecurity consulting, incident response, managed security, or other complex cybersecurity services.
  • Experience winning large enterprise clients and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes.
  • Existing relationships with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and other senior security and technology leaders.
  • Experience selling into Fortune 1000 or other large enterprise organizations.
  • Familiarity with incident response, cyber resilience, security assessments, or other professional cybersecurity services.
  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, C-CISO, or GSTRT.

Why Sygnia

Sygnia offers the opportunity to work alongside some of the most experienced cybersecurity professionals in the industry and engage directly with organizations facing complex security challenges. In this role, you will have a direct impact on Sygnia's growth in North America by winning new clients and building the foundation for trusted, long-term relationships with senior security leaders.

You will work across a highly experienced team of cybersecurity consultants, incident responders, business development professionals, and security specialists, giving you the opportunity to deepen your cybersecurity expertise while building a strong network of senior client relationships.

Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met interne stakeholders en externe partners in een omgeving waar modernisering, cloudadoptie en verbetering van delivery centraal staan.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • De productvisie en roadmap voor de tooling uitwerken en uitvoeren.
  • Strategische doelstellingen omzetten naar concrete teamdoelen en prioriteiten.
  • De product backlog beheren, verfijnen en prioriteren.
  • Instaan voor kwaliteit, operationele stabiliteit en continue verbetering van de oplevering.

Position Overview

The Legal Intake Specialist plays a pivotal role as the first step in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. This position ensures that every request is accurate, complete, and optimized for downstream success. The precision and quality of the intake process directly influence the speed and accuracy of medical record retrieval for law firm clients.

Key Responsibilities

1. Provider Research & Identification

  • Identify all relevant healthcare providers involved in a clients treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.
  • Research and locate billing providers and related entities using tools such as Chartswap, historical request data, and direct provider outreach.
  • Accurately input all identified providers into the admin application.

2. Request Creation & Quality Control

  • Review incoming ROIs (Release of Information forms), correcting incomplete or inaccurate submissions (noting that ~90% require adjustments).
  • Prepare accurate base forms before generating submission packets.
  • Conduct comprehensive quality assurance checks on each ROI packet, verifying inclusion of all required details such as cover letters, affidavits, and other documentation.

3. Request Assignment

  • Assign requests to the appropriate records team members based on workload balance and utilization metrics.

4. Handling Special Cases

  • Identify and escalate special provider requirements (e.g., unique forms or protocols) to the assigned Client Success Manager (CSM).
  • Resolve missing, unclear, or conflicting information by liaising with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

  • Experience: Prior hands-on experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of law firms.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy; even small mistakes can cause delays of several months.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat and other PDF editing/combining tools.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

MANAGING DIRECTOR

OVERVIEW

Justice Democrats seeks a talented, committed leader to serve as Managing Director. This position is responsible for managing our staff and organizational structure; supporting the Executive Director; building and maintaining coordination and alignment across departments, projects and areas of work; and problem-solving major gaps in our organizational capacity to achieve our goals.

The Managing Director will remain grounded in day to day operations while also driving forward our long-term vision by supporting staff at all levels and ensuring that our resources are properly aligned to achieve our outcomes. They will optimize our work across the organizations to keep us as healthy and effective as possible.

The Managing Director reports to Hodari Williams, the Executive Director.

This position will begin in January 2027, the application deadline is November 19th 2026.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Drive long-term vision

  • Work with the Executive Director and Directors team to ensure we have clear short and long term goals, and that these are clear and communicated to staff.
  • Work with Directors team to ensure alignment between different departments in long term strategy and daily operations
  • Ensure alignment between different departments in long term strategy and daily operations
  • Identify short or long term strategic gaps or problems and work with the Executive Director and Directors team to solve them
  • Lead the planning and implementation of the annual staff retreat.

Serve as core support person to the Executive Director:

  • Work with the Executive Director to ensure their time is appropriately prioritized and spent in the appropriate focus areas
  • Support strong cross-organizational reporting
  • Prepare meeting and event briefings (or delegate to other staff members), ensuring the ED is properly prepared for all engagements and anticipating needs before they arise.
  • As needed, attend key meetings and events with or on behalf of the ED, ensuring timely follow-up on all action items.
  • Draft correspondence on behalf of ED and review and edit correspondence and remarks drafted by colleagues.
  • Serve as a support to ED’s direct reports, ensuring strong accountability, efficient flow of communication, and alignment with the ED.
  • Provide executive-level support administrative and logistical support to the ED, as needed, including coordinating meetings, managing follow-up communications, facilitating scheduling, preparing materials, and ensuring the timely executing of organizational priorities.

Organizational Management Systems

  • Maintain the macro view of our organizational management structure and identify gaps and needs
  • Manage onboarding of new staff onto our team
  • Provide management training and/or support for everyone with management responsibilities (whether they manage volunteers, contractors, or staff)
  • Convene, coordinate, and manage agendas for directors and all staff meetings and retreats
  • Convene and coordinate ad hoc decision-making (when no one else is able to hold this effectively) about whether we need to “pump the brakes” on a major project, re-orient in a big way, or otherwise temp check the direction
  • Work with the Directors team to ensure weekly, monthly, and annual priorities are clear.
  • Manage staff to execute hiring processes. Maintain shared hiring resources.
  • Lead on cross-team projects as needed, determined by the Directors Team. In this role support staff members to develop project plans, anticipate obstacles, and follow through on deliverables.

Operations and Human Resources

  • Work with relevant Managers to evaluate and implement performance management as needed (following our progressive discipline policy).
  • Ensure the organization is operating in compliance with our handbook
  • Manage the annual/biannual performance review process across the organization
  • Identify management or human resource gaps or problems and work with the Executive Director to solve them.
  • Improve and make sure internal communication and decision-making processes are clear within and across departments
  • Work in collaboration with our operations consultant to ensure all organizational operations and compliance needs are being met.
  • Work with the Executive Director and operations consultant to develop and approve the annual budget
  • Work with legal counsel to ensure that all programming is operating in a compliant manner

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strategic planning and goal-setting: Depth of experience facilitating organizational goal-setting and translating vision into measurable departmental work plans.
  • Executive advisory and support: Proven track record acting as a trusted advisor to an Executive Director or leadership team.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Demonstrated ability to align a full team and drive cohesive organizational collaboration.
  • Hiring & Onboarding Experience: Experience designing and executing full-cycle hiring processes, structured onboarding programs, and organizational staffing workflows.
  • Performance management: Hands-on experience overseeing performance review cycles, progressive discipline policies, and management support interventions.
  • Management coaching and training: Background in coaching, training, and mentoring people managers.
  • Project management: Experience leading cross-team projects from conception to completion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication: Exceptional communication skills with proven ability to draft executive correspondence, and synthesize organizational updates.
  • Risk assessment and critical decision-making: Comfort with analyzing organizational risk with strong judgment and analytical problem-solving skills. Excited to collaborate with legal counsel to ensure programming and operations remain compliant.
  • Budgeting and financial stewardship: Experience collaborating on annual budget development, resource allocation, and operational expense tracking.
  • Discretion and emotional intelligence: High emotional intelligence, sound instincts, and demonstrated maturity handling sensitive personnel, operational, and executive matters.
  • Ability to operate well in a high-pressure environment

COMPETENCIES

Mission Driven: Deeply aligned with our mission to build people power in our country by electing a bloc of working class leaders in Congress who meet the urgency of our political moment and serve the people’s agenda — not the interests of big corporate donors. You’re driven by the mission of racial and economic justice and the dismantling of institutional racism and wealth inequality. Possess a clear understanding that structural racism and economic inequality exist throughout all institutions and policies.

Technical and Adaptive Skills: You are a curious and creative problem solver, collaborator and coalition builder. You have a 50ft view of the political landscape, with a clear understanding of the granular steps necessary toward accomplishing the mission of the organization. Exemplary at identifying systems and processes and identifying the skill set of staff members to complete identified tasks. You are an excellent communicator and can have difficult conversations and disagreements, respectfully and cordially, while remaining grounded in the values and mission of the organization. Has experience and interest in ensuring organizations operate in a legally compliant and functional manner.

High EQ: You are both self aware and socially aware, understanding your strengths and growth areas, as well as your triggers, and emotional center. You have empathy and compassion for others both aligned and not aligned with us and you are willing to engage in debate and dialogue to create genuine new understanding. You are able to build trusting relationships with colleagues and stakeholders. People in your life describe you as a positive, empathetic, flexible, and curious person. You approach your work with a low ego and are not in the job to raise your own profile

LOCATION

We are a fully remote organization. Anywhere in the US is fine.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

SALARY & BENEFITS

  • The salary for this position is $90,500
  • This is a fully remote position, with some travel
  • Unlimited vacation with a 2 week minimum, all federal holidays off, and the organization is closed the final week of the year
  • Unlimited sick days
  • Fully paid Health, Vision, Dental (including dependents)
  • 401K and 4% employer match
  • Raise every two years

JD/OFJ is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, socioeconomic status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, marital status, or veteran status. Candidates from diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

En Septeo buscamos incorporar un/a Customer Success Specialist con alemán para Nivimu, nuestra solución SaaS de gestión de Recursos Humanos.

Serás una de las personas de referencia para nuestros clientes, acompañándolos desde sus primeros pasos con la plataforma, ayudándoles a resolver dudas e incidencias y asegurando que aprovechen todo el valor que Nivimu puede aportar a su día a día.

Buscamos un perfil cercano, resolutivo y organizado, que disfrute trabajando con clientes y tenga curiosidad por entender cómo funciona el software.

El alemán será una herramienta fundamental en tu día a día, por lo que necesitamos un nivel profesional que te permita mantener conversaciones y comunicaciones escritas con clientes con autonomía.

🎯 ¿Cuál será tu misión?

Acompañarás a nuestros clientes durante su experiencia con Nivimu, combinando onboarding, formación, soporte funcional y seguimiento, con el objetivo de facilitar la adopción del producto y construir relaciones de confianza a largo plazo.

No se trata únicamente de responder consultas. Queremos que entiendas las necesidades del cliente, investigues cada situación y le ayudes a encontrar la mejor solución.

🧩 ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Onboarding y formación

  • Acompañar a nuevos clientes durante sus primeros pasos con Nivimu.
  • Realizar sesiones de formación sobre la plataforma.
  • Entender la operativa y necesidades de cada cliente para adaptar el acompañamiento.
  • Facilitar una correcta adopción de las funcionalidades de Nivimu.

Customer Success y relación con clientes

  • Mantener una comunicación cercana y proactiva con los clientes.
  • Realizar seguimiento de sus necesidades y consultas.
  • Detectar dificultades en el uso de la plataforma y ayudar al cliente a resolverlas.
  • Identificar oportunidades para mejorar su experiencia y aprovechamiento del software.
  • Coordinarte con otros equipos cuando una necesidad requiera su intervención.

Soporte funcional

  • Atender y gestionar consultas e incidencias relacionadas con el uso de Nivimu.
  • Investigar cada caso para comprender su origen y proporcionar una respuesta clara.
  • Hacer seguimiento hasta su resolución.
  • Escalar correctamente aquellas incidencias que necesiten intervención técnica.
  • Mantener informado al cliente durante todo el proceso.

Documentación y mejora continua

  • Crear y actualizar FAQs, tutoriales, guías y documentación de soporte.
  • Detectar consultas recurrentes y proponer mejoras.
  • Compartir feedback de clientes para contribuir a la evolución del producto y de nuestros procesos.

¿Qué buscamos?

Nos gustaría conocerte si cuentas con:

  • Alemán profesional imprescindible, tanto oral como escrito, con autonomía para atender y acompañar clientes.
  • Español fluido.
  • Nivel medio alto de inglés.
  • Formación Profesional de Grado Superior, Grado Universitario o formación equivalente.
  • Experiencia previa en Customer Success, atención al cliente, soporte funcional, onboarding o posiciones similares.
  • Comodidad trabajando con software y herramientas digitales.
  • Capacidad para investigar problemas y buscar soluciones con autonomía.
  • Comunicación clara y orientación al cliente.
  • Organización para gestionar diferentes clientes, consultas y prioridades simultáneamente.
  • Atención al detalle y capacidad para hacer seguimiento de los temas hasta su resolución.

⭐ Nos aportará un plus

Valoraremos especialmente:

  • Experiencia trabajando en empresas SaaS, software o tecnología.
  • Experiencia realizando onboarding o formación de clientes sobre software.
  • Conocimiento o experiencia en soluciones de Recursos Humanos, HR Tech o gestión de personas.
  • Experiencia en soporte funcional de aplicaciones.
  • Conocimientos de portugués, italiano o griego.
  • Uso de herramientas de IA para mejorar la productividad, documentación o atención al cliente.

🙌 Más allá de la experiencia

Buscamos una persona que disfrute trabajando con personas y con tecnología.

Alguien que cuando recibe una consulta no se limite a responderla, sino que quiera comprender qué está ocurriendo.

Que sepa escuchar antes de proponer una solución.

Que pueda explicar algo complejo de una manera sencilla.

Que sea capaz de trabajar con autonomía, pero también de pedir ayuda o escalar una situación cuando sea necesario.

Y que entienda que detrás de cada incidencia hay un cliente esperando una respuesta clara y profesional.

🚀 ¿Qué encontrarás en Septeo?

  • Contrato estable dentro de un grupo tecnológico europeo en crecimiento.
  • Formación completa sobre Nivimu y nuestros procesos.
  • Un entorno donde podrás desarrollar conocimientos de Customer Success, SaaS y HR Tech.
  • Formación continua y oportunidades de desarrollo profesional.
  • Un equipo cercano y colaborativo.
  • Un entorno AI First, donde exploramos nuevas formas de trabajar y generar valor utilizando inteligencia artificial.
  • La oportunidad de participar activamente en la mejora de la experiencia de nuestros clientes.

En Septeo creemos que la tecnología es más valiosa cuando consigue hacer más sencillo el trabajo de las personas.

Si hablas alemán, disfrutas acompañando a clientes y te interesa desarrollarte en el mundo SaaS y Customer Success, queremos conocerte.

  • Participar en la aventura AI First de Septeo y descubrir nuevas formas de trabajar gracias a la inteligencia artificial.
  • Crecer y desarrollarse gracias a un itinerario de formación personalizado y a oportunidades de movilidad interna.
  • Vivir una experiencia humana, intercambiar y compartir en eventos temáticos como encuentros afterwork, actividades deportivas, iniciativas de RSC, seminarios y mucho más.
  • Unirse a un equipo que cuida de los demás y se compromete con la igualdad de oportunidades, la diversidad y la inclusión.

Septeo es un actor europeo líder en el sector del software con presencia internacional, reconocido como uno de los cinco principales proveedores de software vertical en Francia. En plena fase de rápido crecimiento y transformación constante, el grupo se ha consolidado como un referente en la industria del software, impulsado por la fortaleza de unos equipos decididos, audaces y comprometidos.

En Septeo, la inteligencia artificial es el eje de nuestra evolución. La entendemos como un motor de rendimiento sostenible, colaboración e innovación, integrada de manera responsable en las prácticas cotidianas y democratizada en todas nuestras áreas de negocio. Nuestra ambición es clara: «crear software inteligente para Europa».

Nuestra cultura se cimenta en valores sólidos: ser, hacer y transformar juntos. No es una cultura estática; se vive día a día en nuestras acciones y decisiones, logrando un equilibrio entre rendimiento, responsabilidad y disfrute.

Esta ambición se refleja en nuestra labor diaria: diseñar software que acompaña los momentos esenciales de la vida, al servicio de millones de ciudadanos. Desempeñar un papel en estos momentos clave conlleva una gran responsabilidad. Es una responsabilidad que asumimos con orgullo y que pronto podría ser también la tuya.

Unirse a Septeo significa formar parte de un proyecto colectivo internacional, impulsar la transformación del grupo en un entorno de rápida evolución y convertir la IA en un motor tangible de creación de valor, tanto en el presente como en el futuro.
