raw.title: Manager, Technical Accounting
raw.excerpt: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy.
raw.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll operate as Liftoff’s technical accounting expert—drafting and reviewing technical memos, guiding policy, and ensuring that our financial statements appropriately reflect accounting for complex transactions. At Liftoff, our industry as well as our company’s growth present unique challenges for the accounting team. You’ll be tackling some of the most complex and innovative transactions in the industry, often operating at the frontier of accounting standards where clear precedent doesn’t yet exist. If you thrive on solving problems that even Big 4 National Offices debate, and enjoy turning ambiguity into well-reasoned, defensible positions, this role will keep you constantly challenged and engaged.

Responsibilities

  • Research and document technical accounting positions (revenue, stock based compensation (SBC), leases, debt, capitalized software (CapSW)).
  • Prepare journal entry support for complex accounting areas (SBC, CapSW, Debt, significant non-recurring transactions, etc).
  • Own accounting policies
  • Drive implementation of new accounting standards from initial research to operationalization and disclosure impact.
  • Own equity-related technical accounting from review of grant setup in Equity Edge Online (EEO) to disclosures.
  • Prepare statement of equity and statement of cash flows, as well as financial statement footnotes for complex areas, including earnings per share and stock-based compensation, and stockholders’ equity.
  • Prepare SBC expense support for quarterly journal entries
  • Assist in preparation and tie out of Proxy disclosures
  • Collaborate with Legal, FP&A, and business teams on new contracts and billing structures.
  • Support audits with technical documentation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance, and 6 years of experience
  • CPA required
  • Public accounting experience, ideally Big 4 experience
  • Expertise in US GAAP
  • Ownership and accountability: Take ownership of deliverables, deadlines, risks, and outcomes while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and quality.
  • Prioritization and execution: Manage competing priorities and tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Excellent analytical skills and the ability to accurately interpret data.
  • Strong communication skills: clearly communicate complex technical accounting matters to cross-functional stakeholders and auditors.
  • Adaptability: remain calm and effective in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and adapt to evolving business, accounting and reporting requirements.

Location:

Liftoff follows a philosophy of "remote first, come together meaningfully" and allows employees to be based from a number of different states where we have entities. We require that this role work during Pacific time zone; working from the San Francisco Bay Area is highly preferred.

Travel Expectations:

We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:

Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. This role includes On Target Earnings (OTE) including a 10% bonus.

The following are our OTE (base + bonus) ranges for this role:

  • Canada (all): CAD 120,000 - 155,000

Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.

Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.

Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:

Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.

raw.description:
About Bigabid

Bigabid focuses on solving the key challenge of growth for mobile apps by building Machine Learning and Big Data-driven technology that can both accurately predict what apps a user will like and connect them in a compelling way.

Our technology operates at a scale well beyond many of the largest Internet companies, processing over 50 TB of raw data per day. We handle over 4 million requests per second and interact with over a billion unique users a week.

Our innovative platform is cutting-edge with a strong product-market fit. As a result, we're seeing remarkable growth and close to zero customer churn. To support our hyper-growth and continue propelling the growth of some of the biggest names in the mobile industry, we offer a wide range of opportunities for different skill levels and experiences.

About the position

We are looking for a data-centric quality-driven analyst focusing on data process observability. The person is passionate about building high-quality data products and processes as well as supporting production data processes and ad-hoc data requests.

As a Data Analyst at Bigabid, you will be in charge of the quality of service as well as the quality of the data and knowledge platform for all Bigabids data processes. You'll be coordinating with stakeholders and play a major role in driving the business by promoting the quality and stability of the data performance and lifecycle and giving the Operational groups immediate abilities to affect the daily

business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Process monitoring - managing and monitoring the daily data processes; troubleshooting

server and process issues, escalating bugs, and documenting data issues.

Metadata store ownership - Creating and maintaining the metadata store; Managing the

metadata system which holds metadata of tables, columns, calculations, and lineage.

Participating in the design and development of the knowledge base meta store and UX. In order to be the pivotal point of contact when needing information on tables, columns, and how

they are connected. I.e., What is the data source? What is it used for? Why are we

calculating this field in this manner?

Data quality automation - Creating and maintaining data quality tests and validations using Python code and testing frameworks.

Ad-hoc operation configuration changes - Be the extension of the operation side into the data process;

Using SQL to extract specific client-relevant data points and calibrate certain

aspects of the process.

﻿

Requirements:

  • 3+ years experience as a Data Analyst / Data quality engineer
  • Experience in working with SQL and NoSQL Databases and data warehouses such as
  • MySQL, Presto, Athena, SQL Server, Oracle.
  • Methodological worker with a very organized approach and detail-oriented.
  • At least a bachelor's degree in computer science, Math, Physics, Engineering, Statistics or other technical field.
  • Experience as a team lead or mentor.
  • Experience Programming in Python - Familiarity with pyTest, capability to write a simple script code.
  • Experience as a NOC or DevOps engineer - an advantage

raw.title: Creative Director
raw.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.
raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

raw.description:
This is not a traditional business development role focused solely on generating and closing opportunities.

We are looking for someone with 5–10 years of experience in the renewable energy industry who combines strong commercial acumen with a solid understanding of the technical and operational realities of managing renewable energy assets.

You will act as the bridge between the UK market and Streem's pan-European product and commercial strategy.

Your role will be to understand how UK renewable energy players operate, identify where their challenges intersect with Streem's capabilities, and help us adapt and localise our value proposition accordingly. You will then translate that understanding into commercial opportunities and long-term customer relationships.

Working closely with Sales, Product and Streem's leadership team, you will play a central role in defining how Streem enters, positions itself and grows in the UK market.

This is a high-impact role suited to someone who enjoys combining market strategy, customer engagement, technical problem-solving and commercial execution.

In this role, you will:

  • Map and develop a deep understanding of the UK renewable energy ecosystem, identifying the key players across IPPs, operators, asset managers, fund managers and investors, understanding how they operate and interact with one another, and mapping the relevant stakeholders within these organisations. This includes developing a detailed understanding of how prospective customers manage their renewable portfolios, commercial contracts, revenues, invoicing, reporting, data and operational workflows.

  • Build Streem's market knowledge, network and early customer relationships, developing relationships with key stakeholders across the UK renewable energy ecosystem and leading consultative discovery with prospective customers. You will identify their commercial, technical and operational challenges, understand where existing solutions fall short, and translate these insights into relevant Streem use cases and commercial opportunities.

  • Shape and localise Streem's product and value proposition for the UK, working closely with Product to translate market requirements and customer feedback into actionable insights. You will help distinguish individual customer requests from broader market needs, identify gaps and opportunities in Streem's existing offering, and contribute to decisions around localisation, integrations, workflows and capabilities required to succeed in the UK.

  • Build and develop Streem's UK commercial pipeline, initially identifying and working closely with early adopters and beta-friendly customers to validate our proposition and develop strong UK reference cases. Working closely with the Head of Sales, you will progressively turn these early relationships into strategic commercial opportunities and help establish a robust, repeatable medium-term go-to-market approach for the UK.

  • Establish Streem within the wider UK renewable energy ecosystem, representing the company at industry events, conferences, customer meetings and relevant forums, while developing strategic partnerships with technology providers, consultants, service providers and other industry participants that can strengthen Streem's proposition and accelerate our UK market development.

Must-have:

  • 5–10 years of experience in the renewable energy or wider energy industry, with knowledge of the UK market and its ecosystem.

  • Good understanding of renewable energy commercial and operational processes, with exposure to some areas such as asset management, PPAs and route-to-market structures, energy trading, revenue management, metering and energy data, invoicing, portfolio reporting or financial processes.

  • Strong commercial acumen and business development experience, with the ability to identify and develop strategic accounts, build relationships with senior decision-makers, navigate complex B2B buying processes and contribute to proposals and commercial negotiations.

  • A consultative and analytical approach to customers, with the ability to understand how a renewable energy business operates, identify underlying operational and commercial challenges, and translate them into compelling business cases and technology-driven value propositions.

  • Strong technical curiosity and understanding of technology, with the ability to quickly grasp SaaS products, energy software, data flows, integrations and APIs. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable bridging the gap between technical, operational and commercial stakeholders.

  • An entrepreneurial and autonomous mindset, comfortable building a market where the playbook is still being defined, balancing short-term opportunities with long-term market development, and working collaboratively across Product, Commercial and Leadership teams in an international environment.

You do not need to be an expert in every aspect of the renewable energy value chain. What matters is your ability to understand complex energy workflows, connect them to technology and translate that understanding into tangible customer and commercial value.

Disclaimer:

Don't meet every single requirement but believe your experience gives you the ability to understand the UK renewable energy market and build something from the ground up? We encourage you to apply.

Streem Energy offers ...

  • A dynamic entrepreneurial environment.

  • A senior role with significant autonomy and direct influence on Streem's UK strategy.

  • The opportunity to help build a new market rather than inherit an established commercial playbook.

  • An international team with colleagues from many different nationalities.

  • Exposure to multiple European renewable energy markets.

  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of renewable energy, technology and commercial strategy in one of Europe's fastest-growing industries.

Perks & Benefits

At Streem, we believe our employees should be fairly rewarded, share in the company’s success, and enjoy an open, flexible work environment that adapts to their individual needs.

In practice, this includes:

  • Flexible remote working to accommodate your schedule and personal requirements.

  • State-of-the-art tools and equipment, tailored to your working style and habits, so you can perform at your best.

Please submit your CV in English.

Streem Energy is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

At Streem, we are building the next generation SaaS platform to empower the commercial management of renewable energy assets. Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition by enabling asset managers, investors, and operators to extract more value from their renewable portfolios.

As we continue our European expansion, the UK represents a strategic growth market for Streem. While renewable energy is increasingly international, the commercial, regulatory and operational dynamics of each market remain highly local.

We are therefore looking for an experienced Business Development Manager – UK to help us establish and scale Streem's presence in the UK market.

Martek Global Services is seeking an experienced Mid-Level Acquisition Specialist to provide federal acquisition and program support for the National Institutes of Health (NIH). The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience supporting Federal acquisitions throughout the acquisition lifecycle, including acquisition planning, solicitation, award, contract administration, and closeout.

This position will work collaboratively with Contracting Officers (COs), Contracting Officer’s Representatives (CORs), program offices, and cross-functional teams to support timely, compliant, and effective acquisition activities. Experience supporting NIH, the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), or similar Federal acquisition environments is highly valued.

Position Details
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Schedule: Monday-Friday (or 5 days/week)
Work Location: Remote
Salary Range: $78,000.00 – $85,000.00


Responsibilities
  • Support Federal acquisition activities throughout the acquisition lifecycle, including planning, solicitation, award, administration, and closeout.
  • Interpret and apply Federal acquisition regulations, policies, and procedures, including the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and HHS Acquisition Regulation (HHSAR).
  • Support the development and review of procurement request packages and acquisition documentation.
  • Prepare and review acquisition strategies, Statements of Work (SOWs), Performance Work Statements (PWSs), Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs), source selection plans, business case analyses, and related documentation.

  • Assist with responses to Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests and appropriately handle procurement-sensitive information.
  • Utilize automated acquisition and contract writing systems to track procurement status, funding, milestones, and contract closeout activities.
  • Collaborate with COs, CORs, program offices, and other stakeholders to identify acquisition issues and recommend practical solutions.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and timely written communications, reports, and acquisition documentation.
Qualifications
Required
  • Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible experience supporting Federal acquisition activities across the acquisition lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated experience providing pre-award and post-award Federal acquisition support.
  • Working knowledge and experience applying the FAR and other applicable Federal acquisition regulations, policies, and procedures.
  • Experience developing and/or reviewing Federal acquisition documentation, such as SOWs, PWSs, IGCEs, acquisition strategies, source selection documentation, or similar materials.

raw.description:
We are seeking a seasoned, detail-oriented Full-Cycle Revenue Cycle Medical Biller with specialized dermatology billing expertise to support a high-volume dermatology practice. In this role, you will take complete ownership of the end-to-end revenue cycle—from reviewing specialty coding to resolving complex denials and driving outstanding A/R recovery.

The ideal candidate possesses deep familiarity with dermatology procedures, demonstrates a proactive mindset toward uncollected claims, and brings recent, hands-on mastery of ModMed (Modernizing Medicine).

Working Schedule:

Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (US Eastern Standard Time)

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  1. Full-Cycle Dermatology Billing & Claims Submission: Review CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding for dermatology procedures; generate, audit, and submit clean primary/secondary claims.
  2. A/R & Aging Management: Work insurance aging reports, investigate unpaid or underpaid claims, post insurance payments (EOBs/ERAs), and file appeals/reconsiderations.
  3. Patient Ledger & Billing Documentation: Verify patient balances, resolve billing discrepancies, and maintain complete, accurate billing notes within ModMed.

Core Responsibilities

  • Dermatology Coding & Claim Auditing: Verify CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes specific to general, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology prior to claim submission.
  • Denial & Appeals Management: Investigate rejected or denied claims, correct coding/modifier errors, submit formal reconsiderations, and follow up until final resolution.
  • Payment Posting & Reconciliation: Accurately post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and patient co-pays/coinsurance from EOBs and ERAs.
  • Insurance Follow-Up: Conduct persistent follow-up with commercial and government payers on outstanding claims exceeding 30+ days in aging.
  • Trend Analysis: Identify systemic payer denials or billing trends that impact reimbursement and report findings to management.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Specialty Billing Background: Proven full-cycle medical billing experience supporting a Dermatology practice.
  • Software Requirement (Non-Negotiable): Recent, direct hands-on experience using ModMed (Modernizing Medicine / EMA).
  • Coding Proficiency: Solid command of dermatology-specific CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS codes, and modifier applications (e.g., Modifier 25, 59).
  • Revenue Cycle Mastery: Hands-on experience across claims submission, ERA/EOB payment posting, denial resolution, and A/R aging follow-up.
  • Proactive Problem Solver: Self-starter mentality with the ability to take ownership of complex aging accounts without micro-supervision.
  • Remote Setup: A private, HIPAA-compliant home office with a reliable computer setup, high-speed internet, and a clear headset.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a tenacious, sharp dermatology biller who knows ModMed inside and out. You treat unresolved claims as personal challenges, spot coding discrepancies before submission, and keep practice revenue flowing smoothly.

raw.description:
About Our Client:

Our client is one of Nigeria's leading electricity distribution companies, responsible for the distribution and retail supply of electricity within its licensed territory. The company serves customers across the Southern zone, with a strong focus on delivering reliable, efficient, and customer-centric electricity services.

Job Objective:

To lead the organization's internal audit, enterprise risk management, and taxation functions by providing independent assurance, strengthening governance frameworks, ensuring regulatory and tax compliance, mitigating strategic and operational risks, and enhancing long-term organizational value and financial sustainability.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide independent and objective assurance to the Board and Executive Management on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, and compliance frameworks across the organization.
  • Develop and implement a risk-based annual audit strategy and plan that addresses key financial, operational, regulatory, information technology, and strategic risks.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of internal control systems and recommend improvements to safeguard assets, enhance operational efficiency, ensure data integrity, and strengthen organizational performance.
  • Present audit findings, risk exposures, and control deficiencies to the Board Audit & Risk Committee and Executive Management, while monitoring the timely implementation of agreed corrective actions.
  • Lead and maintain the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, ensuring effective identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting of strategic, operational, financial, regulatory, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee enterprise-wide risk assessments and risk profiling exercises, ensuring critical risks are appropriately escalated and integrated into strategic decision-making processes.
  • Direct fraud risk management initiatives, including fraud prevention, investigation, whistleblowing administration, and the promotion of ethical conduct in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for the organization's taxation function, ensuring compliance with all applicable tax laws, regulations, and statutory obligations.
  • Drive tax planning and tax risk management strategies that optimize tax efficiency, support business objectives, and minimize exposure to financial and regulatory penalties.
  • Oversee the timely preparation, review, and submission of statutory tax returns, remittances, and regulatory disclosures, ensuring full compliance with relevant tax authorities.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors, regulatory agencies, tax authorities, and other assurance providers, ensuring effective coordination and resolution of audit, risk, and tax matters.
  • Advise the Board and Executive Management on emerging risks, regulatory developments, governance trends, and assurance matters that may impact organizational performance and sustainability.
  • Champion a strong culture of risk awareness, accountability, compliance, and internal control through organization-wide communication, education, and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
  • Provide strategic leadership, mentorship, and capability development for the Internal Audit, Risk, and Taxation functions to ensure high performance, talent development, succession readiness, and continuous improvement.
  • Prepare and present integrated assurance, risk, compliance, and taxation reports to the Board and Executive Management, providing insights that support informed decision-making, organizational resilience, and sustainable value creation.
  • Promote and demonstrate leadership commitment to Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental (HSSE) standards by ensuring compliance with relevant policies, regulations, and safe work practices within areas of responsibility.

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Banking & Finance, or a related discipline from a recognized institution. A master's degree or MBA in a relevant field is required.
  • A professional accounting qualification such as ACA (ICAN) or ACCA is mandatory. Additional certifications including CIA, CRMA, CISA, CFE, FRM, or CITN will be an added advantage.
  • A minimum of 18 years of relevant post-qualification experience spanning internal audit, enterprise risk management, taxation, governance, and compliance, including at least 10 years in a senior leadership position responsible for enterprise-wide assurance, risk oversight, and strategic decision support.

Key Performance Metric:

  • Annual Risk-Based Audit Plan Delivery: Achieve 100% execution of the Board-approved annual risk-based audit plan within the financial year, with all high-risk areas reviewed and reported.
  • Audit Recommendation Implementation Rate: Ensure at least 90% implementation of agreed audit actions within approved timelines and achieve zero repeat high-risk audit findings.
  • Enterprise Risk Management Effectiveness: Maintain 100% of critical enterprise risks with approved mitigation plans and ensure quarterly review and reporting of the enterprise risk register to Executive Management and the Board.
  • Fraud and Control Loss Prevention: Achieve zero material financial losses resulting from control failures and ensure 100% of fraud cases are investigated and concluded within approved timelines.
  • Tax Compliance and Optimization: Achieve 100% compliance with statutory tax filing and payment obligations, resulting in zero penalties, fines, or regulatory sanctions, while delivering approved tax optimization initiatives annually.
  • Internal Control and Governance Assurance: Maintain zero material internal control weaknesses reported by external auditors, regulators, or assurance providers during the assessment period.
  • Board and Executive Reporting Effectiveness: Submit 100% of quarterly audit, risk, and taxation reports to the Board Audit & Risk Committee and Executive Management within agreed reporting timelines.
  • Leadership, Risk Culture and Succession Readiness: Conduct a minimum of two enterprise-wide risk and control awareness initiatives annually and maintain at least one ready-now or ready-soon successor for each critical role within the function.

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • Demonstrates expertise in internal audit, assurance, and financial and operational audits, supported by strategic leadership and sound business management.
  • Applies enterprise risk management, taxation, corporate governance, and regulatory knowledge to support informed decision-making.
  • Combines fraud risk management and investigation skills with accountability, integrity, ethical judgement, professional skepticism, and attention to detail.
  • Uses data analytics, technology audit, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills to identify risks and improve organisational performance.
  • Demonstrates effective people and change leadership, stakeholder management, executive communication, negotiation, influencing, and conflict management skills.

Job Title: Operational Excellence Leader

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

The Operational Excellence Leader is responsible for leading the Canadian Service Tools and Operational Supplies programs, ensuring Field Service teams have access to the tools, equipment, and support required to deliver safe, effective, and efficient customer service. This includes leadership of tool strategy, procurement, calibration and repair, supplier management, inventory and lifecycle management, field support, and financial stewardship of the Service Tools program.

In addition, the role drives operational excellence across the Canadian Service organization through improved operational rigor, performance metrics, quality and compliance, process improvement, and readiness for evolving service processes and technologies. Key accountabilities include Daily Management System (DMS) preparedness and dashboard alignment, Service Request cleanup and ServiceMax preparedness, quality initiatives including Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), and the implementation of sustainable operating mechanisms that improve service performance.

The role works cross-functionally with Service leadership, Field Service, Quality, Engineering, Sourcing, operational support teams, suppliers, and regional and global partners to translate business and field requirements into effective solutions and continuous improvement.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities


Service Tools, Operational Supplies & Financial Management

  • Provide overall leadership for the Canadian Service Tools and Operational Supplies programs, including tool availability, procurement, calibration, repair, field support, inventory, catalog management, and lifecycle requirements.
  • Manage the $1.25M+ annual Service Tools budget, including annual planning, prioritization of investments, and alignment with Regional and National Service leadership.
  • Manage calibration and repair suppliers, including work-in-progress reviews, prioritization of high-demand tools, cost management, and resolution of supplier performance issues.
  • Partner with Engineering, Sourcing, Supplier Quality, operational support teams, and other stakeholders to resolve tool availability, obsolescence, validation, quality, and procurement issues.
  • Provide governance for the Operational Supplies catalog, inventory requirements, associated workflows, and supporting data.
  • Serve as an escalation point for Field Service tool requirements, identifying solutions and alternatives that support field productivity and customer service.

Systems & Performance

  • Drive operational rigor across the Service organization through effective performance metrics, operating mechanisms, action management, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead Daily Management System (DMS) preparedness and dashboard alignment, ensuring operational processes, metrics, data, and ownership support business requirements.
  • Lead and support Service Request cleanup and ServiceMax preparedness, including process readiness, testing, data quality, and resolution of workflow gaps.
  • Identify operational performance gaps and partner with Service leaders and cross-functional teams to establish actions, ownership, and sustainable solutions.
  • Support implementation of new processes, systems, metrics, and operational initiatives that improve Service effectiveness.

Quality, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with Quality and Service stakeholders to support Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities, new quality metrics, investigations, corrective actions, and effectiveness checks.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure assigned operational processes align with applicable Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
  • Lead or support investigations and corrective actions related to Service Tools processes, including out-of-tolerance assessments and field escalations.
  • Identify recurring process issues and lead cross-functional improvement initiatives that strengthen quality, compliance, safety, and operational performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years of operational or field experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in service operations, operational excellence, field service, supply chain, asset or tool management, or a related operational function.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving actions through completion in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience with operational performance management, including metrics, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience working with quality, compliance, audit, or corrective-action processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, suppliers, competing priorities, and operational escalations.
  • Strong analytical, project-management, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of an organization.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience in healthcare technology, medical devices, Field Service, or another regulated environment.
  • Strong understanding of Field Service operations and the relationship between operational processes, field productivity, quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Experience supporting major system implementations, operational transformations, or process changes.
  • Experience with dashboards, operational metrics, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), supplier management, calibration, or asset management.
  • Familiarity with enterprise service management, asset management, quality, and field-service systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify root causes, develop practical solutions, and implement sustainable process improvements.
  • Ability to balance strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational execution and escalations.
  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills with the ability to operate effectively across regional and global teams.

The pay range for this position is $90,000.00-$120,000.00 CAD Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. raw.title: Outsourced Tier-1 IT Help Desk Services — Microsoft 365 & RMM
raw.excerpt: Request for qualifications from IT services firms and independent IT businesses.
raw.description:
Request for qualifications from IT services firms and independent IT businesses.

About goCloudOffice®

goCloudOffice® is a modern, AI-driven IT consulting company. Founded in 2003 and based in Silicon Valley, we serve customers nationwide across the United States. Our customers are small businesses of 5 to 50 people, in industries that include biotechnology, law and professional services. They own their business applications, and we run their IT with senior engineering judgment and AI-augmented support that has been in daily production since summer 2024.

The engagement

Request for qualifications: first-line IT support services (remote) for goCloudOffice®'s Helpdesk customers — Tier-1 end-user support, RMM operations tasks and Tier-1 administration at goCloudOffice®'s Tier-1 service level. Budgeted rate USD 65 per hour; providers propose coverage windows, a block fee and terms.

goCloudOffice® welcomes responses from IT services firms, including helpdesk firms whose own W-2 personnel provide first-line support, and from independent IT practitioners who operate an established business.

This is a business-to-business engagement under a master services agreement and a statement of work between goCloudOffice® and your business, which invoices for the services it delivers.

Engagement contact: the goCloudOffice® account lead. The provider directs its own work and personnel.

Scope of services

The services are first-line IT support at goCloudOffice®'s Tier-1 service level: requests that follow a clear, documented runbook, delivered remotely, with anything beyond a runbook handed off to goCloudOffice®'s senior providers.

  • Tier-1 end-user support. Remote help for business users through the Helpdesk ticketing system: Windows 10 and 11 and macOS troubleshooting; Microsoft 365 apps such as Outlook, Teams and OneDrive; printers and peripherals; Microsoft 365 and authenticator apps on users' phones; and the Tier-1 steps of user onboarding and offboarding.
  • RMM operations. RMM operations deliverables in goCloudOffice®'s NinjaOne environment (patch-policy roll-outs, scripted remediations, alert triage) under named, scoped access.
  • Tier-1 administration. In each customer's Microsoft 365 tenant: user additions and changes, password resets and multi-factor re-registration after identity verification, and group, distribution-list and license changes, each under the customer's change rules and a documented runbook.
  • Escalation.Security events, tenant-wide settings, new policies and scripts, network changes and multi-system work are handed off to goCloudOffice®'s senior providers, with a hand-off note that records what was seen, what was tried and what the user was told.
  • Documentation.Clear ticket notes, knowledge-base articles and runbook updates, so every customer stays easy to support.
  • AI-assisted delivery. AI tools used as a daily part of the work, including AI-assisted troubleshooting, knowledge-base drafting and ticket summarization, with every output verified before it reaches a customer or a customer system.

First-line tickets are triaged by the Helpdesk's AI assistant; the provider handles the tickets it accepts under the statement of work and hands off to goCloudOffice®'s senior providers on escalation.

Services must meet each customer's security, access and confidentiality policies and the service levels in the statement of work.

The provider uses its own equipment and business identity; goCloudOffice® grants only the proprietary system access the services require.

The provider presents under its own business name on every surface a customer sees: a Helpdesk alias of the form "[Name] — [Business]", public replies signed "Thanks, [Name], [Business] — for the Helpdesk", and RMM and customer-tenant accounts labelled with the business.

The services are delivered remotely, and providers in any US state may respond. On-site work at customer premises is arranged separately and sits outside this scope.

What your business brings (required qualifications)

1. An independently established IT services business. Your business:

  • operates under its own business name, including in the ticketing and management systems it works in;
  • regularly contracts with other businesses and advertises its services to the public;
  • holds the business licenses and registrations its work requires (for example, in its home city and state);
  • carries general liability insurance (USD 1M per occurrence, USD 2M aggregate), technology errors-and-omissions and network security and privacy liability insurance (USD 1M per claim) with breach-response cover, and workers' compensation where the business has W-2 personnel;
  • provides its own equipment.

Preferred structure:A corporation, or an LLC taxed as an S-corporation, whose own W-2 personnel perform the services is preferred; helpdesk firms that staff first-line support this way are welcome. Sole proprietorships and single-member LLCs are also considered.

2. Typically three or more years of hands-on Tier-1 and Tier-2 IT support experience for business users across Windows, macOS and Microsoft 365.

3. Remote Tier-1 troubleshooting: Windows 10 and 11, macOS, Microsoft 365 apps, printers and peripherals, and Microsoft 365 and authenticator apps on users' phones, resolved through tickets and remote sessions.

4. Microsoft 365 Tier-1 administration: user additions and changes, password resets and multi-factor re-registration, and group, distribution-list and license changes, carried out from documented runbooks, with identity verification before every account change.

5. RMM operations:hands-on delivery of RMM operations tasks on a remote monitoring and management platform (patch-policy roll-outs, scripted remediations and alert triage), with every action documented in the ticket.

6. AI-assisted service delivery. Providers should demonstrate at least one year of AI-assisted service delivery in their practice (for example, AI-assisted troubleshooting, knowledge-base drafting or ticket summarization). We look for:

  • Tools:any mainstream assistant, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or GitHub Copilot.
  • A clear method for checking AI output: confirming answers against vendor documentation such as Microsoft Learn or Apple Support, trying a fix on one device before wider use, reading every line of a script before running it, checking every AI-drafted reply for accuracy before a customer sees it, and keeping customer data inside tools approved for it.
  • Experience with AI-triaged ticket queues: reading an AI assistant's triage critically before acting on it.

7. Security judgment:identity verification before any account or device change, immediate escalation of security events such as a phishing report or an unusual sign-in, and careful handling of credentials, recovery keys and customer data.

8. Clear written communication with end users: patient, plain-language replies, accurate ticket notes, and hand-offs complete enough for the next engineer to continue from the last step.

9. Remote service capability: able to deliver the services remotely from any US state (customer data is handled under the customer's terms and within the United States), within the coverage windows the provider proposes and commits to, and at the service levels in the statement of work.

Where a qualification names years, equivalent depth gained in fewer years counts; tell us how.

Also valuable (preferred qualifications)

  • A.Hands-on NinjaOne experience: device management, patch management, alerts and conditions, the script library and remote access.
  • B.Relevant certifications, such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (exam MD-102) or Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals (exam MS-900).
  • C.Experience with a Zendesk-class ticketing desk: views, macros, internal notes and service-level targets.
  • D.More than one qualified person in your business who can perform the services, for coverage continuity.

Rate, fee and term

  • Budgeted rate: USD 65 per hour. Providers propose their own rates and commercial terms.
  • Fee structure: a fixed fee per coverage block, sized from the budgeted rate, plus hourly or per-ticket overage for work outside the block, itemized on the provider's invoice.
  • Coverage:Customer demand is concentrated in US Pacific business hours; providers propose the coverage windows they will commit to.
  • Service levels: acknowledgment and first-response targets, measured over each month and set in the statement of work.
  • Volume:the coverage windows the provider proposes set the volume; scope may expand by statement of work.
  • Term:a 12-month statement of work, renewable.

How to respond

Submit your business's qualifications: a capability statement, résumés of the personnel who would perform the services, and answers to the response questions. The questions cover business details, licenses and insurance in force, who performs the services, current clients (count and industries, including those your business serves remotely; no names), equipment, the ticketing and RMM platforms your personnel use for other clients, the coverage windows you offer, your proposed fee and terms, and one example of AI-assisted service delivery. Please send résumés without photographs, dates of birth, government identification numbers or home addresses, and share the notice below with the personnel whose résumés you submit. The qualification process is clear and quick:

1. A review of your response against the posted qualifications.
2. A 25-minute introductory qualification call about how your business runs.
3. A technical qualification call with live Tier-1 scenarios and a practical AI exercise, using the AI assistant of your choice or one we provide.
4. A walk-through of the Helpdesk workflow, using sample tickets.

5. Two references from current clients.

6. A final decision by goCloudOffice®'s founder.

Every respondent receives an answer. Reasonable accommodations and other adjustments to any step are available on request; the notice below explains how to reach us.

AI-assistance and privacy notice

This notice covers the businesses that respond to this request for qualifications and the personnel they name. goCloudOffice, Inc. may use AI-assisted tools — Manatal, the platform that hosts our request page, and AI models from Anthropic — to organize and summarize responses against the qualifications posted here and to draft our replies. People, not tools, make every selection decision, and a person reads every response before any decision is made. We keep response records for four years and never sell or share them. You may decline AI assistance, ask for human re-review of any step, or request an accommodation for a qualification call through our contact form at ; doing so will not affect how we evaluate your response. Our full privacy notice for respondents, including California privacy rights, is at .

Equal opportunity

goCloudOffice® selects providers on the posted qualifications alone. It welcomes responses from every qualified business, and considers them without regard to the race, color, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or reproductive health decision-making of the business's owners or personnel, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
Founded by games industry veterans, Rushdown was created with a simple philosophy in mind: We believe that when talented developers are consistently challenged and given clear ownership of their work, extraordinary things will happen. As a co-dev game studio, we now focus on solving some of the most difficult problems that face multiplayer games — and we bring our experience working on games like PUBG, League of Legends, and Rocket League with us. We truly love the work we do and we want to funnel our passion and expertise into features and games that billions of players will enjoy worldwide.

Our Role

Rushdown Studios is looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to join us in support of an existing partner studio! In this role, you’ll work alongside our existing team to improve infrastructure reliability and automate infrastructure creation and tools for a large-scale game development project.

Our ideal candidate is a self-motivated and demonstrated team player with the ability to juggle and jump between different tasks as necessary. Prior game development experience is required for this role, but we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements listed below!

Work Location: Rushdown Studios is based in Saratoga Springs, NY and we have a strong preference for local candidates willing to work from our office on a hybrid basis (i.e., Tuesday-Thursday) or fully remote candidates in the Eastern United States. However, we're always open to expanding our list of remote-eligible states for the right candidate, as well.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure for game development and live-service games using one or more cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Deploy infrastructure-as-code for cloud resources using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure Bicep, or Azure Resource Manager templates.
  • Promote cloud security best practices and compliance requirements for gaming infrastructure.
  • Design and develop CI/CD pipelines for builds and deployments.
  • Respond to live support issues for a live-service game.
  • Empower multiple teams through development environment automation.

Requirements

  • Four (4) years of professional experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience scripting with languages like Python, PowerShell, or Groovy.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of game packaging and deployment requirements for different platforms.
  • Experience compiling code and/or managing pipelines that compile code.
  • Experience monitoring and profiling applications (DataDog, CloudWatch, Prometheus)
  • Ability to debug unexpected issues that arise during development.
  • Willingness to selflessly put player experiences first before even your own code and ego.
  • Proactive approach to communication, particularly when it comes to unblocking yourself and navigating obstacles as part of a team.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with build systems like Jenkins, TeamCity, or Azure DevOps, specifically for game development projects.
  • Experience working with additional cloud providers (e.g., AWS, GCP).
  • Knowledge of game development workflows and asset management.
  • Experience with the Go programming language.
  • Experience running multi-cloud applications.
  • Previous work using version control for game development (e.g., Perforce, Git LFS).

Benefits:

  • Compensation: $100,000-150,000/year. Please note that final base pay will ultimately depend upon a combination of factors, including your prior experience, general qualifications, and broader skill set.
  • 9 Paid Holidays plus Flexible PTO and Annual Winter Break Closure
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Annual Video Game Budget
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Paid Parental Leave

EEO Statement

At Rushdown Studios, we believe that we're made better by each of the different perspectives that our team members bring to the table. We said it above, and we'll say it again: We want to hear from you, even if you don't meet all of the requirements for a specific role.

We're also an equal opportunity employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of race; color; ancestry or national origin; religion; physical or mental disability; age; sex, including pregnancy; sexual orientation; gender, gender identity, or gender expression; medical condition; genetic information; or marital, military, or veteran status.

Responsible for the data capture, analysis & reporting of data information to assist the Trinity Health leadership team achieve operational efficiency. Responsible for auditing of department information, producing reports & suggesting improvements to processes. Provides knowledge & expertise in the program, services & applications.


Essential Functions

  • Our Trinity Health Culture: Knows, understands, incorporates & demonstrates our Trinity Health Mission, Values, Vision, Actions & Promise in behaviors, practices & decisions.
    Work Focus:
  • Researches, collects & analyzes information. Identifies opportunities, develops solutions, & leads through resolution.
  • Collaborates on performance improvement activities as indicated by outcomes in program efficiency & patient experience.
  • Responsible for distribution of analytical reports.
  • Process Focus:
  • Utilizes multiple system applications to perform analysis, create reports & develop educational materials.
  • Incorporates basic knowledge of Trinity Health policies, practices & processes to ensure quality, confidentiality & safety are prioritized.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of departmental processes & procedures & ability to readily acquire new knowledge.
  • Data Management & Analysis:
  • Research & compiles information to support ad-hoc operational projects & initiatives.
  • Synthesizes & analyzes data & provides detailed summaries including graphical data presentations illustrating trends & recommending practical options or solutions while considering the impact on business strategy & supporting leadership decision making.
  • Leverages program & operational data & measurements to define & demonstrate progress, ROI & impacts.
  • Maintains a Working Knowledge of applicable federal, state & local laws / regulations, Trinity Health Integrity & Compliance Program & Code of Conduct, as well as other policies, procedures & guidelines in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical &
  • Professional behavior & safe work practices.

Functional Role


  • Responsible for ensuring accurate CPT and/or ICD-10 documentation for the patient billing process and educating colleagues and providers in accurately document services performed and using the appropriate codes representing those services. Maintains documentation regarding charge capture processes. Performs regular reviews of process adherence and identify missing charges. Coordinates with key stakeholders regarding impacts of system change requests and upgrades to processes to ensure capture accuracy. Provides oversight of charge reconciliation processes for assigned departments; ensuring daily and appropriate monthly reconciliations are occurring.
  • May perform or provide “at elbow” guidance to clinical departmental daily reconciliation processes including ensuring supply charges are appropriate captured (may include implants), identify duplicate charges and initiate appropriate communications when there are documentation and/or charge deficiencies or charge errors.
  • Performs charge entry/capture functions, charge approvals, and/or quality charge reviews; including but not limited to, appending modifiers, and checking clinical documentation. Provides feedback to intra-departmental Revenue Integrity colleagues including areas of opportunity.
  • Reviews and responds to various quality reports, including reports that identify missing charges, duplicate charges, late charges, etc. Maintain and update required reference logs and other reporting tools. May create and present information for decision making purposes.
  • Supports other stakeholders with denial related charge reviews including analysis of clinical documentation, root cause analysis and education to the responsible ancillary department.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum of one (1) to two (2) years of relevant work experience in a hospital and/or Physician Practice environment and experience in revenue cycle, billing, coding and/or patient financial services. Charge control/capture work experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with current medical terminology, data entry, supply chain processes, hospital and/or Medical Group practice operations; hospital and/or Physician group practice revenue cycle front-end functions such as patient registration that may impact charge related errors; and billing and regulatory guidelines related to charging and other revenue cycle processes and ability to assist clinical departments and/or physician practices with changes to their charging practices based on guidelines.

Additional Qualifications (nice to have)

  • Licensure/Certification: RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CPC/COC, AAPC or other coding credentials and/or Licensed Vocational Nurse/Licensed Practical Nurse licensure preferred. CHC (Healthcare Compliance Certification) preferred. CHRI certification/membership strongly preferred.

Our Commitment

Rooted in our Mission and Core Values, we honor the dignity of every person and recognize the unique perspectives, experiences, and talents each colleague brings. By finding common ground and embracing our differences, we grow stronger together and deliver more compassionate, person-centered care. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

Overview

We are seeking a Staff Consultant to join our Public Safety Practice. The Public Safety practice provides a broad range of services across police, fire, EMS, dispatch, corrections, and department of motor vehicles to include project management, process analysis, operational reviews, organization development, and system acquisition and implementation. This new team member will be located in either our Portland, Maine office (or another BerryDunn office) or in a home-based location.

Travel Expectations: Willingness to travel 35-50%

You Will

  • Assist in performing consulting engagements. This may involve such tasks as conducting research, assisting with detailed and technical aspects of the engagement, documenting the engagement, and assisting with engagement reporting.
  • Support the delivery of services to clients on time, within scope, and within budget, including assisting in creating written deliverables and other work products
  • Participate in meetings and interviews with client stakeholders and assist in documenting client needs and challenges
  • Participate in staff/team meetings and training and work effectively as a team player on multiple client projects
  • Support additional team operations on an as needed basis including events and marketing, internal research projects, and ongoing professional development initiatives
  • Assist with project management tasks such as tracking and reporting project progress, maintaining project document repository, and reviewing deliverables for quality assurance
  • Provide ad hoc assessments and briefings in response to client requests.
  • Develop concise summaries, reports, and presentations of complex data for client leadership.
  • Perform assigned administrative tasks effectively and efficiently

You Have

  • BA/BS Degree (relevant professional may be offered in lieu of this requirement)
  • 2-4 years of professional experience, preferably in a Business Analyst role
  • Relevant experience in project management, project coordination, and/or research
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint

Preferred skills:

  • Experience working in a public safety domain: police, fire, EMS, dispatch, or corrections
  • Experience working with Computer Aided Dispatch (CAD) datasets
  • Experience with one or more of the following public safety system types: police Records Management Systems (RMS), fire RMS, Jail Management Systems (JMS), or Offender Management Systems (OMS)
  • Experience with MS Teams and SharePoint collaboration platforms and leveraging AI for efficiency

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $68,000 - $90,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being.
