raw.excerpt: About Current AICurrent AI is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale.
raw.description:
About Current AI

Current AI
is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already raised hundreds of millions through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.

If AI is the transformative revolution we perceive it to be, it needs to serve the public interest today and tomorrow. At Current AI, our goal is to help build a collaborative, collective, and global vision for AI, not one governed by a specific country or a company.

Today, there are builders and researchers around the world developing public interest AI building blocks (datasets, models, compute, audits and applications), but efforts are not always co-ordinated or additive. To have a genuine shot at being an alternative, we must harness the full breadth of work happening across open source and public interest AI. That means leveraging government influence and resources, philanthropic funding, and private sector expertise and scale towards building the alternative.

Role Overview

Our main product umbrella at Current AI is AI Potluck:, an open source project to build a vertically integrated and easy to use AI product assembled entirely out of open source components and built collaboratively with the open source ecosystem.

As VP Product and reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the overall product strategy and product management organization for Current AI. You will own AI Potluck end to end: Alpha, our open source alternative to the closed AI assistants most people use today, the Gap Map, our insights product that shows the open source ecosystem where attention is needed, and the products that come after. You will partner with the Head of engineering and executive leadership to translate vision into scalable roadmaps and PRDs, running the product lifecycle from inception to launch. The goal is movement building through product, so the technology is the means and the measure is whether people and organizations adopt what we ship and contribute back to it. You will define what makes AI Potluck unique and why people should join the movement.

What you will be working on

AI Potluck has three parts today, and you will own all of them:

  • Alpha, at , an assistant assembled entirely from open source components, launched in July 2026 at AI for Good in Geneva and in open testing since.
  • The Gap Map, at , which shows where the open source AI ecosystem has gaps and where funding and contribution should go.
  • The Alpha Public Router, a single endpoint serving models from public and mission aligned suppliers. It powers Alpha today and becomes a product for developers next.

Your first six months

  • Take Alpha from testing to real everyday use inside a small number of partner organisations.
  • Decide what the Public Router becomes as a product, and what we ask developers to do with it.
  • Set the 2027 roadmap with partners and grantees.
  • Increase our partners’ contributions on Alpha

How we will measure success

  • Products shipped on the dates we announce publicly.
  • Organisations actively using Alpha and the Router, not only registered.
  • Open source projects integrated into the stack, and contributions we send back to them.
  • Partners who move from a conversation to a shipped integration.
  • A roadmap that partners can read without needing a meeting to understand it.

What you’ll do

The VP Product will be responsible for the following:

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Lead the overall product vision and strategy, translating organizational mission into compelling product designs while prioritizing interoperability and completeness of the broader ecosystem stack over in-house build.
  • Own the global product roadmap, bringing technical options, trade-offs, and strategic recommendations directly to the CEO and Board before roadmaps are finalized.
  • Set the product policies, including the content policy for our products, the criteria for the models and suppliers we serve, and how we measure quality in each language.
  • Drive the full product lifecycle, including PRD development, user story creation, and managing the roadmap from inception to launch.
  • Structure work streams and maintain documentation for the roadmap, the release notes and partner communications, in line with company-wide guidelines on workspace tool.
  • Drive high-impact product / feature launches ensuring they are delivered on time and effectively communicated to the ecosystem.
  • Run the Product Sprint process, including the backlog, sprint planning & Weekly update, being ready to do some hands-on building when needed

Internal & External Alignment

  • Work closely with the Engineering team to translate technical platform capabilities into tangible product features.
  • Align internal engineering teams and external partners around a common product roadmap, working with leaders of funding projects, partner institutions and internal teams to facilitate collaboration and ensure that individual initiatives contribute to broader ecosystem products.
  • Partner with leadership to identify and engage the right partners, ensuring external contributions (developers, organizations) are additive.
  • Federate around the mission of Current AI, engaging with partners, grantees and the broader technical community to advance the ecosystem strategy and position Current AI as a trusted product coordination hub.

Team & Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and empower product team and engineering leadership, directly overseeing the Head of Engineering and product teams to foster a high-performing, accountable builder culture.
  • Plan resourcing and hiring collaboratively, proposing product and engineering resource plans and budgets for regular review with executive leadership.

Exploratory & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate with the Engineering Team and the CEO and broader leadership to identify and incubate new projects, prototypes, or product lines that address critical gaps in the public-interest AI stack.
  • Engage with partners, grantees, and the community to advance the product strategy and position Current AI as a trusted hub for public-interest AI.

Balancing AI-assisted development and human judgment

  • Set the vision for how we use AI coding tools while also keeping the most critical aspects of product human.
  • Help the engineering team decide what we're building and for whom from first principles. Architecture is hard to reverse, and anything requiring quality, security or human judgment has to be designed that way.

What we’re looking for

Essential Qualifications

  • 12-15+ years of experience in product leadership roles, including AI systems and managing cross-functional product and engineering organizations
  • Experience designing and driving complex technical product roadmaps across distributed teams
  • Collaborative and cross-functional working style; experienced in partnering with Engineering and Programme teams to surface and amplify impact.
  • Strategic thinker about product ecosystems and platforms
  • Builder mindset with a bias toward experimentation and shipping
  • Fluent English with strong public speaking skills and capacity to adapt written communication for different audiences
  • Executive maturity: proactive communicator to the CEO, skilled in executive coordination, and comfortable navigating complex public-private stakeholder environments
  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM systems (evaluation, serving, safety)

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in open-source ecosystems, research-product organizations or public-interest technology initiatives
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute product strategies that shift narrative and build movements
  • French proficiency is a strong plus
  • Experience in international organisations, foundations, or global advocacy movements.

Character traits

We’re looking for people who:

  1. Put the mission before personal credit and work well in low-ego, highly collaborative teams
  2. Exercise good judgment and integrity, including knowing when to push back or say no
  3. Enjoy building from scratch and making progress with imperfect information
  4. Have a bias to action, shipping useful things and helping others do the same
  5. Are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution as needed
  6. Work effectively across cultures, time zones, and disciplines
  7. Believe AI can serve the public interest - and are willing to do the practical, unglamorous work to make that true.

How to apply

Please submit your resume through the button on the top right and answer the prompted questions in no more than [500] words in total:

Equal opportunity commitment

Current AI is committed to ensuring equal access to employment and preventing all forms of discrimination. All applications will be reviewed fairly, without regard to origin, sex, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, disability, religious beliefs, views held, or any other criteria unrelated to professional qualifications. Selection will be based solely on skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

Current AI does not accept unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies with whom we do not have a signed agreement. Current AI will not be liable for any fees or commissions in the event that a candidate submitted in this manner is subsequently hired.

Salary: Paris: 140,000 € - 180,000 € depending on experience. Our offers are adjusted based on location.

raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.
  • High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.
  • Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

raw.description:
About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

About the role

Rubrik Professional Services is hiring a Global Solutions Architect to serve as our most senior technical authority for public cloud. This is a global, individual-contributor role at Technical Director level. You will set the architectural direction for how Rubrik is designed, deployed, and operated in the world’s most demanding cloud environments — and you will carry that direction personally into our most strategic customer engagements.

You will be deployed where technical risk is highest: flagship accounts, first-of-a-kind architectures, and the engagements whose outcome sets the pattern everyone else follows. Between those engagements, you will convert what you learned into the reference architectures, service offerings, and enablement that raise the capability of every architect and consultant in the field. Your impact is measured by the quality of the practice you leave behind, not the hours you personally bill.

We are looking for depth in public cloud architecture first. Deep Rubrik product expertise is expected to be built on the job. If you have architected large-scale data, storage, or security platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and you can learn a new platform quickly and completely, we want to talk.

What you will do

Set technical direction

  • Own the global cloud architecture standard for Rubrik Professional Services — reference architectures, design patterns, guardrails, and documented anti-patterns
  • Act as the final technical escalation point for cloud architecture decisions on strategic engagements worldwide
  • Define the technical shape of our cloud service offerings: what we sell, how it is scoped, and what good delivery looks like
  • Establish Rubrik PS’s position on emerging cloud capabilities and translate them into deployment guidance before customers ask

Lead the hardest engagements

Serve as trusted advisor to customer CIO, CTO, Chief Architect, and CISO stakeholders, and defend design decisions in front of customer architecture review boards

  • Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales on strategic pursuits: technical validation, level of effort, and honest risk assessment on the deals we cannot afford to get wrong
  • Lead briefings and multi-day design workshops on site and remotely

Scale yourself through the practice

  • Build the intellectual property that multiplies your reach — reference architectures, deployment automation, design templates, decision trees, and delivery accelerators

  • Define technical competency standards and enablement for cloud within Professional Services, and help set the hiring bar through technical interviews
  • Represent Rubrik Professional Services externally at conferences, customer advisory boards, and in published technical material

Influence the product

  • Act as the field’s most credible voice into Product Management and Engineering, backed by evidence from our largest deployments
  • Shape roadmap priorities, supportability, and cloud-native feature direction
  • Partner with Support and Customer Success on systemic technical issues before they become patterns
  • Work with PS Operations and leadership to turn field learning into better scoping models, estimates, and delivery methodology

What you bring

  • 15+ years overall experience, including 8+ years as a hands-on cloud architect at enterprise scale
  • Demonstrated ownership of architecture for multi-region, multi-account or multi-subscription cloud estates, in a large enterprise or a consulting / professional services organization
  • Expert-level AWS and Azure; GCP strongly preferred. Genuine depth across compute, storage, networking, identity, and encryption / key management
  • Deep understanding of enterprise data protection and cyber resilience — RTO and RPO modelling, immutability, backup and recovery design, isolated and air-gapped recovery
  • Working fluency in cloud security and compliance frameworks and how they constrain design in regulated industries
  • Strong automation background — infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep), scripting (Python, PowerShell), API-first integration, and CI/CD (Strong Automation Background)
  • A track record of influence without authority across a global, matrixed organization and multiple time zones
  • Executive-grade communication — credible with a customer’s CIO and their principal engineer on the same day
  • Evidence of building reusable technical IP, not only delivering successful projects
  • The ability to learn a complex new platform to expert depth, quickly. Prior Rubrik experience is not required
  • Occasional travel

Nice to have

  • Kubernetes and containerized workload architecture; cloud-native and managed database platforms
  • SaaS data protection experience (Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and similar)
  • Prior Principal, Distinguished, or Technical Director title within a vendor professional services organization or a major systems integrator
  • Professional or expert-level certifications (AWS Solutions Architect – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)
  • An established public technical presence — talks, writing, open source, or community leadership

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: Rubrik platform depth established, current cloud reference architectures assessed, and the top three gaps in our cloud delivery capability identified and evidenced
  • First 6 months: Leading architecture on at least two strategic global engagements; first published reference architecture or accelerator in field use
  • First 12 months: Recognized as the escalation point for cloud architecture across all theatres; measurable improvement in scoping accuracy and delivery consistency on cloud engagements; a named group of architects visibly stronger for your mentorship

Success in this role means hustling on a daily basis, hitting and exceeding monthly sales goals, being proactively strategic, and bringing a can-do attitude every day. About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.

With programs like Future of Medicine, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced virtual Principal Investigator to join our team. As the Principal Investigator, you will be responsible for oversight of all clinical trials according to study protocols, company processes, and GCP. Please note this is a part-time role.

How You'll Make An Impact

Provide medical support to sub-investigators and study staff for protocol-related issues including protocol clarifications, inclusion/exclusion determinations, and issues of patient safety and/or eligibility.

  • Complete the necessary Care Access and protocol specific trainings

raw.description:
About the Role

Xsolla is looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to help bring greater clarity, coordination, and operational discipline across our product development teams.

This role sits at the center of product execution, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, and other Delivery Managers to ensure teams are aligned on priorities, dependencies, timelines, and changes.

The Senior Delivery Manager will own the operating rhythm of the team: maintaining the backlog and roadmap, running engineering ceremonies, surfacing risks and blockers, and ensuring that changes are communicated clearly—not just what is changing, but why.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, this person will also play an important role in identifying broader operational challenges and working with leadership to improve how the team plans, communicates, prioritizes, and executes.

Key Responsibilities

    Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment across initiatives.

  • Maintain visibility into dependencies, timelines, priorities, and risks across teams.

  • Proactively identify areas where teams are becoming misaligned and drive the conversations necessary to resolve them.

  • Ensure stakeholders understand both what the team is doing and how individual activities connect to broader product and business priorities.

    • Team Execution & Scrum

  • Run and facilitate engineering scrum ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and other working sessions as needed.

  • Ensure teams leave meetings with clear decisions, owners, and next steps.

  • Track blockers and risks through resolution rather than simply documenting them.

  • Help create a predictable and effective operating cadence between Product and Engineering.

    • Backlog & Roadmap Management

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve the team backlog and roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering leadership.

  • Ensure work is clearly prioritized, appropriately structured, and visible to stakeholders.

  • Maintain clarity between committed roadmap work, future opportunities, operational improvements, and unscheduled backlog items.

  • Identify dependencies, sequencing challenges, and resource conflicts before they become delivery issues.

    • Change Management & Communication

  • Communicate changes to priorities, timelines, scope, and direction clearly and proactively.

  • Help teams understand the why behind changes so that Engineers, Designers, and other stakeholders have the context necessary to make better decisions.

  • Ensure important decisions and changes are documented and communicated consistently across impacted teams.

  • Help reduce confusion caused by fragmented or inconsistent communication.

    • Operational Improvement

  • Identify recurring execution challenges, process breakdowns, organizational friction, and operational gaps.

  • Work with leadership to understand root causes and define strategies for addressing them.

  • Translate operational strategies into actionable improvements for the team.

  • Continuously evaluate how planning, prioritization, communication, and execution processes can be improved.

  • Encourage accountability across teams and help ensure problems are driven toward resolution rather than passed between functions.

What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means teams have greater clarity and predictability in how they operate.

    The right candidate will help create an environment where:

  • Teams understand what the highest priorities are and why.

  • Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Marketing remain aligned as plans evolve.

  • Roadmaps and backlogs accurately reflect the work of the team.

  • Risks and dependencies are surfaced early rather than discovered late.

  • Changes are communicated clearly and with appropriate context.

  • Meetings result in decisions and action rather than additional ambiguity.

  • Operational problems are identified proactively and systematically improved.

  • Leadership has confidence in the team’s ability to execute against its commitments.

Skills & Experience

    Strong Communication

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to communicate effectively across technical, product, creative, and business teams.

  • Comfortable facilitating discussions involving competing priorities or viewpoints.

  • Able to simplify complex situations and provide teams with clear direction and context.

    • Highly Organized

  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, stakeholders, and timelines simultaneously.

  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of broader strategic priorities.

  • Comfortable creating structure in environments where processes or responsibilities may not yet be clearly defined.

    • Diligent & Proactive

  • Does not wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them.

  • Proactively identifies risks, gaps, dependencies, and areas of confusion.

  • Consistently follows through on decisions, commitments, and open items.

  • Takes ownership of driving issues toward resolution.

    • Strategic & Operational Thinking

  • Able to distinguish between isolated execution problems and broader systemic challenges.

  • Comfortable working with leadership to improve how teams operate.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to identify root causes rather than treating symptoms.

  • Able to balance immediate delivery needs with longer-term improvements to team effectiveness.

Preferred Experience

  • Significant experience in Project Management, Program Management, Product Operations, or a similar role within a technology or software organization.

  • Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.

  • Experience managing product roadmaps, engineering backlogs, and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Experience working in complex organizations with multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Experience in gaming, payments, e-commerce, or technology platforms is a plus.

The duties and responsibilities of this position may evolve over time to support the organization’s goals and individual growth. raw.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We're looking for a Senior MarTech Manager to set the technology and operational strategy behind our marketing programs. This person will define how marketing strategy, data, systems, and execution connect, ensuring our tools work together, data is trustworthy, and teams can scale their use of technology to acquire, engage, and retain customers.

The ideal candidate operates at both altitudes: setting a multi-year MarTech strategy and architecture direction, while staying close enough to the stack to make sound build-vs-buy and integration calls. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence over cross-functional priorities, vendor spend, and technical direction, partnering closely with Marketing, Data, Product, and Engineering leadership.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Set strategy and own architecture decisions for the MarTech stack, including build-vs-buy calls and vendor relationships.
  • Define and drive a multi-year roadmap for marketing technology, automation, analytics, and personalization.
  • Direct the platform strategy for CRM, marketing automation, CDP, analytics, attribution, experimentation, and customer engagement tools.
  • Architect data flows between marketing systems, product systems, CRM, and the data warehouse, and set the standards other teams build against.
  • Establish and enforce governance standards for tracking, campaign setup, lifecycle management, and data quality across the org.
  • Partner with Marketing, Growth, Data, Product and Engineering leadership (Director/VP level) to translate business strategy into scalable technical solutions.
  • Identify and lead automation initiatives that materially reduce manual campaign operations.
  • Own the technical foundation for segmentation, lifecycle marketing, personalization, and reporting.
  • Lead vendor evaluation, selection, and contract negotiation; own implementation and adoption outcomes.
  • Build documentation, governance frameworks, and processes that make the MarTech ecosystem scalable and auditable.
  • Monitor system performance, data quality, and operational risk, and escalate/resolve complex issues before they become team-wide blockers.
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to marketing ops or MarTech staff, even without formal reporting lines.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8-12 years of experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, growth operations, or a related field, with a track record of owning strategy, not just execution.
  • Demonstrated experience setting technical direction and influencing decisions at the Director/VP level.
  • Deep expertise across CRM, marketing automation, customer data platforms, analytics, and integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce/HubSpot, Braze/Iterable, Segment, GA4, GTM, Snowflake/BigQuery, Zapier, Workato, OneTrust, and related platforms.
  • Strong SQL, API, and data integration fluency, with the judgment to know when to build vs. delegate.
  • Track record managing cross-functional projects, external vendors, and budget/spend decisions.
  • Executive-level communication skills, able to translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical leadership.
  • Comfortable setting direction in ambiguity, without waiting for complete information.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience building or modernizing a MarTech stack from the ground up, ideally at more than one company.
  • Experience in healthcare, consumer technology, subscription, or other data-rich, regulated environments.
  • Deep expertise in experimentation, attribution, lifecycle marketing, or personalization strategy.
  • Strong grasp of privacy, consent, and data governance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA if healthcare).

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • We now offer the Prenuvo’s Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we’ve got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $135,000-$150,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. About VictoriaMetrics

We are the company behind the popular open-source, high-performance time-series database and monitoring solution, VictoriaMetrics; as well as the open source logs database, VictoriaLogs, and our open source traces database, VictoriaTraces. Together, they form the VictoriaMetrics Observability Stack.

We are a fast-growing scaleup making our mark on the observability landscape with solutions that are simple, reliable and efficient. Fortune 500 companies use our products as their core observability solution such as Spotify R&D, Wix, Hubspot, Adidas, andthousands others. Our products have now surpassed 1 billion downloads.

About the opportunity

We have built strong momentum across European and North American markets, with established inbound and referral lead-generation channels that we are now ready to scale.

We are hiring a Marketing Manager focused on operations and execution to join our North American team. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, North America, you will be the engine that turns strategy into shipped work — running campaigns end-to-end, managing the marketing stack, building AI-powered workflows and agents, and making sure every initiative is measurable, repeatable, and on time.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves both the craft of marketing execution and the leverage that AI and automation bring to a modern team. You will be a key member of the Marketing team, helping define and execute our company and product messaging, content strategy, and marketing communications across the US market.

Required Qualifications

  • 4-7 years of B2B marketing experience with a strong operations and execution background; working with open-source, developer tools, or infrastructure software

  • Proven track record of running end-to-end marketing programs - planning, launching, measuring, and iterating - across email, web, paid, events, and content

  • Hands-on with the marketing stack: CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot), analytics (GA4 ), CMS, and integration tools.

  • Proficient with AI tools and how to apply them to real marketing work:

    1. Daily use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for research, drafting, editing, and content repurposing

    2. Strong prompt engineering skills - can write, test, and refine prompts to produce consistent, on-brand, technically accurate output

    3. Comfortable building AI projects and agents (custom GPTs, Claude Projects, agent workflows, RAG over internal docs) to automate recurring marketing tasks

    4. Understands how to evaluate AI output critically, fact-check technical claims, and keep humans in the loop where it matters

  • Automation mindset - you instinctively look for the repeatable parts of a process and wire them together with scripts, integrations, or agents

  • Strong project management; can run multiple workstreams without dropping balls, and brings structure to ambiguous problems

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to collaborate across engineering, sales, product, leadership and customers

  • Based in the United States, authorized to work in the US, and able to overlap with both East Coast and European business hours as needed.

  • Self-directed and comfortable working in a remote, distributed team

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing open-source projects, developer tools, or infrastructure software (observability, databases, monitoring).

  • Light coding for custom automations and data work.

  • Experience with attribution modeling and multi-touch reporting.

  • Prior experience at an early-stage or founder-led company.

What You Will Do

Marketing Operations NA

  • Own the marketing tech stack: CRM, marketing automation, analytics, attribution, and the integrations between them.

  • Maintain clean data, lead routing, lifecycle stages, and reporting dashboards so the team and leadership can trust the numbers.

  • Define and document repeatable processes for campaign launches, content production, and reporting.

  • Manage budgets, vendors, and tool evaluations; ensure spend is tracked and tied to outcomes.

Campaign Execution (End-to-End)

  • Plan, launch, and measure full-funnel campaigns — email sequences, webinars, paid programs, content launches, and events — from brief to retrospective.

  • Coordinate across content, design, web, sales, and engineering to keep campaigns on schedule and on brand.

  • Run A/B tests, analyze results, and iterate; bring data-driven recommendations to the Head of Marketing.

AI-Powered Content & Workflows

  • Use AI to accelerate content creation — outlines, first drafts, editing, SEO variants, social repurposing, and translations — while preserving the VictoriaMetrics technical voice with human review and sign-off.

  • Write, test, and version prompts as reusable assets the entire team can rely on (a shared prompt library, templates, and style guides).

  • Build AI projects and agents that automate recurring work — for example, a content-repurposing agent that turns a blog into LinkedIn posts, newsletter snippets, and SEO/AEO variants; a research agent that monitors competitor releases; or a customer-story agent that drafts case study outlines from call transcripts.

  • Pilot new AI tools, share what works with the broader team, and help raise the AI fluency of marketing as a whole.

Sales Enablement

  • Partner with the Head of Marketing NA and product marketing peers to keep enablement assets current — pitch decks, one-pagers, and demo narratives — and make sure sales can find what they need.

Feedback Loops

  • Run regular feedback loops with sales, support, and engineering — both live readouts and an async knowledge repository — so marketing stays connected to frontline insights.

Together we will

Grow business and engagement in North America with focus our key product lines:

  • Work with the Head of Marketing (NA), the sales team, and the founders to operationalize value propositions for the chosen go-to-market approach.

  • Measure, analyze, and improve marketing and sales metrics on a continuous cadence.

  • Build a modern, AI-augmented marketing function that punches above its weight.

Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage

  • Remote-first culture / Flexible PTO

Our hiring process

  • Introductory Video Call (30 min): Meet to discuss your experience and fit and clarify role and expectations.

  • Interview with the Head of Marketing, North America (60 min).

  • Interview with Chief Marketing Leader (30 min)

  • Call with founders (optional, 30 min): An extra session, if needed.

  • Offer: Embark on your journey with VictoriaMetrics.

raw.description:
MGID is a global advertising technology company and pioneer in native advertising, operating a programmatic platform that connects advertisers and publishers across 200+ countries. The company runs a real-time bidding (OpenRTB) business model with AI-powered targeting and content recommendation widgets, serving hundreds of millions of users monthly.

MGID is seeking a Strategy Manager to help define and execute the company’s multi-year strategic direction, with a strong focus on shifting from a product-led to a customer-value-led mindset, evaluating strategic product and investment opportunities, and cascading strategy into prioritized, cross-functional initiatives.

This role sits within a fast-moving, data-driven ad-tech environment and reports to the COO.

Role Purpose

The Strategy Manager will act as a key strategic partner to the COO and leadership team, responsible for shaping MGID’s medium- to long-term strategy, evaluating strategic options for products and markets, and ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into concrete, prioritized projects with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

Requirements

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategy, corporate development, or related roles within international tech scale-ups or high-growth environments; ad-tech or programmatic advertising experience is a strong plus.

  • Proven track record in a top-tier consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Big Four strategy practices) or equivalent strategic role in a tech company.

  • Hands-on experience preparing and presenting successful strategic cases with visible internal impact, such as new market entry, product portfolio optimization, or major investment decisions.

  • Strong financial modeling skills, including practical experience with valuation methods such as DCF, NPV, and IRR, and the ability to build and maintain investment models in Excel.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, commercial, data/BI, and operations leaders in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills; able to influence senior audiences and drive alignment across geographies.

  • Self-starter mindset: ready to operate as an individual contributor who can both design strategy and execute hands-on.

What You’ll Do:

Corporate & Product Strategy

  • Lead the identification and articulation of MGID’s overall strategy and strategic direction for the next 3–5 years, aligning with business focus and growth trajectory.

  • Evaluate strategic perspectives for specific products and portfolios, assessing market exposure, competitive dynamics, and growth potential.

  • Support the shift from a product-led to a customer-value-led company by embedding customer-centric frameworks into strategic planning, prioritization, and roadmap decisions.

Investment & Business Evaluation

  • Lead evaluations of stand-alone investment opportunities, including new products, markets, partnerships, and M&A, and prepare robust business cases with clear financial impact assessments.

  • Own and evolve company evaluation models, including DCF, NPV, IRR, and scenario analysis, and ensure consistent application across strategic and investment decisions.

  • Support participation in accelerators and corporate venture initiatives to identify and select startup investments that drive business growth and strategic synergy.

Strategy Execution & Prioritization

  • Cascade corporate strategy into granular projects and initiatives, working closely with the CPO, CRO, and BI Director on prioritization, resourcing, and sequencing.

  • Define KPIs and performance frameworks to track strategy implementation and outcomes, and establish governance and reporting routines for strategic workstreams.

  • Monitor progress, adapt plans in response to changing market conditions, and recommend corrective actions to keep strategic initiatives on track.

Strategic Analysis & Advisory

  • Conduct market, competitor, and customer analysis to inform strategic choices and identify opportunities and risks.

  • Facilitate scenario planning and stress testing to assess strategic resilience under different market and regulatory conditions.

  • Present strategic recommendations and status updates to senior leadership, influencing decision-making with clear, evidence-based insights.

At MGID, we thrive on innovation, collaboration, and a passion for AdTech. Our culture is built on openness, transparency, and a shared drive for excellence. We empower our teams to take bold steps, embrace challenges, and grow together in a dynamic, people-first environment. Here, your ideas matter, your contributions are valued, and your potential has no limits. Join us and shape the futureof digital advertising!

Group Finance Director – Insurance & Investments

About the Role

The Group Finance Director is a senior leadership position responsible for overseeing the Group's financial management, planning, reporting, controls, treasury, and performance across its insurance, investment, asset management, and other financial services businesses.

The role provides strategic financial leadership across subsidiaries and business units, ensuring strong financial performance, regulatory compliance, capital discipline, effective risk management, and high-quality decision support for the Group CFO, CEO, Board, and shareholders.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Group-wide financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Oversee consolidated financial reporting, management accounts, statutory accounts, and financial analysis across subsidiaries.

Drive FP&A, profitability analysis, cost optimization, and financial performance improvement.

Monitor financial performance across insurance, investments, asset management, and other Group businesses.

Oversee insurance finance, including premium revenue, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability analysis.

Lead financial reporting and accounting oversight for investment and asset management portfolios, including valuation, income, performance, and reporting.

Support Group-level capital planning, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet management.

Oversee treasury, cash management, funding requirements, and working-capital optimization.

Strengthen Group-wide financial controls, governance, policies, and risk management frameworks.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting obligations.

Provide financial analysis for M&A, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and capital allocation decisions.

Partner with senior executives to improve business-unit profitability, operating efficiency, and return on capital.

Lead finance transformation, including ERP, automation, management reporting, analytics, and digital finance initiatives.

Develop and mentor Finance Directors, Controllers, Heads of Finance, and senior finance teams across the Group.

Act as a key financial advisor to the Group CFO, CEO, Executive Committee, Board, auditors, regulators, investors, and other stakeholders.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Group revenue, EBITDA/profitability, and earnings growth

ROE / ROIC and return on capital

Budget and forecast accuracy

Cost-to-income and expense efficiency

Insurance underwriting and investment profitability

Capital adequacy and solvency position

Liquidity and treasury efficiency

Investment portfolio financial performance

Quality and timeliness of Group reporting

Regulatory and statutory compliance

Strength of internal controls and audit outcomes

Successful finance transformation and process automation

Value creation across subsidiaries and business units

Candidate Profile

15–20+ years of progressive finance experience, preferably within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience operating at Group / regional / multi-entity level.

Previous experience as Group Finance Director, Finance Director, Group Financial Controller, Deputy Group CFO, Financial Controller, or senior finance executive.

Strong understanding of insurance accounting, investment accounting, financial reporting, capital management, treasury, and regulatory finance.

Demonstrated experience managing complex consolidated reporting structures and multiple subsidiaries.

Strong commercial understanding of investment portfolios, financial markets, capital allocation, and business performance.

Experience supporting M&A, corporate transactions, strategic investments, or restructuring is highly desirable.

Strong leadership experience managing geographically dispersed finance teams.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent is strongly preferred.

Additional qualifications in insurance, investment management, or financial risk are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Finance | Group Consolidation | FP&A | Financial Reporting | Insurance Finance | Investment Finance | Capital Management | Treasury | Solvency | Financial Controls | Regulatory Reporting | M&A | Risk Management | Tax | Finance Transformation | Investor & Board Reporting

Leadership Characteristics

Strategic and commercially minded

Strong analytical and financial judgment

High integrity and governance orientation

Excellent stakeholder and Board communication

Results-driven and performance-focused

Strong people leadership and succession-planning capability

Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multi-entity environments

Reporting Line

Reports to: Group CFO / Group CEO

Key Stakeholders: Board of Directors, Executive Committee, Group CFO, CEOs/MDs of subsidiaries, Investment & Risk teams, Regulators, Auditors, Investors, and Shareholders.

Target Sourcing Titles

Group Finance Director | Group Financial Director | Group CFO | Deputy Group CFO | Finance Director | Group Financial Controller | Financial Controller | Regional Finance Director | Director of Finance | Head of Group Finance | Head of Finance | VP Finance | Deputy CFO | Finance Executive Director | Group Finance Controller

raw.description:
ABOUT YOU & THE ROLE

🚀 What is Synera? — Where AI Meets Deep-Tech

Synera is on a mission to accelerate engineering with AI. We’ve built the industry’s leading AI Agent platform for engineering teams, enabling companies to turn complex, manual workflows into automated processes — cutting weeks of engineering work down to minutes.

Our AI agents integrate seamlessly with the tools engineers already use, remove bottlenecks in real-world product development, and help deep-tech companies move faster without compromising quality. In a world where engineering speed is a competitive advantage, Synera is defining the new standard.

Having just closed our series B, we’re a fast-growing team, and we’re rapidly expanding our Revenue teams in Germany, France and the United States to support increasing demand from innovative deep-tech companies.

If you’re excited about selling cutting-edge AI, working close to the market, and building something early — and if you have big plans for your future — now is the right time to join us.

👉 Your Role

Joining us as a Sales Development Representative (SDR) in France you’ll be the first voice our future customers hear — C-level deciders, engineering leaders, innovation teams, and thought leaders at forward-thinking deep-tech companies.

Your mission: turn curiosity into conversations, and conversations into real business opportunities.

Let’s be real: this role is hands-on. You’ll spend a lot of time picking up the phone, sending messages, following up, and getting through to tough prospects. Along the way, you will learn how to position and pitch an AI product that delivers value, and how to drive thought leadership in the field of AI. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing, test different outreach strategies, and help shape how Synera goes to market in the US.

If you enjoy momentum, love the challenge of getting a “yes” from a skeptical prospect, and want to open doors that lead to big deals — we want to hear from you. If you are hungry to take the first step towards a sales career in one of the most exciting fields there is, you have come to the right place.

👉 Your main focus areas:

  • Pipeline Building: You qualify leads and set up meetings for the Account Executive team.

  • Prospect & Qualify: You engage senior leaders and decision-makers via cold outreach (email, LinkedIn, calls, reaching 60+ activities per day).

  • Outbound Excellence: You shape and manage targeted outbound campaigns, working with the Marketing team to optimize messaging.

  • Engage & tell great stories: You spark interest in Synera’s Agentic AI solutions through compelling storytelling and value-driven conversations. You experiment and find creative ways to engage with senior leaders and build trustful relationships

  • Iterate & Improve: You analyze outreach performance, test new approaches, and refine our SDR playbook.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You know our domain inside out: who our ideal customers are, what keeps them up at night, and how Synera solves their biggest challenges. You have become an AI native, and curiosity is what drives you daily.

  • You routinely create great Discovery Calls, proving you can turn outreach into meaningful conversations for our Sales team. You have gained great confidence in explaining and pitching a complex tech product.

  • You are a power user of our tools and workflows - from prospecting platforms to CRM systems. Giving and receiving feedback has become a normal part of your day.

  • You understand what makes our product special and be able to speak authentically about the value we bring to teams who want to transform what they do with AI. You love to share knowledge and good practices in an international team.

Here is our team at last year’s summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 What’s in it for you?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • Mid-level (OTE): 51.900€ - 60.400€

  • Senior (OTE): 42.800€ - 87.400€

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • Flexible working: you decide when and where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of $2,500. You’ll also have the chance to grow together with us!

  • We don't count your vacation days as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Access to the mental health platform nilo to support your well-being.

  • We support you with health insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan.

  • Regular team events, in the US or abroad (Germany)🌈

Requirements

🌱 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You are nativeGerman and fluent in English, allowing you to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders in an international environment.

  • You have proven experience in outbound B2B SaaS sales.

  • You can demonstrate a strong track record of performance, including consistent quota overachievement.

  • You are confident in pitching complex technical solutions (experience in AI, CAD, CAE, or engineering software is a strong plus).

  • You are resilient, handle rejection well, and continuously iterate with a growth mindset.

  • You are proficient with CRM systems and modern outbound tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, and Aircall.

  • You are motivated by proactively identifying and creating new business opportunities.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Sales Development team.

raw.title: Spezialist / Architekt Stammdaten SAP for Utilities (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: was wir suchenWir suchen erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der Branche, die Lust haben, sich einem sehr starken Team anzuschließen und sich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
raw.description:
was wir suchen

Wir suchen erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der Branche, die Lust haben, sich einem sehr starken Team anzuschließen und sich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Du befindest dich aktuell in einem sich wiederholenden Arbeitsumfeld und suchst einen neuen Blickwinkel auf deine Tätigkeit oder bist in deinem Umfeld die einzige Person, die die Materie wirklich beherrscht? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

was machen wir anders

Wir versammeln die Besten und Motiviertesten und setzen konsequent auf Qualität, Expertise und die Architektur die am Besten zu unseren Kunden passt. Durch unseren kontinuierlichen Austausch untereinander fördern wir uns gegenseitig und lassen neue Ideen und Ansätze gedeihen. Niemand deckt Schwerpunkte allein ab; jede Person hat jemanden, mit dem sie auf Augenhöhe diskutieren kann.

das bringst du mit

Wir wissen, dass unsere Anforderungen enorm sind. Aber nur mit diesem Anspruch erreichen wir auch das Niveau, das unsere Kunden von cerebricks erwarten. Falls du noch nicht alle Punkte abhaken kannst, kein Problem, bewirb dich trotzdem! Gemeinsam im richtigen Team schaffst du das locker.

  • Du bist Experte für das Datenmodell für die deutsche Energiewirtschaft mit Schwerpunkt SAP I-SU & S/4 HANA Utilities.
  • Du kennst die technischen und abrechnungstechnischen Stammdaten für die unterschiedlichen Messkonzepte und kannst die Objekte zuordnen (Marktpartner, Anschlussobjekt, Geräte, Messarten, technische Ressourcen, Lokationen, Verträge, Vertragskonten usw.), um in Workshops den Kunden zu beraten und Migrationskonzepte zu schreiben
  • Das Konzept zur Übermittlung der Lokationsbündelstruktur war dein am häufigsten gelesenes Dokument in 2023
  • Du kennst die Lücken und fehlende Detailebene im Referenzdatenmodell der SAP und hast eigene Ideen und Konzepte für unsere Kunden
  • Von der Standardentnahme und Standardeinspeisung bis zur Pauschalanlage, Summenmessung und Hinterschaltung kennst du die Konzepte so gut, dass du den Monteuren Vorgaben machen kannst
  • Gute Auffassungsgabe und Motivation sich in ein komplexes Themenumfeld wie das Mieterstrommodell, Abbildung von Arealnetze und Ladeinfrastrukturen, Trafoverluste und Eigenverbrauch einzuarbeiten und mitzugestalten
  • Du machst Vorgaben und Verbesserungsvorschläge für zahlreiche Kunden und definierst die Abbildung der Messkonzepte und Neuanlagenprozesse (z.B. im Rahmen der SAP Messkonzeptverwaltung)
  • Veränderungen der Marktbedarfe oder Prozesse erkennst du als erste(r) und definierst für eine Mehrzahl an Kunden den Umgang mit regulatorischen und gesetzlichen Veränderungen
  • Im SAP Umfeld bist du mit allen relevanten Komponenten und Modulen vertraut und immer auf dem neuesten Stand
    1. APE Framework & PDocs & Transferdokumente
    2. Common Layer & PDocs & IDocs sowie ältere Datenaustauschtechnologien
    3. SAP MaCo Cloud inkl. MMT
    4. US4G & UCOM
    5. Schnittstellen zur Abrechnung, Kundenmanagement und SAP Messkonzeptverwaltung
    6. SAP BTP inkl. 3rd Party EDM Apps
  • Du navigierst und handelst souverän in den Plattformen und findest die optimale Architektur für unsere Kunden, egal ob onPrem, hybrid oder in der Cloud
  • Die folgenden Begriffe machen dir keine Sorgen: APIs, Fiori elements, ABAP, Python, eclipse, REST

das erwartet dich bei uns

Dich erwarten spannende und abwechslungsreiche Herausforderungen – auf Projekten bei unseren Kunden und im Rahmen unserer eigenen Weiterentwicklung als Firma. Natürlich wirst du von uns fachlich und methodisch ausgebildet. Danach steht dir der Karriereweg bei uns und bei unseren Kunden offen.

Darüber hinaus findest Du bei uns:

  • Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell. Ob Vollzeit oder Teilzeit - beides machen wir möglich.
  • Attraktives Gehaltsmodell mit fix. und var. Gehaltsbestandteil sowie Erfolgstantiemen
  • Bei uns gilt remote first. Gleichzeitig ist uns der persönliche Kontakt wichtig, deshalb solltest du auch regelmäßig in unseren Büros präsent sein. Gute Gründe gibt es dafür genug: tolle Kolleg:innen, coole Co-Working-Spaces und gemeinsame Teamevents. Je nach Projekt kann außerdem die Arbeit direkt beim Kunden erforderlich sein. Diese Einsätze stimmst du flexibel und individuell mit deinen Kolleg:innen und den Kund:innen ab.
  • 32 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Zuschüsse zur Kinderbetreuung sowie Flexibilität und Kollegialität, wenn du wegen Kita oder Schule spontan Pläne anpassen musst
  • Freue dich auf flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, Pragmatismus und eine wertschätzende Kommunikation. Wir verbinden einmalig die Stabilität und Sicherheit eines inhabergeführten Unternehmens mit der Agilität eines Startups.
  • Stillstand kennen wir nicht! Wir achten darauf, dass Du dich wohlfühlst, investieren in Dich und entwickeln mit Dir deine persönliche Karriere. So wie das Unternehmen wächst, definieren wir auch gemeinsam dein Wachstum.

dein weg zu uns

Du hast bis hierher gelesen? Dann sollten wir uns schnellstmöglich kennenlernen.
Sende deine Bewerbungsunterlagen direkt über unser Kontaktformular und wir setzen uns mit dir in Verbindung zur Terminabsprache für ein erstes Kennenlernen.

raw.description:
At Limitlessli, we specialize in recruiting, hiring, and managing high-caliber remote staff for dynamic and growing healthcare facilities. Leveraging our extensive global network, we connect clients with highly qualified professionals, offering meticulously tailored services to meet our clients' unique business needs.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Forensic Utility Bill Auditor / Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will review and analyze utility accounts—including gas, electric, and water—to identify billing errors, incorrect rate classifications, tariff misapplications, unusual usage patterns, and potential overcharges.

You will work with utility bills, customer portals, spreadsheets, AI-powered data extraction tools, and public property information to investigate anomalies and help build evidence supporting potential audit findings and recovery claims.

This position is remote and offers you the flexibility of working from home.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Review customer utility accounts and billing histories to identify high-value accounts requiring further investigation.
  • Download and organize historical utility bills and supporting documentation.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and professional communications to utility providers outlining identified billing discrepancies, suspected errors, and supporting findings for further investigation and resolution.
  • Create and maintain standardized folder structures and audit files for each client, utility type, account, or property.
  • Prioritize accounts based on billing thresholds and potential financial impact.
  • Standardize utility statements into clean, readable PDFs suitable for data extraction and analysis.
  • Use AI-powered tools to extract up to 24 months of utility billing data into structured spreadsheets.
  • Analyze billing information using Month-over-Month (MoM) and Year-over-Year (YoY) comparisons.
  • Review key data points, including:
    • Billing cycle dates
    • Total monthly charges
    • Energy or utility consumption
    • Rates and tariffs
    • Meter types and rate classes
    • Itemized charges, including generation, transmission, and delivery costs
  • Identify irregular usage patterns, billing anomalies, potentially unjustified charges, and other indicators of possible overbilling.
  • Perform detailed quality assurance by manually validating AI-generated data against the original utility bills.
  • Research property characteristics, including square footage, property type, and visible operational factors that may impact utility usage.
  • Prepare targeted questions for clients to better understand property operations and consumption patterns.
  • Investigate suspected billing errors, including incorrect rate classes, meter types, and tariff violations.
  • Support the calculation of potential historical overcharges and assist in documenting the evidence behind audit findings.
  • Independently verify utility tariffs, rate schedules, regulations, and other supporting documentation using official published sources before finalizing findings.
  • Manage multiple high-priority accounts simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, organization, and attention to detail.

The role requires a combination of data extraction, benchmarking, manual quality assurance, property research, and tariff validation.

Qualifications & Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, Business, Engineering, Energy Management, or a related field is preferred.
  • Previous experience in data analysis, auditing, utility billing, energy management, financial analysis, or forensic analysis is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies, discrepancies, and potential errors within large sets of financial and operational data.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including data organization, calculations, comparisons, and analysis.
  • Experience working with large volumes of documents and maintaining highly organized digital filing systems.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered data extraction or document analysis tools is an advantage.
  • Experience reviewing utility bills, tariffs, rate schedules, meter types, or energy consumption data is preferred.
  • Strong research skills and the ability to locate and interpret information from official utility, regulatory, and public sources.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to manually verifying data accuracy.
  • Ability to understand and compare Month-over-Month and Year-over-Year performance and identify unusual variances.
  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills, with the ability to determine the potential cause of discrepancies.
  • Comfortable managing multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
  • A high level of integrity, accuracy, and discretion when handling client financial and operational information.

Service Fee:

Industry standards applicable to the state depending on work experience and level of expertise.

Hours:

US Eastern Standard Time (EST) - 10am to 6pm

Why Limitlessli?

We embrace the flexibility and convenience of a remote working environment, and you will collaborate with an international team while contributing to our growing business, all from the comfort of your home.

Essential requirements:

You will need to have some essential tools – a reliable computer and noise-canceling headset, a second monitor for enhanced productivity, and a stable internet connection. You’ll also be required to have a backup internet connection, ensuring that you’re well-equipped to complete your work seamlessly.

Don't miss out on this opportunity – apply now and become a valuable member of the Limitlessli team! If you're interested in what you have read, then we invite you to take the next step and submit your application.

JOIN OUR TEAM!
