Job Description: Social Media Manager (Instagram & Reddit)

  • Type: Part-time, 20–30 hours/week
  • Location: Remote (EU)
  • Sector: Adult

Our client is seeking a senior, self-directed Social Media Manager to take full ownership of organic user acquisition across Instagram and Reddit, with secondary support for TikTok. This role is built for a strategic operator who can independently steer the direction, execute at high volume, analyze data, and rapidly iterate.

Role Overview

The core focus of this position centers on Instagram and Reddit, where the target audience lives and traffic converts. While main social profiles remain platform-safe, they serve as top-of-funnel pathways directing users toward an NSFW AI girlfriend product. On Reddit, the work involves direct engagement and posting within NSFW subreddits.

Beyond direct execution, the Social Media Manager will brief and manage internal or external video content creators, setting clear creative direction for video shoots and ensuring content performs. This is a senior, part-time position suited for an experienced growth specialist who knows how to promote an adult product sustainably without triggering permanent account bans.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and execute the organic social media strategy across Instagram (primary), Reddit (close secondary), and TikTok.
  • Drive high-volume posting, monitor channel analytics, and pivot strategy rapidly based on performance data.
  • Navigate platform constraints skillfully, keeping public profiles compliant while effectively funneling traffic to the core product.
  • Execute direct community engagement and content placement within relevant NSFW subreddits.
  • Brief, direct, and manage video content creators to ensure production aligns with current trends and performance goals.
  • Leverage AI tools across content creation, scripting, video editing, scheduling, and analytics to operate at a multiplier of standard human capacity.

Requirements

  • Verifiable track record of Instagram growth, supported by account links, follower growth curves, and analytics data demonstrating scale from low thousands to hundreds of thousands (or higher).
  • Deep, practical experience growing traffic on Reddit without triggering site-wide or subreddit bans, demonstrating an intimate understanding of account age, karma requirements, subreddit rules, and moderator dynamics.
  • High degree of AI fluency with a proven workflow for scaling content operations using AI assistance.
  • Demonstrated ability to market and promote adult products successfully while maintaining account longevity.
  • Highly self-directed work ethic with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience scaling OnlyFans or independent creator accounts from scratch to meaningful traffic and revenue.
  • Proven track record of scaling TikTok accounts and driving external web traffic.
  • Experience building or utilizing custom automation for parts of the content pipeline.

raw.description:
Keller Executive Search is partnering with a leading supply-chain services company in the utility-scale solar and renewable-energy sector to hire an Enterprise Sales Manager. Our client helps manufacturers, EPCs, IPPs, and developers manage, move, and monetize solar equipment with speed and confidence, combining a national warehousing and transportation footprint with value-added inventory, storage, and secondary-market services that keep high-stakes projects on schedule.

The timing could not be stronger. The United States continues to add record volumes of new utility-scale solar capacity, and these large, high-value projects run on aggressive timelines where a single logistics failure can delay energization and strain supplier relationships. Solar modules and components are fragile, oversized, and warranty-sensitive, so buyers increasingly seek specialized partners rather than commodity brokers. This role sits precisely at that intersection, selling operational capability and reliability rather than a product on a shelf.

This is a fully remote, high-autonomy hunting seat with national territory ownership. You will independently generate, qualify, and close new enterprise logistics, warehousing, and supply-chain service contracts across the solar ecosystem, then partner with operations and finance to design solutions that are both compelling to customers and profitable to deliver. It is an ideal opportunity for a consultative enterprise seller who wants to leverage an existing renewable-energy network, sell complex high-value solutions, and make a measurable revenue impact inside a fast-growing organization with strong operational and proposal support behind them.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a sales strategy targeting utility-scale solar developers, EPCs, manufacturers, asset owners, and other enterprise customers
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities through prospecting, referrals, industry relationships, and strategic outreach
  • Lead consultative sales conversations to understand customers’ operational, logistics, inventory, transportation, and equipment needs
  • Develop tailored commercial proposals and solutions for complex, multi-stakeholder solar projects
  • Manage the complete sales cycle, from initial engagement and discovery through proposal development, negotiation, and contract close
  • Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and become a knowledgeable commercial partner to customers
  • Collaborate with operations, logistics, supply-chain, and leadership teams to ensure proposed solutions are commercially viable and operationally deliverable
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, activity, and forecasting information
  • Monitor market activity, customer requirements, competitor developments, and emerging opportunities within the solar industry
  • Represent the company at relevant conferences, trade shows, and industry events
  • Support account growth by identifying additional services and opportunities within existing customer relationships
  • Contribute market insight and customer feedback to the company’s broader growth strategy

Requirements

  • 5-7+ years of enterprise sales experience, preferably in logistics, warehousing, 3PL, renewable energy, or solar supply chains
  • Proven success selling logistics, warehousing, 3PL, or other complex service-based solutions to enterprise customers, with evidence of personally won deals
  • Hunter mentality with a demonstrated ability to independently generate and close net-new business, not grow an inherited book
  • Personal ownership of consultative, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from prospecting through contract execution, engaging VP and C-level decision makers
  • Understanding of solar or comparable capital-equipment logistics, including storage, transportation, inventory strategy, and project-based delivery models
  • Strong business acumen across financial metrics, deal economics, and lead/lag indicators
  • Proven ability to self-manage and stay productive in a fully remote environment with no local supervision
  • Strong written and verbal business communication in English
  • U.S.-based and able to cover a fully remote national territory in U.S. time zones
  • Willingness and ability to travel nationally approximately 20 to 30%

Preferred

  • Existing, currently active relationships within solar manufacturers, EPCs, developers, IPPs, or renewable-energy supply chains
  • Utility-scale solar experience specifically, as opposed to residential or C&I
  • A portable, multi-segment network of manufacturer, EPC, IPP, and developer decision makers
  • Deep solar supply-chain, warehousing, and inventory-strategy design expertise
  • Cross-functional collaboration experience with operations, warehousing, transportation, finance, and customer success
  • Disciplined CRM, pipeline, forecast, and proposal management (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)
  • Adjacent project-cargo, heavy or oversized equipment, wind, or battery-storage logistics experience that transfers to solar

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a commercially minded, self-driven enterprise hunter who thrives without an SDR team or a local office behind you. You are energized by opening new logos, running long multi-stakeholder deals across supply chain, procurement, operations, and finance, and translating complex operational challenges into tailored, margin-aware solutions. You bring credibility in the renewable-energy or logistics space, prefer selling solutions over commodities, and hold yourself to disciplined pipeline and forecast standards while building trust in person with senior buyers.

Benefits

  • Base salary range of $90,000 to $110,000, plus a commission plan on top of base
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment and schedule
  • PTO accrual, sick days, mental health days, and paid holidays
  • Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • FSA/HSA options and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Paid parental leave and wellness stipends
  • Professional development and volunteer time off
  • Employee discounts and referral bonuses

Keller is a recruitment agency that provides services to clients ranging from startups and non profits to multinational corporations. Keller emphasizes ethical search processes, attentive candidate care, and leadership placements that support long-term client outcomes.

To learn more about the firm and about our candidate services - please visit our website

For all positions, whether with Keller Executive Search or our clients, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, skin color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, protected veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

Reasonable Accommodations: Both Keller Executive Search and our clients are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and pregnant individuals. We engage in an interactive process to determine effective, reasonable accommodations.

raw.title: Engineering Project Manager - Substation Engineering
raw.excerpt: Revamp is seeking an Engineering Project Manager to oversee the delivery of the substation and interconnection engineering within our utility-scale renewable projects.
raw.description:
Revamp is seeking an Engineering Project Manager to oversee the delivery of the substation and interconnection engineering within our utility-scale renewable projects. You will manage multiple simultaneous projects and own scope, schedule, budget, and deliverables. You will read contract and proposal language, interpret what it means for the delivery of complex interconnection and substation projects, and give clients and internal teams clear direction and feedback on scope. You will actively orchestrate cross-disciplinary collaboration across our electrical, civil, structural, and power systems engineering teams to ensure projects are delivered efficiently and with a high level of accuracy.

As a member of a mission-driven team, you will contribute to meaningful projects that move the needle in the renewable energy transition—and as an employee-owner, you will be a direct recipient of the profitability of the firm and the projects you help deliver.

Duties & Responsibilities

Core Functional Responsibilities

  • Responsible for managing the scope, schedule, and budget for assigned projects from kickoff through closeout.
  • Interpret substation contract, proposal, and scope language and confirm what is included in the delivered scope.
  • Lead multiple substation and interconnection projects concurrently, including complex projects with multi-discipline scopes.
  • Manage internal engineering resources as well as the work of external subconsultants.
  • Manage submittals, RFIs, and change requests through to resolution.
  • Identify project risks, scope changes, and schedule impacts early, and drive them to a decision.
  • Prepare, track, and submit monthly project invoicing.
  • Apply standard project management procedures with independent professional judgment.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Using a strong understanding of the technical elements of each project, serve as the day-to-day reference point for the project team, routing technical questions to the right party.
  • Coordinate civil, electrical, power systems studies, and structural discipline leads to sequence work and meet deliverable dates.
  • Work with technical leads to plan detailed aspects of engineering work and resource assignments.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

  • Review Revamp deliverables for conformity to client expectations, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
  • Confirm that project execution meets client requirements, utility standards, and applicable jurisdictional requirements.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and records so equipment information and correspondence are filed and retrievable by the team.

Client Interface & Business Development

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects.
  • Lead project meetings with clients, internal teams, and subcontractors.
  • Present project status, risks, and technical issues clearly to client stakeholders.
  • Contribute scope definition, budget, and schedule inputs to proposals.

Mentorship & People Leadership

  • Assign and direct work for engineering discipline team members on assigned projects.
  • Mentor project engineers and less experienced project staff on delivery practices and client interaction.
  • Share substation delivery knowledge with the broader project management team so the group builds depth over time.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties including meeting deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or a closely related field, or similar applicable work experience.
  • Five or more years of project management experience in engineering consulting, EPC construction, renewable energy, or a comparable industry.
  • Direct experience delivering high voltage projects, such as substation, interconnection, or transmission work, as a project manager or project engineer.
  • Ability to read substation, transmission and other medium/high-voltage project contract and proposal terms and explain their delivery implications to internal teams and clients.
  • Demonstrated ownership of project scope, schedule, budget, and invoicing.
  • Confident, credible communication with technical client stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and resolve complex project issues with limited direction.
  • Ability to travel up to 15% of the time, including overnight trips, to support project sites, client meetings, and team events.
  • Ability to rent and drive a vehicle for business purposes, including maintaining a valid driver’s license and required auto insurance.

Preferred

  • Prior substation engineering experience before moving into project management, in any relevant discipline including electrical and structural.
  • Experience at a design-build or substation engineering and construction firm.
  • Greenfield substation project experience.
  • PMP certification.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and subconsultants.
  • Familiarity with the utility-scale renewable energy project development lifecycle.

Benefits for Full-Time Positions

  • Participation in Revamp’s Employee Ownership ESOP program
  • Competitive compensation with bonus.
  • Full benefits package including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.
  • Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.
  • Monthly health and wellness stipend.
  • Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.
  • Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility-scale solar generation capacity in the us since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation.

So much more than just an engineering firm; we are a diverse, international team of singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers and problem-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit

Disclaimers

1. Employment with Revamp Engineering Inc. may be subject to background checks that are permitted by applicable law and relevant to the position. Any such checks will be conducted in compliance with all legal requirements, including providing notice, obtaining consent where required, and allowing candidates to access and correct personal information as permitted by law.

2. Revamp Engineering Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We value diversity and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Revamp Engineering Inc. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you require an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us.

Salary: $110,000 – $145,000 / year

Group Finance Director – Insurance & Investments

About the Role

The Group Finance Director is a senior leadership position responsible for overseeing the Group's financial management, planning, reporting, controls, treasury, and performance across its insurance, investment, asset management, and other financial services businesses.

The role provides strategic financial leadership across subsidiaries and business units, ensuring strong financial performance, regulatory compliance, capital discipline, effective risk management, and high-quality decision support for the Group CFO, CEO, Board, and shareholders.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Group-wide financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Oversee consolidated financial reporting, management accounts, statutory accounts, and financial analysis across subsidiaries.

Drive FP&A, profitability analysis, cost optimization, and financial performance improvement.

Monitor financial performance across insurance, investments, asset management, and other Group businesses.

Oversee insurance finance, including premium revenue, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability analysis.

Lead financial reporting and accounting oversight for investment and asset management portfolios, including valuation, income, performance, and reporting.

Support Group-level capital planning, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet management.

Oversee treasury, cash management, funding requirements, and working-capital optimization.

Strengthen Group-wide financial controls, governance, policies, and risk management frameworks.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting obligations.

Provide financial analysis for M&A, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and capital allocation decisions.

Partner with senior executives to improve business-unit profitability, operating efficiency, and return on capital.

Lead finance transformation, including ERP, automation, management reporting, analytics, and digital finance initiatives.

Develop and mentor Finance Directors, Controllers, Heads of Finance, and senior finance teams across the Group.

Act as a key financial advisor to the Group CFO, CEO, Executive Committee, Board, auditors, regulators, investors, and other stakeholders.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Group revenue, EBITDA/profitability, and earnings growth

ROE / ROIC and return on capital

Budget and forecast accuracy

Cost-to-income and expense efficiency

Insurance underwriting and investment profitability

Capital adequacy and solvency position

Liquidity and treasury efficiency

Investment portfolio financial performance

Quality and timeliness of Group reporting

Regulatory and statutory compliance

Strength of internal controls and audit outcomes

Successful finance transformation and process automation

Value creation across subsidiaries and business units

Candidate Profile

15–20+ years of progressive finance experience, preferably within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience operating at Group / regional / multi-entity level.

Previous experience as Group Finance Director, Finance Director, Group Financial Controller, Deputy Group CFO, Financial Controller, or senior finance executive.

Strong understanding of insurance accounting, investment accounting, financial reporting, capital management, treasury, and regulatory finance.

Demonstrated experience managing complex consolidated reporting structures and multiple subsidiaries.

Strong commercial understanding of investment portfolios, financial markets, capital allocation, and business performance.

Experience supporting M&A, corporate transactions, strategic investments, or restructuring is highly desirable.

Strong leadership experience managing geographically dispersed finance teams.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent is strongly preferred.

Additional qualifications in insurance, investment management, or financial risk are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Finance | Group Consolidation | FP&A | Financial Reporting | Insurance Finance | Investment Finance | Capital Management | Treasury | Solvency | Financial Controls | Regulatory Reporting | M&A | Risk Management | Tax | Finance Transformation | Investor & Board Reporting

Leadership Characteristics

Strategic and commercially minded

Strong analytical and financial judgment

High integrity and governance orientation

Excellent stakeholder and Board communication

Results-driven and performance-focused

Strong people leadership and succession-planning capability

Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multi-entity environments

Reporting Line

Reports to: Group CFO / Group CEO

Key Stakeholders: Board of Directors, Executive Committee, Group CFO, CEOs/MDs of subsidiaries, Investment & Risk teams, Regulators, Auditors, Investors, and Shareholders.

Target Sourcing Titles

Group Finance Director | Group Financial Director | Group CFO | Deputy Group CFO | Finance Director | Group Financial Controller | Financial Controller | Regional Finance Director | Director of Finance | Head of Group Finance | Head of Finance | VP Finance | Deputy CFO | Finance Executive Director | Group Finance Controller

Job Title: Senior Director- U.S. Advocacy and Society Relations — Hematologic Cancers

Job Location: Remote, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Company Overview

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Position Overview

The Oncology Business Unit (OBU) Medical Affairs organization is building a best-in-class patient advocacy and society relations function across a strategically important portfolio spanning breast cancer, lung and gynecologic malignancies, hematologic and genitourinary cancers, and a growing early-stage pipeline. The OBU is committed to ensuring the patient and provider voice is embedded in every stage of medical strategy, clinical development, and evidence generation.

The Senior Director, U.S. Advocacy and Society Relations is a dedicated advocacy and society relations lead. This individual builds and manages Lilly's corporate relationships with a portfolio of cancer patient advocacy organizations (PAOs), professional medical societies, and related coalitions, ensuring these relationships advance Lilly's innovation readiness priorities and position Lilly as a partner of choice for improving outcomes for people living with cancer.

This position reports to the Associate Vice President, Patient Advocacy and Professional Relations, OBU Medical Affairs, and serves as a primary point of connectivity for disease state team leads and cross-functional colleagues across Clinical Development, Global Medical Affairs, Commercial, Communications, and Government Affairs and Policy.

Position Responsibilities

The Senior Director will support Lilly's goals to accelerate the reach and impact of the OBU portfolio and pipeline by managing a portfolio of patient advocacy and professional society relationships and their associated collaborations, sponsorships, and memberships. This individual will partner with the disease state teams and OBU advocacy leadership to advance innovation readiness strategic initiatives supporting the launch of key late-phase programs, line extensions, and other pipeline assets.

Primary responsibilities include:

Patient Advocacy and Professional Society Relationships

  • Build and sustain relationships with key cancer patient advocacy organizations and professional groups, identifying partnership opportunities and advocating for programs and policies that support the OBU portfolio.
  • Serve as Lilly's relationship owner for key PAOs and manage engagement with professional societies at the organizational level, ensuring Lilly's scientific and medical contributions are appropriately represented in society programming and policy positions.
  • Execute the OBU's tiered PAO engagement model, protecting core relationships from year-to-year prioritization volatility while enabling flexible activation at clinical and regulatory milestones.
  • Represent Lilly's mission and values through customer engagements, including congresses, meetings, and Lilly-sponsored events.
  • Execute memberships, sponsorships, and partnerships to grow brand equity and strengthen relationships, ensuring commitments and benefits are fulfilled.

Integration with OBU Disease State Teams

  • Serve as the advocacy and society relations partner to disease state team leads, ensuring PAO and society priorities are aligned with franchise medical strategy.
  • Advance understanding of the science related to priority oncology disease states and molecules, and build internal understanding of customer priorities, positions on key issues, and other environmental factors relevant to the assigned disease area(s).
  • Bring patient and provider community perspectives into clinical trial design, PRO endpoint discussions, and post-approval evidence communication for oncology assets, as appropriate.
  • Address barriers to access for the oncology patient community through external relationships and collaborations.

Government Affairs and Policy Connectivity

  • Partner with Lilly's Government Affairs and Policy team to advocate for policies supportive of key oncology priorities, including clinical trial access, rare disease designations, and coverage policies.
  • Keep Lilly's Government Affairs and Policy team informed of emerging PAO perspectives on access, coverage, and pricing, and identify opportunities for coordinated advocacy on oncology-relevant policy issues.

Funding, Governance, and Compliance

  • Manage sponsorships, memberships, and partnerships for the assigned oncology portfolio in alignment with company policies and OBU advocacy governance.
  • Provide input to the OBU patient advocacy budget and annual prioritization recommendations based on disease state team input and external landscape assessment.
  • Ensure all advocacy activities and financial relationships with PAOs comply with regulatory, legal, and ethical standards.

Internal Visibility, Communication, and Executive Support

  • Support executive engagement with key oncology organizations and at scientific congresses.
  • Collaborate with the External Engagement team on post-congress event readouts and sentiment intelligence memos to keep internal partners informed of the external landscape.
  • Support internal training and awareness to deepen employee understanding of the patient experience in oncology and to educate on patient advocacy best practices.
  • Identify innovative opportunities to communicate the impact of oncology patient advocacy efforts to internal and external audiences.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 5+ years of experience working in or with patient advocacy and/or professional medical society organizations.
  • Ability to travel up to 35%, including occasional weekend travel for major oncology congresses and PAO events.
  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Skills and Preferences

  • Master's or advanced degree in health sciences, public health, public policy, or related field.
  • Expertise working in the external environment to build relationships and advance policy or environment-shaping goals.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Specific passion for and knowledge of hematologic cancers preferred.
  • Specific experience or established relationships in hematologic malignancies and with hematology advocacy organizations and/or professional societies preferred.
  • Demonstrated resilience and a strong customer service orientation, with the ability to manage competing priorities and stakeholder expectations.
  • Strong strategic thinking skills, with the ability translate strategy and business priorities into implementation tactics.
  • Demonstrated relationship-building skills and the ability to influence others and lead without authority.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior internal and external audiences.
  • Experience working and communicating with executives.
  • Proven success understanding, interacting with, partnering with, and influencing the decisions of external stakeholders.
  • Experience or familiarity with healthcare policy and government affairs, particularly as it relates to access, coverage, and pricing, preferred.
  • Understanding of the oncology policy landscape and its impact on business priorities.
  • Extreme learning agility, with strong prioritization, problem-solving, and multi-tasking capabilities.

Additional Information

  • Domestic travel required (estimated up to 40%); occasional international travel possible depending on oncology congress calendar.
  • Remote work is possible; candidate should be open to travel to Indianapolis for business-critical meetings and team engagements.

DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Kick-start your engineering career with a remote role that puts you at the forefront of innovation! At DLB, you’ll collaborate with seasoned professionals on high-impact projects, including state-of-the-art hyperscale data centers that power the digital world. We’re looking for electrical, mechanical, and architectural engineers eager to apply their education, strengthen real-world design skills, and grow in a collaborative, tech-forward environment.

Position Title: Engineer I

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The Engineer I will have the opportunity to work with senior design staff to advance their design skills for commercial building design and construction. They will learn, through hands-on application, how to design a wide variety of projects. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team and interact closely with the Project Management Team to produce construction documents, assist in project specifications and assist in the construction administration process.

Engineers in this role may choose to pursue a project management–focused career track, gain exposure across all three MEP disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing/Fire Protection), or progress toward deeper specialization. Specialization paths may include Mechanical, Electrical, or Plumbing/Fire Protection design, as well as advanced focus areas such as Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Power Systems Studies, Information and Communications Technology (ICT), or other mission-critical engineering specialties, based on individual interests, strengths, and business needs.

The Engineer I will rely on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job.  This person will work under immediate supervision.

The Engineer I will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

ASSIST IN PRODUCTION OF ENGINEERING DOCUMENTS (50%)

  • Perform basic engineering work and design tasks under a senior engineer’s supervision
  • Perform standard computations and analysis
  • Perform load calculations, equipment selection and pressure drop calculations
  • Utilize AutoCAD and Revit software to prepare drawings and visual aids
  • Assist in the review and creation of drawings details, schedules, sequence of operations and drawing content as directed

ASSIST IN PRE-CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITIES (15%)

  • Survey existing building conditions and prepare technical reports of findings
  • Collect data and other information for construction documents
  • Prepare project design and construction documents
  • Basic review and editing of project specifications
  • Basic review of long lead equipment and impact on design conditions

ASSIST IN CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITIES (15%)

  • Work as part of the engineering team and interact closely with the project management team
  • Assistwith construction administration tracking (submittals, RFIs, etc.)
  • Review shop drawings and submittals
  • Review and respond to RFIs
  • Assistwith punch lists and project closeout documents

REPORTING (10%)

  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Provide status updates on work products

TECHNOLOGY, DIGITAL TOOLS & AI-ENABLED EFFICIENCY (10%)

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identifyopportunities to improve processes anddemonstratea continuous learning mindset, seeking outnew technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt toemergingtechnologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Project Management Track would also include(percentages above would shift):

Project Coordination and Support

  • Assist Project Managers withday-to-daycoordination of routine project tasks and deliverables.
  • Track action items, schedules, and milestones under guidance to supporttimelyproject execution.
  • Maintain organized project files and documentation to ensure accuracy and accessibility.
  • Support coordination between internal teams and external stakeholders by relaying information and following up on routine requests.
  • Organize andassistin QAQC and compilation of work products (including subconsultants) for external distribution

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (BEGINNER LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED)

  • Knowledge of engineering principles
  • Knowledge of code and specifications for design and engineering
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Ability toleverageAI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows,optimizeoperational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation.
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environmentthrougheffective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents,reportsand correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, facility and other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

TRAINING REQUIREMENTS

In support of your success and long-term growth at DLB, the Design Team hosts a week-long, in-person onboarding and training program for new hires. This immersive experience, held at DLB’s Training & Collaboration space at Bell Works in Holmdel, New Jersey, is designed to help you build meaningful connections, gain hands-on exposure to our tools and standards, and develop a strong understanding of how your work contributes to our projects and teams. The program provides dedicated time to learn, collaborate, and confidently step into your role alongside fellow Design Team members.

Attendance and active participation in this training are required as part of your onboarding with the Design Team. All reasonable travel expenses associated with attending this training will be covered by DLB.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 10%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
  • Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering from ABET accredited institution, with a sound knowledge of engineering fundamentals

BENEFITS

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

About the company

Our client is a dynamic recruitment and talent solutions platform dedicated to bridging the gap between high-growth startups and top-tier professional talent. By leveraging innovative sourcing strategies and deep industry insights, the team helps organizations across various sectors scale their operations with precision. They specialize in identifying specialized skill sets for modern businesses, ensuring that both candidates and employers find the perfect alignment for long-term success.

As a fast-growing player in the human capital and HR technology space, the company operates with a remote-first mindset that prioritizes efficiency and impactful connections. The team is driven by a mission to modernize the hiring experience through data-informed decision-making and a highly collaborative internal culture. For professionals looking to make a significant impact within a scalable, forward-thinking environment, this organization offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of talent acquisition and workforce development.

Job Summary

We are seeking a high-energy, hands-on Business Development Manager to lead a team of four specialists while maintaining an active presence on the front lines of sales. This is not a "sideline" management role; it is a position for a true sales leader who thrives on coaching, analyzing data, and closing deals. You will be responsible for driving accountability, optimizing outbound campaigns, and ensuring the team consistently hits aggressive revenue goals within the staffing and recruiting industry. If you are an expert at turning raw data from tools like Apollo and Aircall into actionable sales strategies, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to diagnose why a campaign or representative is underperforming using specific data metrics.
  • Mastery of the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, objection handling, and closing.
  • Ability to create and implement performance recovery strategies when KPIs are not met.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a focus on value-based selling.
  • Advanced experience with Apollo, Aircall, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Familiarity with multi-channel sales sequencing tools and advanced CRM reporting.
  • Experience developing custom sales training modules and rebuttals for the staffing industry.

🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

raw.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for experienced Internal Appointment Setters / SDRs to join a fast-paced, fully remote outbound sales environment.
raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for experienced Internal Appointment Setters / SDRs to join a fast-paced, fully remote outbound sales environment.

This is a pure B2B cold-calling role focused on speaking directly with US small and mid-sized business owners and sales leaders. You will be responsible for opening conversations, identifying genuine business needs, handling objections confidently, and booking qualified 30-minute sales meetings.

This position is best suited to someone who already understands the rhythm and discipline of outbound prospecting — including call volume, connect rates, follow-up, meeting conversion and rebooking no-shows.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Make high-volume outbound cold calls to US-based small and mid-sized businesses.
  • Maintain an average calling pace of approximately 20–25 dials per hour.
  • Speak directly with business owners, decision-makers and sales leaders.
  • Follow a structured cold-calling methodology and sales script.
  • Identify whether prospects have a genuine business need and qualify opportunities accordingly.
  • Book qualified 30-minute sales meetings and secure them on the calendar.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects who request a callback.
  • Proactively rebook prospects who no-show rather than treating the opportunity as lost.
  • Maintain accurate prospect statuses, notes, follow-ups and meeting information within the CRM.
  • Provide a concise end-of-shift update covering calls, conversations, meetings booked and outstanding follow-ups.
  • Participate in ongoing sales coaching, call reviews, role-play sessions and team training.

Performance Expectations

The role operates in a measurable, performance-driven environment. The initial benchmark is approximately one booked meeting for every two hours of calling, with performance expected to progress toward approximately one appointment per hour.

Successful candidates should be comfortable discussing and working against metrics such as:

  • Daily dial volume
  • Connect/conversation rates
  • Conversations-to-meeting conversion
  • Meeting show rates
  • Weekly meetings booked

Essential Experience & Requirements

Candidates must have:

  • A minimum of 12 months' experience in a genuine outbound cold-calling role.
  • Recent outbound calling experience gained within the last two years.
  • Proven B2B sales, appointment-setting or SDR experience.
  • Experience cold calling rather than working primarily with warm inbound enquiries.
  • Experience selling or prospecting into the US or UK market, or demonstrable ability to communicate effectively with US prospects.
  • Strong experience handling objections and maintaining composure during difficult calls.
  • A clear, warm, professional and easy-to-understand speaking voice suitable for engaging US business owners.
  • Strong knowledge of their own outbound sales metrics and previous performance.
  • A persistent but professional approach to follow-up and rebooking.
  • The ability to work independently and remain productive throughout a remote evening shift.
  • A coachable mindset and willingness to follow an established sales methodology.

Communication Style

We are looking for someone who sounds warm, confident, composed and unhurried on the phone. Strong candidates know how to slow a conversation down, ask effective questions, leave space for the prospect to respond and remain calm when faced with objections or rejection.

The ability to maintain the right tone under objection is particularly important.

Remote Working Requirements

As this is a phone-intensive remote position, candidates must have:

  • A quiet, dedicated home working environment with no disruptive background noise.
  • Stable and reliable internet, preferably with a wired connection.
  • A reliable backup solution for internet or power interruptions.
  • A working computer.
  • A professional-quality headset.
  • A webcam for meetings, training and coaching sessions.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday – Full Time

  • Until 1 November 2026: 16:00 – 00:00 SAST
  • From 1 November 2026: 17:00 – 01:00 SAST

Candidates must be genuinely comfortable working these hours on a permanent basis.

Systems & Tools

The role uses:

  • CRM software for daily prospect lists, call notes, statuses and meeting logging
  • Cloud-based phone systems
  • Calendar and meeting-booking tools
  • AI-supported role-play and training tools

Previous experience with a specific CRM platform is not required, provided you are comfortable learning new sales technology.

What Will Make You Stand Out

You are likely to excel in this position if you have 1–5 years of recent B2B outbound appointment-setting or SDR experience, can confidently explain your previous cold-calling metrics, understand that follow-up is a major part of appointment generation, and remain calm and personable when prospects push back.

There is also potential for strong performers with leadership capability to grow into team-lead responsibilities as the remote sales team expands.

Benefits

Compensation

USD $1,600 – $2,000 per month, depending on experience, demonstrated performance and seniority.

Candidates with a strong track record of producing results and the potential to progress into leadership may be considered toward the upper end of the range.

Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to complete a practical outbound sales assessment, including questions about previous calling metrics, objection-handling scenarios and a short live cold-call role-play.

The assessment is designed to evaluate outbound experience, numbers fluency, follow-up instinct, call presence and coachability.

Job Title: Cloud / DevOps Exploitation SpecialistJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Public TrustEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a Cloud/DevOps Exploitation Specialist to build, secure, assess, and evolve the AWS environment that supports continuous attack-surface operations. This hands-on role combines advanced Terraform and Ansible engineering. The role also validates cloud identity/authorization paths, supply-chain vulnerabilities, and CI/CD exploitation scenarios. The specialist will make assessment infrastructure repeatable, and version controlled while also validating cloud and DevOps attack paths within approved scope.

This position will provide continuous technical assessment support for full‑time, proactive testing of externally and internally visible federal cyber assets. This expands federal visibility by conducting continual assessments of .gov domains, subdomains, and internet‑facing assets to uncover unknown exposures, validate vulnerabilities, and provide agencies with actionable remediation guidance. This role supports the Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) Program’s mission to safeguard and secure cyberspace in an environment where the threat of cyber-attack is continuously growing and evolving and is responsible for enhancing the security, resilience, and reliability of the Nation’s cyber and communications infrastructure. The CDM Program defends the United States (U.S.) Federal Information Technology (IT) networks from cybersecurity threats by providing continuous monitoring sensors (tools), diagnosis, mitigation tools, and associated services to strengthen the security posture of Government networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS network, IAM, compute, storage, data, logging, and security services using reusable Terraform modules and Ansible automation.
  • Operate secure version-control, review, testing, state-management, secrets-management, approval, deployment, rollback, and change-audit processes for infrastructure as code.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that deploy assessment infrastructure and integrate IaC, secrets, dependency, container, registry, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Assess AWS, CI/CD, container, registry, Kubernetes, and IaC configurations for exploitable weaknesses; safely validate privilege escalation, lateral movement, supply-chain, and data-exposure paths when authorized.
  • Test Kubernetes/EKS governance, service account privilege escalation, and container breakout vectors.
  • Investigate IaC misconfigurations by exploiting tfsec/Checkov findings to demonstrate realistic attack feasibility.
  • Harden and monitor assessment infrastructure while preserving the flexibility required for scanning, reconnaissance, controlled exploitation, and rapid response.
  • Develop Python, Bash, PowerShell automation, APIs, and operational tooling; maintain architecture diagrams, runbooks, module documentation, and recovery procedures.
  • Partner with Attack Surface Testing engineers and customer platform owners to troubleshoot issues, control cost and performance, and deliver secure, repeatable technical capabilities.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • The selected candidate must meet eligibility requirements for access to sensitive information and be able to obtain a Public Trust fitness determination (High Risk).
  • Ability to work in customer-provided remote environments, use customer-approved tools, and comply with rules of engagement, data-handling requirements, evidence controls, deconfliction procedures, and stop-work criteria.
  • Five or more years of cloud, DevOps, DevSecOps, platform-engineering, or cloud-security experience, including at least three years of hands-on AWS and infrastructure-as-code work.
  • Advanced practical experience with Terraform and Ansiblein version-controlled production environments, including modules, remote state, secrets, testing, approvals, and repeatable deployment.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS IAM, VPC/networking, EC2/compute, S3/storage, KMS, CloudTrail/logging, serverless, container, and data-service security.
  • Hands-on experience withCI/CD and container ecosystems such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, and ECR or comparable tools.
  • Experience with security testing tools such as Checkov/tfsec, Trivy/Grype, Prowler/ScoutSuite, Semgrep, SAST/DAST, secrets scanning, and cloud-native security services.
  • Strong Linux, networking, Git, and scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

Desired:

  • AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect/DevOps Professional, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, CKS/CKA, GCSA, or comparable credentials.
  • Experience building short-lived or segmented offensive-security/assessment infrastructure with strong auditability and teardown controls.
  • Experience exploiting IAM, CI/CD, container, registry, Kubernetes, serverless, metadata-service, or IaC weaknesses in authorized assessments.
  • Experience with policy as code, OPA/Conftest, SBOM, software-supply-chain controls, observability, and cost/performance optimization.
  • Federal cloud, FedRAMP, GovCloud, DHS/CISA, or high-assurance environment experience

raw.description:
Job Title: Global Study Delivery Lead

Location: Remote-Flexible/Global

Job Type: Full-Time, exempt

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer

SUMMARY

To lead and be accountable for Civia's global study delivery function, setting the standard for operational excellence, building high-performing delivery capability, and ensuring the successful delivery of all studies to time, cost, quality, and client expectations.

SCOPE

This is a hands-on, operational delivery role — not advisory and not a back-office systems function. The Global Study Delivery Lead is the global delivery authority for Civia’s studies, accountable for delivering them to time, cost, and quality, acting as a primary client point of contact, and owning project-management excellence across the organisation. Its defining way of working is close, day-to-day partnership with in-country delivery teams — enabling them and holding a single, high standard everywhere — and it is the single accountable owner of how delivery performance is reported. Where study-level delivery is managed at country level, this role owns delivery across the entire global portfolio, together with the methodology, baselines, and KPIs that make it repeatable.

The role operates at enterprise level within the study delivery leadership structure and holds no responsibility for strategic partners. The methodology, documentation, and reporting it builds are a means to an end: consistently delivering studies and exceeding client expectations.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Accountability for delivering Civia’s study portfolio to time, cost, and quality, globally
• Partnering closely with in-country delivery teams to raise and hold a single, high standard across every study and geography
• Acting as a primary point of contact for clients on delivery, building trust and ensuring every commitment is met
• Ownership of project-management excellence across Civia, holding internal functions to account for delivery
• Direct, decisive intervention whenever delivery performance is at risk
• Identification, creation, and implementation of the methodology, documentation, baselines, forecasts, and KPIs that make delivery repeatable
• Sole ownership of study-performance reporting — ensuring delivery is represented accurately, currently, and in KPI terms always
• Sustained client confidence through delivery that consistently meets and exceeds expectations
• The accountable leader in Civia for setting the tone and expectations for study management, fostering excellence, and a mentor who develops less experienced delivery colleagues.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Study Delivery — Time, Cost & Quality

• Own delivery of the global study portfolio to time, cost, and quality, end to end across start-up, recruitment, execution, and close-out
• Maintain a forward-looking view of delivery health and forecast accuracy, and intervene directly and decisively when any study is at risk
• Drive the trade-offs and recovery actions that keep studies on schedule, on budget, and at the required quality
• Protect delivery quality, timelines, and cost discipline through proactive risk identification and resolution

Client Leadership & Point of Contact

• Act as a primary point of contact for clients on delivery, owning the relationship and representing Civia’s delivery performance
• Provide transparent, forward-looking delivery communication — progress, risks, variance, and recovery actions
• Build trust through reliability and consistency, ensuring every commitment made to a client is met
• Enable repeat work by making Civia predictable and exceptional to deliver with

Project-Management Excellence Across Civia

• Own the standard of project-management excellence across Civia, leading the study delivery and project-management methodology
• Set clear ownership, decision rights, governance routines, and escalation pathways for study delivery
• Coach and uplift delivery and project-management capability so studies are run to a consistently high standard everywhere
• Hold internal functions accountable for their contribution to delivery commitments
• Mentor and develop more less experienced delivery and project-management colleagues, actively building the next generation of delivery talent

Global Partnership & Cross-Functional Alignment

• Work closely and continuously with in-country delivery teams— the primary partnership through which studies are delivered — enabling them, aligning on priorities, and holding a single, high standard everywhere
• Align Site Operations, Recruitment, Regulatory, Data, Quality, and Safety with country teams to deliver each study to plan
• Facilitate portfolio- and study-level delivery reviews and drive timely resolution of bottlenecks
• Establish clear accountability so every country team and function knows what it owns and by when
• Escalate constructively and act decisively when delivery performance deviates from plan

Methodology, Baselines, Forecasts & KPIs

• Identify, create, and implement Civia’s study delivery methodology, documentation, and processes — the means by which studies are delivered reliably
• Define the reporting baselines and forecasting models against which all study delivery is planned and measured
• Design, implement, and own the KPI framework for study delivery, ensuring metrics are meaningful, comparable, and acted upon globally
• Act as the single source of truth for study-performance reporting — owning the accuracy, currency, and integrity of every system, report, and KPI
• Embed a single, repeatable way of working that removes delivery variability across studies, sites, and geographies

Governance, Risk & Continuous Improvement

• Establish disciplined governance routines and a performance cadence across the portfolio
• Ensure continuous audit and inspection readiness is built into delivery
• Lead corrective actions and continuous-improvement initiatives, closing the loop from insight to embedded change
• Continuously refine methodology based on delivery data, lessons learned, and evolving client and regulatory expectations

Performance Measures (KPIs)

• On-time delivery: Studies delivered to agreed timelines across the global portfolio
• On-budget delivery: Delivery to cost and margin protection across the portfolio
• Quality: Delivery to required quality, with continuous audit and inspection readiness sustained
• Portfolio delivery vs commitment: ≥100% of study commitments met across the global portfolio
• Client satisfaction: Strong sponsor feedback on delivery and repeat awards
• Country-team partnership: Strength of collaboration with in-country delivery teams, evidenced by consistent, high-quality delivery and expectations exceeded across geographies
• Forecast accuracy: Delivery performance tracking on or ahead of approved baselines and forecasts
• Reporting integrity: Study performance always represented accurately and current, with systems, reports, and KPIs trusted as the single source of truth
• Delivery variability: Year-on-year reduction in delivery variance and avoidable slippage
• Project-management maturity: Consistent, high-standard application of delivery methodology and KPIs across all studies and geographies

Experience & Qualifications:

Required Experience

• 10-15 years of relevant experience with deep operational understanding of clinical trial delivery and its dependencies
• Track record of delivering strategic and operational outcomes
• Proven ability to design, document, implement, and scale delivery and project-management systems
• Strong regulatory, GCP, GDPR and operational literacy
• Strong analytical and financial literacy — builds baselines, forecasts, and KPIs that hold up
• Platform experience with CRIO, HubSpot, and Monday.com

Mindset

• Deeply focused on delivery — driven to complete studies to time, cost, and quality
• Client-first and self-starting; takes ownership of the relationship and closes delivery gaps on their own initiative
• Uncompromising on delivery standards and determined to exceed client expectations

Behavior

• Brings structure, clarity, and a single way of working to complex, multi-geography delivery
• Operates hands-on and close to the work, building strong, trusting partnerships with in-country delivery teams to raise the standard everywhere
• Acts decisively when delivery is at risk; closes the loop from insight to embedded change
• Communicates with authority, transparency, and credibility at leadership level
• Focuses on practical solutions and supports others in learning and improving through challenges.

Personal Traits

• Highly accountable, resilient, and composed under pressure
• Self-directed, organised, and adaptive — treats being a self-starter as the baseline, not the goal
• Builds confidence with teams and stakeholders through follow-through and reliability
• Takes pride in honest, current reporting — owns delivery issues as a reflection of the function and moves quickly to put them right

Qualifications:

  • ​B.S. or B.A.; MBA or equivalent advantageous. Science related degree preferred.

There is never a typical day at Accenture, but that’s why we love it here! This is an extraordinary chance to work in a digitally driven, innovation-led environment where you can help clients in their own reinvention journey. As you build a rewarding career at Accenture, you’ll have the opportunity to work with leading-edge technologies and take on some of the coolest projects you can imagine.

ABOUT ACCENTURE SECURITY

Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond to, and recover across all points of the security lifecycle. Our OT Security practice delivers program-scale cybersecurity outcomes to critical infrastructure owners across energy, utilities, oil & gas, manufacturing, water, and life sciences—combining deep domain expertise with the scale and innovation that only Accenture can bring.

The Work

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager, you will lead complex, multi-workstream engagements and drive the growth of Accenture's OT Security practice. You are a recognized practitioner who can direct delivery teams, build trusted client relationships at the CISO and VP level, and contribute to business development across the OT security market. You balance strategic vision with operational accountability—ensuring delivery quality on your own accounts while actively supporting the pursuit of new business as a senior subject matter expert.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead multi-workstream OT security engagements across critical infrastructure clients—owning delivery quality, client satisfaction, and financial performance

  • Develop and execute OT security program strategies for clients, including multi-year roadmaps, governance structures, CSOC build-outs, and technology investment plans

  • Serve as a trusted senior advisor to client CISOs, VP-level leaders, and operational stakeholders on OT risk strategy, regulatory compliance (NERC CIP, TSA, CFATS), and program maturity

  • Drive client growth through relationship development, add-on scoping, and proactive identification of security capability gaps

  • Oversee and mentor a team of consultants and managers—providing technical guidance, career development, and quality assurance across deliverables

  • Serve as a senior SME on competitive OT security pursuits—shaping win strategy, contributing to RFP responses and orals preparation, and lending technical credibility to proposals across the practice pipeline

  • Lead or co-lead OT security business development efforts including opportunity qualification, client presentations, and proposal strategy

  • Represent Accenture's OT security capabilities externally through speaking engagements, industry forums, and client workshops

  • Contribute to Accenture's OT Security practice development—building reusable assets, methods, accelerators, and partnerships with OT technology vendors (Dragos, RunZero, NetRise, Claroty, etc.)

  • Manage engagement economics: staffing, forecasting, margin, risk escalation

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity or critical infrastructure security roles

  • Minimum 7 years of consulting experience, with a demonstrated track record delivering OT security programs to Fortune/Global 1000 or critical infrastructure clients

  • Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience, including managing, mentoring, and developing consultants and senior consultants

  • Minimum 5 years of experience leading OT security assessments, program design, or managed security implementations across multiple industry verticals

  • Minimum 5 years of experience engaging with C-suite and VP-level client stakeholders on OT risk, compliance, and program strategy

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Professional Skills Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience with OT regulatory frameworks: NERC CIP, IEC 62443, TSA SD-02D, NIST CSF, DOE C2M2, or equivalent

​Bonus points if you have

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in business development activities: shaping opportunities, developing win strategies, leading client pitches

  • Experience structuring and managing large-scale OT security programs ($2M+ engagements) with multiple concurrent workstreams

  • Deep familiarity with the OT security vendor ecosystem (Dragos, RunZero, NetRise, Claroty, Nozomi, Armis, Verve, etc.) and the ability to position Accenture's alliance investments commercially

  • Experience building or operating OT-centric CSOCs, integrating OT NSM platforms with enterprise SIEMs and SOC workflows

  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK for ICS, threat intelligence frameworks, and adversary TTPs targeting critical infrastructure

  • Relevant certification: CISSP, GICSP, CISM, GRID, or equivalent

  • Existing relationships with utility, energy, or critical infrastructure security leaders

  • Experience contributing to OT security thought leadership: publications, conference presentations, or regulatory comment processes

  • Master's degree in cybersecurity, engineering, business, or a related field
